```systemverilog
      fdi_lp_rx_active_sts = 1'b0;

      count = 0;
      while ((fdi_pl_state_sts != PhyState_linkError || debug_rdi_state != PhyState_linkError) && count < 300) begin
        step(1); count++;
      end
      if (count >= 300) $fatal(1, "FDI/RDI did not both reach LinkError");
      if (fdi_pl_stall_req || fdi_pl_inband_pres)
        $fatal(1, "LinkError stall/inband outputs are incorrect");

      fdi_lp_linkerror = 1'b0;
      fdi_lp_state_req = PhyStateReq_active;

        step(1); count++;
      end

  task automatic scenario_direct_reset_exits;
    logic [63:0] header;
    logic [63:0] payload;
    logic has_payload;
    logic saw_adapter;
    logic saw_rdi;
    int unsigned packets;
    int unsigned count;
    string direct_reset_case;
    begin
      if (!$value$plusargs("DIRECT_RESET_CASE=%s", direct_reset_case))
        direct_reset_case = "all";
      if (direct_reset_case != "all" && direct_reset_case != "disabled" &&
          direct_reset_case != "linkreset" && direct_reset_case != "linkerror")
        $fatal(1, "Unknown +DIRECT_RESET_CASE=%s", direct_reset_case);
      $display("[scenario] Direct Reset exits case=%s", direct_reset_case);

      if (direct_reset_case == "all" || direct_reset_case == "disabled") begin
        // Reset -> Disabled -> Reset.
        reset_and_initialize(1'b0);
        fdi_lp_state_req = PhyStateReq_nop;
        step(2);
        fdi_lp_state_req = PhyStateReq_disabled;

        saw_adapter = 1'b0;
        saw_rdi = 1'b0;
        packets = 0;
        while (!(saw_adapter && saw_rdi) && packets < 4) begin
          take_tx_message(header, payload, has_payload, 1000);
          if (header == LOCAL_ADAPTER_REQ_DISABLE) saw_adapter = 1'b1;
          else if (header == LOCAL_RDI_REQ_DISABLE) saw_rdi = 1'b1;
          else $fatal(1, "Unexpected Reset->Disabled message 0x%016h", header);
          packets++;
        end
        if (!(saw_adapter && saw_rdi)) $fatal(1, "Reset->Disabled requests incomplete");

        send_rx_message(REMOTE_RDI_RSP_DISABLE, 64'b0, 1'b0, 1000);
        count = 0;
        while (debug_rdi_state != PhyState_disabled && count < 300) begin step(1); count++; end
        send_rx_message(REMOTE_ADAPTER_RSP_DISABLE, 64'b0, 1'b0, 1000);
        count = 0;
        while ((fdi_pl_state_sts != PhyState_disabled || debug_rdi_state != PhyState_disabled) && count < 500) begin
          step(1); count++;
        end
        if (count >= 500) $fatal(1, "Direct Reset->Disabled did not complete");

        fdi_lp_state_req = PhyStateReq_active;
        count = 0;
        while ((fdi_pl_state_sts != PhyState_reset || debug_rdi_state != PhyState_reset) && count < 300) begin
          step(1); count++;
        end
        if (count >= 300) $fatal(1, "Disabled->Reset did not complete");
      end

      if (direct_reset_case == "all" || direct_reset_case == "linkreset") begin
        // Reset -> LinkReset -> Reset.
        reset_and_initialize(1'b0);
        fdi_lp_state_req = PhyStateReq_nop;
        step(2);
        fdi_lp_state_req = PhyStateReq_linkReset;

        saw_adapter = 1'b0;
        saw_rdi = 1'b0;
        packets = 0;
        while (!(saw_adapter && saw_rdi) && packets < 4) begin
          take_tx_message(header, payload, has_payload, 1000);
          if (header == LOCAL_ADAPTER_REQ_LINKRESET) saw_adapter = 1'b1;
          else if (header == LOCAL_RDI_REQ_LINKRESET) saw_rdi = 1'b1;
          else $fatal(1, "Unexpected Reset->LinkReset message 0x%016h", header);
          packets++;
        end
        if (!(saw_adapter && saw_rdi)) $fatal(1, "Reset->LinkReset requests incomplete");

        send_rx_message(REMOTE_RDI_RSP_LINKRESET, 64'b0, 1'b0, 1000);
        count = 0;
        while (debug_rdi_state != PhyState_linkReset && count < 300) begin step(1); count++; end
        send_rx_message(REMOTE_ADAPTER_RSP_LINKRESET, 64'b0, 1'b0, 1000);
        count = 0;
        while ((fdi_pl_state_sts != PhyState_linkReset || debug_rdi_state != PhyState_linkReset) && count < 500) begin
          step(1); count++;
        end
        if (count >= 500) $fatal(1, "Direct Reset->LinkReset did not complete");

        fdi_lp_state_req = PhyStateReq_active;
        count = 0;
        while ((fdi_pl_state_sts != PhyState_reset || debug_rdi_state != PhyState_reset) && count < 300) begin
          step(1); count++;
        end
        if (count >= 300) $fatal(1, "LinkReset->Reset did not complete");
      end

      if (direct_reset_case == "all" || direct_reset_case == "linkerror") begin
        // Reset -> LinkError.
        reset_and_initialize(1'b0);
        fdi_lp_linkerror = 1'b1;
        take_tx_message(header, payload, has_payload, 1000);
        if (header !== LOCAL_RDI_REQ_LINKERROR)
          $fatal(1, "Direct Reset->LinkError expected RDI request, got 0x%016h", header);
        send_rx_message(REMOTE_RDI_RSP_LINKERROR, 64'b0, 1'b0, 1000);

        count = 0;
        while ((fdi_pl_state_sts != PhyState_linkError || debug_rdi_state != PhyState_linkError) && count < 300) begin
          step(1); count++;
        end
        if (count >= 300) $fatal(1, "Direct Reset->LinkError did not complete");
      end
      finish_serial_exchange(direct_reset_case == "disabled" || direct_reset_case == "linkreset");
      $display("PASS: scenario_direct_reset_exits case=%s", direct_reset_case);
    end
  endtask

  initial begin : run_tests
    string scenario;
    if (!$value$plusargs("SCENARIO=%s", scenario))
      scenario = "all";

    if ($test$plusargs("VCD")) begin
      $dumpfile("D2DAdapterLinkMgmtTopIntegrated128Spec_tb.vcd");
      $dumpvars(0, D2DAdapterLinkMgmtTopIntegrated128Spec_tb);
    end

    // Give every input a defined value before the first asynchronous reset.
    fdi_lp_state_req = PhyStateReq_nop;
    fdi_lp_linkerror = 1'b0;
    fdi_lp_rx_active_sts = 1'b0;
    fdi_lp_wake_req = 1'b0;
    fdi_lp_clk_ack = 1'b0;
    fdi_lp_stall_ack = 1'b0;
    ltsm_start = 1'b0;
    ltsm_stable_clk = 1'b0;
    ltsm_pll_locked = 1'b0;
    ltsm_stable_supply = 1'b0;
    manual_sideband_mode = 1'b0;
    bfm_received_ready = 1'b0;
    bfm_send_valid = 1'b0;
    bfm_send_msg = 128'b0;
    cycles_1us = 32'd1;
    reset_n = 1'b0;

    if (scenario == "all" || scenario == "retrain") scenario_retrain();
    if (scenario == "all" || scenario == "disabled") scenario_disabled();
    if (scenario == "all" || scenario == "linkreset") scenario_linkreset();
    if (scenario == "all" || scenario == "linkerror") scenario_linkerror();
    if (scenario == "all" || scenario == "direct_reset_exits") scenario_direct_reset_exits();

    if (scenario != "all" && scenario != "retrain" && scenario != "disabled" &&
        scenario != "linkreset" && scenario != "linkerror" &&
        scenario != "direct_reset_exits")
      $fatal(1, "Unknown +SCENARIO=%s", scenario);

    if (serial_error || serial_failure_seen)
      $fatal(1, "Serial wire/receive checker failed; scenario cannot pass");
    if (dut.local_out_completed == 0 || dut.local_in_completed == 0)
      $fatal(1, "No complete serialized traffic observed in both local directions");
    $display("PASS: D2DAdapterLinkMgmtTopIntegrated128Spec serial scenario=%s", scenario);
    $finish;
  end
endmodule

`default_nettype wire
```

## [64] test\DllPiEncodingSpec_tb.sv

```systemverilog
// FILE_INDEX: 64
// FILE_PATH : test\DllPiEncodingSpec_tb.sv

`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

// Self-contained contract test; no absent analog reference RTL is required.
// Check the physical mux coordinates and weighted switch banks independently
// of the production encoder's thermometer loop. The original optional
// comparison with dll_pi_control is retained under test/reference/.
module DllPiEncodingSpec_tb;
  logic [37:0] seen [0:263];
  logic clock = 1'b0;
  always #5 clock = ~clock;
  logic reset_n = 1'b0;
  logic [8:0] phase_index = '0;
  wire [37:0] pipeline_code;
  wire [8:0] pipeline_index;
  wire pipeline_valid;
  logic expected_valid = 1'b0;
  logic [8:0] expected_index = '0;
  logic [511:0] pipeline_seen = '0;
  int pipeline_checks = 0;

  MBTrain_DllPiEncoder pipeline (
    .clock(clock), .reset_n(reset_n), .phase_index(phase_index),
    .phase_code(pipeline_code), .phase_index_out(pipeline_index),
    .valid(pipeline_valid)
  );

  // The input crosses two register boundaries: stage 2 must publish the
  // previous rising edge's index, including its unchanged invalid-index tag.
  // Changing the requested index every cycle catches stale/bank/tag mixtures.
  always @(posedge clock) begin
    if (!reset_n) begin
      expected_valid = 1'b0;
      expected_index = '0;
      #1;
      if (pipeline_valid !== 1'b0 || pipeline_code !== 38'h00001ffff0)
        $fatal(1, "DLL/PI pipeline reset did not clear valid and select phase zero");
    end else begin
      #1;
      if (pipeline_valid !== expected_valid)
        $fatal(1, "DLL/PI pipeline valid latency mismatch");
      if (expected_valid) begin
        if (pipeline_index !== expected_index ||
            pipeline_code !== LtsmParameters_pkg::encode_d2c_phase(expected_index))
          $fatal(1, "DLL/PI pipeline code/tag mismatch expected=%0d actual=%0d code=%h",
            expected_index, pipeline_index, pipeline_code);
        pipeline_seen[expected_index] = 1'b1;
        pipeline_checks++;
      end
      expected_valid = 1'b1;
      expected_index = phase_index;
    end
  end

  task automatic drive_index(input int index);
    @(negedge clock);
    phase_index = 9'(index);
  endtask

  function automatic int weight(input logic [16:0] bank);
    return int'(bank[0]) + 2*$countones(bank[16:1]);
  endfunction

  function automatic bit thermometer(input logic [15:0] bits);
    // Legal coarse masks are zero or a contiguous run of ones at the LSB.
    return (bits & (bits + 16'd1)) == 0;
  endfunction

  initial begin
    logic [37:0] code;
    logic [16:0] upper, lower;
    int sec, step, upper_coordinate, lower_coordinate, physical_phase;
    if (LtsmParameters_pkg::DEFAULT_D2C_PI_CODE_WIDTH != 38)
      $fatal(1, "DLL/PI physical word must have 38 bits");
    for (int phase = 0; phase < 264; phase++) begin
      sec = phase / 33;
      step = phase % 33;
      code = LtsmParameters_pkg::encode_d2c_phase(9'(phase));
      upper = code[20:4];
      lower = code[37:21];
      if (lower !== ~upper || weight(lower) + weight(upper) != 33)
        $fatal(1, "Bank complement/weight mismatch at phase %0d", phase);
      if (code[1:0] != 2'((sec+1)/2) || code[3:2] != 2'(sec/2))
        $fatal(1, "Wrong clock source at phase %0d", phase);
      if (sec % 2) begin
        if (!thermometer(upper[16:1]) || weight(upper) != step)
          $fatal(1, "Odd-sector switch ordering/weight mismatch at %0d", phase);
      end else if (!thermometer(lower[16:1]) || weight(lower) != step)
        $fatal(1, "Even-sector switch ordering/weight mismatch at %0d", phase);
      upper_coordinate = int'(code[1:0])*66;
      lower_coordinate = int'(code[3:2])*66 + 33;
      if (code[1:0] == 0 && code[3:2] == 3) upper_coordinate = 264;
      physical_phase = ((upper_coordinate*weight(upper) +
                         lower_coordinate*weight(lower))/33) % 264;
      if (physical_phase != phase)
        $fatal(1, "Decoded phase mismatch: requested=%0d decoded=%0d", phase, physical_phase);
      for (int previous = 0; previous < phase; previous++)
        if (code === seen[previous]) $fatal(1, "Duplicate phases %0d/%0d", previous, phase);
      seen[phase] = code;
    end
    // Literal phase-zero controls: all upper switches on, both muxes zero.
    for (int invalid_phase = 264; invalid_phase < 512; invalid_phase++)
      if (LtsmParameters_pkg::encode_d2c_phase(9'(invalid_phase)) !== 38'h00001ffff0)
        $fatal(1, "Invalid phase %0d did not select phase zero", invalid_phase);
    @(negedge clock);
    reset_n = 1'b1;
    for (int index = 0; index < 512; index++) drive_index(index);
    repeat (2) @(negedge clock);
    if (pipeline_seen !== '1)
      $fatal(1, "DLL/PI pipeline did not exercise all 512 input indices");

    // Abort a partially filled pipeline, then cross multiple sector boundaries
    // in consecutive cycles to verify fresh tags after reset release.
    drive_index(263);
    drive_index(17);
    #2 reset_n = 1'b0;
    #1;
    if (pipeline_valid !== 1'b0 || pipeline_code !== 38'h00001ffff0)
      $fatal(1, "DLL/PI pipeline asynchronous reset did not discard in-flight output");
    repeat (2) @(negedge clock);
    reset_n = 1'b1;
    phase_index = 9'd33;
    drive_index(263);
    drive_index(66);
    drive_index(511);
    drive_index(0);
    repeat (2) @(negedge clock);
    $display("PASS DllPiEncodingSpec_tb: 264 unique physical phases, 248 invalid-index fallbacks, %0d pipelined code/tag checks and reset",pipeline_checks);
    $finish;
  end
endmodule

`default_nettype wire
```

## [65] test\DllPiSweepSpec_tb.sv

```systemverilog
// FILE_INDEX: 65
// FILE_PATH : test\DllPiSweepSpec_tb.sv

`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

module DllPiSweepSpec_tb;
  logic clock = 0;
  always #5 clock = ~clock;
  logic reset_n = 0, start = 0;
  wire busy [0:2], done [0:2], error [0:2], apply_phase [0:2], point_start [0:2];
  logic phase_applied [0:2], point_done [0:2], valid_pass [0:2], cumulative_pass [0:2];
  logic [63:0] lane_pass [0:2];
  wire [37:0] phase_code [0:2], final_code [0:2];
  wire [37:0] left_code [1:2], right_code [1:2];
  wire [15:0] retries [0:2], failed [0:2];
  wire [4:0] state1;
  wire [3:0] state2, statev;
  wire apply_deskew;
  logic deskew_applied;
  wire [1279:0] deskew_codes;
  MBTrain_DataTrainCenter1SweepEngine center1 (
    .clock(clock),.reset_n(reset_n),.start(start),
    .busy(busy[0]),.done(done[0]),.trainError(error[0]),
    .apply_tx_clock_phase(apply_phase[0]),.tx_clock_phase_code(phase_code[0]),
    .tx_clock_phase_applied(phase_applied[0]),.apply_tx_lane_deskew(apply_deskew),
    .tx_lane_deskew_codes(deskew_codes),.tx_lane_deskew_applied(deskew_applied),
    .point_test_start(point_start[0]),.point_test_done(point_done[0]),
    .point_test_lane_pass(lane_pass[0]),.point_test_valid_pass(valid_pass[0]),
    .point_test_cumulative_pass(cumulative_pass[0]),.state(state1),
    .lastFailedComparisons(failed[0]),.retryCount(retries[0]),.finalClockPhase(final_code[0])
  );
  MBTrain_DataTrainCenter2SweepEngine center2 (
    .clock(clock),.reset_n(reset_n),.start(start),
    .busy(busy[1]),.done(done[1]),.trainError(error[1]),
    .apply_tx_clock_phase(apply_phase[1]),.tx_clock_phase_code(phase_code[1]),
    .tx_clock_phase_applied(phase_applied[1]),
    .point_test_start(point_start[1]),.point_test_done(point_done[1]),
    .point_test_lane_pass(lane_pass[1]),.point_test_valid_pass(valid_pass[1]),
    .point_test_cumulative_pass(cumulative_pass[1]),.state(state2),
    .lastFailedComparisons(failed[1]),.retryCount(retries[1]),.finalClockPhase(final_code[1]),
    .globalLeftPhase(left_code[1]),.globalRightPhase(right_code[1])
  );
  MBTrain_ValTrainCenterSweepEngine valid_center (
    .clock(clock),.reset_n(reset_n),.start(start),
    .busy(busy[2]),.done(done[2]),.trainError(error[2]),
    .apply_tx_clock_phase(apply_phase[2]),.tx_clock_phase_code(phase_code[2]),
    .tx_clock_phase_applied(phase_applied[2]),
    .point_test_start(point_start[2]),.point_test_done(point_done[2]),
    .point_test_valid_pass(valid_pass[2]),.state(statev),
    .lastFailedComparisons(failed[2]),.retryCount(retries[2]),.finalClockPhase(final_code[2]),
    .validLeftPhase(left_code[2]),.validRightPhase(right_code[2])
  );

  // Independent reference based on switch weights, not the package encoder.
  function automatic logic [37:0] expected_phase(input int phase);
    int sec, step;
    logic [16:0] later, upper;
    logic [1:0] lower_mux, upper_mux;
    sec=phase/33; step=phase%33;
    later='0; later[0]=1'(step%2);
    for(int sw=0;sw<16;sw++) later[sw+1]=(sw<step/2);
    upper=sec%2 ? later : ~later;
    lower_mux=2'(sec/2); upper_mux=2'((sec+1)/2);
    return {~upper,upper,lower_mux,upper_mux};
  endfunction

  function automatic int decode(input logic [37:0] word);
    for(int phase=0;phase<264;phase++)
      if(word === expected_phase(phase)) return phase;
    $fatal(1,"Illegal DLL/PI word %h",word);
    return -1;
  endfunction

  function automatic logic [19:0] expected_deskew(input int half_steps);
    int first, second;
    logic [19:0] result;
    first=half_steps>19 ? 19 : half_steps;
    second=half_steps>19 ? half_steps-19 : 0;
    result='0; result[0]=1'(first%2); result[10]=1'(second%2);
    for(int sw=0;sw<9;sw++) begin
      result[1+sw]=sw<first/2;
      result[11+sw]=sw<second/2;
    end
    return result;
  endfunction

  function automatic bit pass_at(input int scenario, input int phase);
    case(scenario)
      0: return 1;
      1: return (phase>=30 && phase<=35)||(phase>=80 && phase<=85);
      2: return 0;
      3,6: return phase>=180 && phase<=189;
      4: return phase<=2 || phase>=260;
      5: return phase==263;
      default: return 0;
    endcase
  endfunction

  function automatic int expected_selected_phase(input int scenario);
    case (scenario)
      0: return 131;
      1: return 32;
      3, 6: return 184;
      4: return 261;
      5: return 263;
      default: return -1;
    endcase
  endfunction

  task automatic run_scenario(input int scenario);
    int wait_apply[0:2], wait_point[0:2], sweep_count[0:2], final_count[0:2];
    int point_count[0:2];
    int early_ack_count[0:2];
    int initial_count, verify_count, deskew_count, deskew_wait, cycles, phase;
    int expected_center, expected_left, expected_right, expected_sweeps;
    bit is_initial, is_verify, is_final, in_wait;
    logic [37:0] held_phase[0:2];
    logic [37:0] last_applied_phase[0:2];
    logic [1279:0] held_deskew;
    @(negedge clock);
    reset_n=0; start=0; deskew_applied=0;
    initial_count=0; verify_count=0; deskew_count=0; deskew_wait=0; cycles=0;
    for(int engine=0;engine<3;engine++) begin
      phase_applied[engine]=0; point_done[engine]=0;
      valid_pass[engine]=0; cumulative_pass[engine]=0; lane_pass[engine]='0;
      wait_apply[engine]=0; wait_point[engine]=0;
      sweep_count[engine]=0; final_count[engine]=0;
      point_count[engine]=0; last_applied_phase[engine]='0;
      early_ack_count[engine]=0;
    end
    @(negedge clock);
    reset_n=1; start=1;
    @(negedge clock);
    start=0;
    while(!((done[0]||error[0])&&(done[1]||error[1])&&(done[2]||error[2]))) begin
      if(++cycles>20000) $fatal(1,"Scenario %0d timeout states=%0d/%0d/%0d",scenario,state1,state2,statev);
      deskew_applied=0;
      if(apply_deskew) begin
        if(deskew_wait==0) held_deskew=deskew_codes;
        if(deskew_codes!==held_deskew) $fatal(1,"Deskew changed under backpressure");
        deskew_wait++;
        if(deskew_wait==3) begin
          deskew_applied=1; deskew_count++;
          for(int lane=0;lane<64;lane++) begin
            int delay;
            delay=(scenario==3 && state1==7 && lane<16) ? 3-lane%4 : 0;
            if(deskew_codes[lane*20+:20]!==expected_deskew(delay))
              $fatal(1,"TX deskew incorrect lane=%0d delay=%0d word=%h",lane,delay,deskew_codes[lane*20+:20]);
          end
        end
      end else deskew_wait=0;
      for(int engine=0;engine<3;engine++) begin
        phase_applied[engine]=0;
        // Scenario 5 holds an old/high analog acknowledge through decoder
        // preparation. The FSM must ignore it until a valid apply is issued.
        if (scenario==5 && !apply_phase[engine] &&
            (engine==0 ? (state1==2||state1==9||state1==14) :
             (engine==1 ? (state2==1||state2==6) : (statev==1||statev==6)))) begin
          phase_applied[engine]=1;
          early_ack_count[engine]++;
        end
        if(apply_phase[engine]) begin
          if(wait_apply[engine]==0) held_phase[engine]=phase_code[engine];
          if(phase_code[engine]!==held_phase[engine]) $fatal(1,"PI changed under backpressure engine=%0d",engine);
          wait_apply[engine]++;
          // Vary acknowledgement latency, including the first apply cycle.
          // These checks do not prescribe the decoder preparation latency.
          if(wait_apply[engine]==(scenario==5 ? 1 : 1+(sweep_count[engine]+engine+scenario)%5)) begin
            phase_applied[engine]=1;
            phase=decode(phase_code[engine]);
            last_applied_phase[engine]=phase_code[engine];
            is_initial=engine==0 && state1==2;
            is_verify=engine==0 && state1==9;
            is_final=engine==0 ? state1==14 : (engine==1 ? state2==6 : statev==6);
            if(is_final) begin
              final_count[engine]++;
              if (phase != expected_selected_phase(scenario) ||
                  phase_code[engine] !== final_code[engine])
                $fatal(1,"Stale/wrong final phase applied scenario=%0d engine=%0d got=%0d final_code=%h",
                  scenario,engine,phase,final_code[engine]);
            end
            else begin
              if(phase!=sweep_count[engine]%264) $fatal(1,"Skipped/duplicated phase engine=%0d got=%0d count=%0d",engine,phase,sweep_count[engine]);
              sweep_count[engine]++;
              if(is_initial) initial_count++;
              if(is_verify) verify_count++;
            end
          end
        end else wait_apply[engine]=0;
        in_wait=engine==0 ? (state1==4||state1==11||state1==16) :
          (engine==1 ? (state2==3||state2==8) : (statev==3||statev==8));
        if (point_start[engine]) begin
          point_count[engine]++;
          if (point_count[engine] != sweep_count[engine]+final_count[engine] ||
              phase_code[engine] !== last_applied_phase[engine])
            $fatal(1,"Point test did not start with exactly one acknowledged phase engine=%0d",engine);
        end
        point_done[engine]=0;
        if(in_wait) begin
          if (phase_code[engine] !== last_applied_phase[engine])
            $fatal(1,"PI changed during point-test wait engine=%0d",engine);
          wait_point[engine]++;
          phase=decode(phase_code[engine]);
          is_initial=engine==0 && state1==4;
          is_final=engine==0 ? state1==16 : (engine==1 ? state2==8 : statev==8);
          valid_pass[engine]=is_initial ? 1 : pass_at(scenario,phase);
          cumulative_pass[engine]=valid_pass[engine];
          lane_pass[engine]='0;
          for(int lane=0;lane<16;lane++) begin
            if(is_initial && scenario==3)
              lane_pass[engine][lane]=(phase>=120+lane%4 && phase<=129+lane%4);
            else if(is_initial && scenario==6)
              lane_pass[engine][lane]=phase==(lane==0 ? 0 : 100);
            else lane_pass[engine][lane]=pass_at(scenario,phase);
          end
          if(is_final && scenario==3 && retries[engine]==0) begin
            valid_pass[engine]=0; cumulative_pass[engine]=0; lane_pass[engine]='0;
          end
          if(wait_point[engine]==1+(point_count[engine]+engine+scenario)%3) point_done[engine]=1;
        end else wait_point[engine]=0;
      end
      @(negedge clock);
    end
    deskew_applied=0;
    for(int engine=0;engine<3;engine++) begin
      phase_applied[engine]=0; point_done[engine]=0;
      if (point_count[engine] != sweep_count[engine]+final_count[engine])
        $fatal(1,"Applied phase / point-test count mismatch engine=%0d",engine);
      if (scenario==5 && early_ack_count[engine]==0)
        $fatal(1,"Decoder-wait early acknowledge was not exercised engine=%0d",engine);
      if(scenario==2 || (scenario==6 && engine==0)) begin
        if(!error[engine] || done[engine] || retries[engine]!=1 ||
           sweep_count[engine]!=528 || final_count[engine]!=0)
          $fatal(1,"Failure/retry handling mismatch scenario=%0d engine=%0d",scenario,engine);
      end else begin
        case(scenario)
          0: begin expected_center=131; expected_left=0; expected_right=263; end
          1: begin expected_center=32; expected_left=30; expected_right=35; end
          3,6: begin expected_center=184; expected_left=180; expected_right=189; end
          4: begin expected_center=261; expected_left=260; expected_right=263; end
          default: begin expected_center=263; expected_left=263; expected_right=263; end
        endcase
        expected_sweeps=(engine==0 ? 528 : 264)*(scenario==3 ? 2 : 1);
        if(!done[engine] || error[engine] || retries[engine]!=(scenario==3 ? 1 : 0) ||
           final_code[engine]!==expected_phase(expected_center) ||
           sweep_count[engine]!=expected_sweeps || final_count[engine]!=(scenario==3 ? 2 : 1))
          $fatal(1,"Selection/count mismatch scenario=%0d engine=%0d code=%h sweeps=%0d final=%0d",scenario,engine,final_code[engine],sweep_count[engine],final_count[engine]);
        if(engine>0 && (left_code[engine]!==expected_phase(expected_left) ||
           right_code[engine]!==expected_phase(expected_right))) $fatal(1,"Encoded window endpoints mismatch");
      end
    end
    if(scenario==2 || scenario==6) begin
      if(initial_count!=528 || verify_count!=0 || deskew_count!=2)
        $fatal(1,"Center1 invalid-window/overflow applied deskew or verify");
    end else if(initial_count!=(scenario==3 ? 528 : 264) ||
                verify_count!=initial_count || deskew_count!=(scenario==3 ? 4 : 2))
      $fatal(1,"Center1 initial/verify/deskew coverage incomplete");
    $display("PASS DLL/PI sweep scenario %0d: Center1/Center2/ValTrainCenter",scenario);
  endtask

  initial begin
    for(int scenario=0;scenario<7;scenario++) run_scenario(scenario);
    $display("PASS DllPiSweepSpec_tb: 7 scenarios, ordered 264-phase sweeps, stable acknowledged codes, final selection, varied handshake stalls");
    $finish;
  end
endmodule

`default_nettype wire
```

<a id="test-JtagSnapshotSpec_tb-sv"></a>

## [66] test\JtagSnapshotSpec_tb.sv

```systemverilog
// FILE_INDEX: 66
// FILE_PATH : test\JtagSnapshotSpec_tb.sv

`timescale 1ns/1ps

// Standalone mailbox regression. The system TAP/scan sequencing is exercised
// separately; these directed cases target clock-domain and reset boundaries.
module JtagSnapshotSpec_tb;
  localparam int DATA_W = 8;
  localparam logic [DATA_W-1:0] RESET_VALUE = 8'ha6;
  logic clk = 1'b0;
  logic run_clk = 1'b1;
  logic nRst = 1'b0;
  logic jtag_nRst = 1'b0;
  logic tdr_tck = 1'b0;
  logic tdr_rst = 1'b0;
  logic tdr_tdi = 1'b0;
  logic tdr_capture = 1'b0;
  logic tdr_shift = 1'b0;
  logic tdr_update = 1'b0;
  logic sel = 1'b1;
  logic tdo;
  logic [DATA_W-1:0] data_in, data_out;
  logic data_out_valid;
  logic [DATA_W-1:0] sensor = 8'h5a;
  integer write_count = 0;
  integer tck_half_ns = 2;
  initial begin
    if ($value$plusargs("TCK_HALF_NS=%d", tck_half_ns)) begin end
    if (tck_half_ns < 1) $fatal(1, "TCK_HALF_NS must be positive");
  end
  logic previous_valid = 1'b0;

  always #5 if (run_clk) clk = ~clk;
  assign data_in = data_out ^ sensor;

  jtag_tdr_snapshot #(.DATA_W(DATA_W), .RESET_VALUE(RESET_VALUE)) dut (.*);

  always @(posedge clk or negedge nRst or negedge jtag_nRst) begin
    if (!nRst || !jtag_nRst) begin
      previous_valid = 1'b0;
    end else begin
      if (data_out_valid) begin
        if (previous_valid) $fatal(1, "write-valid lasted more than one core cycle");
        write_count = write_count + 1;
      end
      previous_valid = data_out_valid;
    end
  end

  task automatic tick(input bit cap, input bit shift, input bit upd, input bit di);
    tdr_capture = cap;
    tdr_shift = shift;
    tdr_update = upd;
    tdr_tdi = di;
    #(tck_half_ns);
    tdr_tck = 1'b1;
    #1;
    tdr_tck = 1'b0;
    #(tck_half_ns);
    tdr_capture = 1'b0;
    tdr_shift = 1'b0;
    tdr_update = 1'b0;
  endtask

  task automatic idle(input int cycles);
    repeat (cycles) tick(0, 0, 0, 0);
  endtask

  task automatic scan(input logic [DATA_W:0] tx,
                      output logic [DATA_W:0] rx,
                      input bit do_update = 1'b1);
    tick(1, 0, 0, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i <= DATA_W; i++) begin
      rx[i] = tdo;
      tick(0, 1, 0, tx[i]);
    end
    tick(0, 0, do_update, 0);
  endtask

  task automatic complete;
    int limit;
    limit = 0;
    while (dut.busy && limit < 200) begin
      idle(1);
      limit++;
    end
    if (dut.busy) $fatal(1, "mailbox did not complete");
    idle(2); // Also consume the synchronized acknowledge edge.
  endtask

  task automatic write_word(input logic [DATA_W-1:0] value);
    logic [DATA_W:0] ignored;
    scan({value, 1'b1}, ignored);
    complete();
  endtask

  task automatic check_snapshot(input logic [DATA_W-1:0] expected);
    logic [DATA_W:0] rx;
    scan('0, rx, 1'b0);
    if (rx !== {expected, 1'b0})
      $fatal(1, "snapshot: expected %h, got %h", {expected, 1'b0}, rx);
  endtask

  task automatic functional_reset;
    @(negedge clk);
    #1 nRst = 1'b0;
    idle(4);
    nRst = 1'b1;
    idle(20);
  endtask

  task automatic stop_core;
    @(negedge clk);
    run_clk = 1'b0;
  endtask

  initial begin : regression
    logic [DATA_W:0] rx;
    logic [DATA_W-1:0] retained;
    integer count_before;
    #21;
    nRst = 1'b1;
    jtag_nRst = 1'b1;
    idle(3);
    if (data_out !== RESET_VALUE) $fatal(1, "incorrect reset value");

    count_before = write_count;
    write_word(8'h3c);
    if (data_out !== 8'h3c || write_count != count_before + 1)
      $fatal(1, "write did not apply exactly once");
    check_snapshot(8'h3c ^ sensor);

    sensor = 8'h96;
    count_before = write_count;
    scan('0, rx); // Read-only Update-DR launches a fresh snapshot.
    complete();
    check_snapshot(8'h3c ^ sensor);
    if (write_count != count_before || data_out !== 8'h3c)
      $fatal(1, "read-only transaction wrote control data");

    // Deselected capture/shift/update must not touch this TDR.
    idle(2);
    sel = 1'b0;
    scan({8'hff, 1'b1}, rx);
    idle(20);
    if (dut.busy || data_out !== 8'h3c || write_count != count_before)
      $fatal(1, "deselected TDR accepted a transaction");
    sel = 1'b1;

    // Both completed request parities must survive an IP-only reset without
    // replay. The original RTL replayed the last write for parity one.
    for (int parity = 1; parity <= 2; parity++) begin
      functional_reset();
      for (int j = 0; j < parity; j++) write_word(8'h20 + 8'(j));
      if (dut.req_toggle_q !== 1'(parity)) $fatal(1, "wrong test parity");
      count_before = write_count;
      functional_reset();
      if (data_out !== RESET_VALUE || write_count != count_before || dut.busy)
        $fatal(1, "IP-only reset replayed a completed write (parity %0d)", parity);
    end

    // TRST resets mailbox state, preserving already committed control data.
    for (int parity = 1; parity <= 2; parity++) begin
      functional_reset();
      for (int j = 0; j < parity; j++) write_word(8'h40 + 8'(j));
      retained = data_out;
      count_before = write_count;
      #1 jtag_nRst = 1'b0;
      idle(4);
      jtag_nRst = 1'b1;
      idle(20);
      if (data_out !== retained || write_count != count_before || dut.busy)
        $fatal(1, "TRST corrupted/replayed committed control (parity %0d)", parity);
    end

    // A stopped IP clock makes busy deterministic even with many scan clocks.
    // TLR must neither cancel nor replay the accepted transaction. The second
    // Update-DR occurs while busy and must be ignored (one warning expected).
    stop_core();
    count_before = write_count;
    scan({8'ha5, 1'b1}, rx);
    if (!dut.busy) $fatal(1, "expected pending write with stopped IP clock");
    tdr_rst = 1'b1;
    idle(3);
    tick(0, 0, 1, 0); // TLR suppresses even a malformed update request.
    if (!dut.busy) $fatal(1, "TLR discarded the pending handshake");
    tdr_rst = 1'b0;
    scan({8'hb4, 1'b1}, rx);
    if (!rx[0]) $fatal(1, "Capture-DR did not report busy");
    run_clk = 1'b1;
    // Keep TLR asserted while the original request finishes in the core.
    tdr_rst = 1'b1;
    idle(20);
    tdr_rst = 1'b0;
    complete();
    if (data_out !== 8'ha5 || write_count != count_before + 1)
      $fatal(1, "TLR/busy handling duplicated or replaced the original write");
    check_snapshot(8'ha5 ^ sensor);

    // TRST cancels an uncommitted request without affecting committed data.
    stop_core();
    retained = data_out;
    count_before = write_count;
    scan({8'hc3, 1'b1}, rx);
    #1 jtag_nRst = 1'b0;
    idle(4);
    jtag_nRst = 1'b1;
    run_clk = 1'b1;
    idle(20);
    if (data_out !== retained || write_count != count_before || dut.busy)
      $fatal(1, "TRST failed to cancel an uncommitted write");

    // IP reset cancels a pending request and restores the reset value.
    stop_core();
    count_before = write_count;
    scan({8'hd2, 1'b1}, rx);
    #1 nRst = 1'b0;
    idle(4);
    nRst = 1'b1;
    run_clk = 1'b1;
    idle(20);
    if (data_out !== RESET_VALUE || write_count != count_before || dut.busy)
      $fatal(1, "IP reset failed to cancel a pending write");

    // Stop TCK after Update-DR, let the IP acknowledge, then bring the
    // acknowledgement through exactly two synchronizer clocks. Capture on
    // the acknowledge-edge cycle must get the NEW snapshot, not rd_data_q.
    count_before = write_count;
    scan({8'h1d, 1'b1}, rx);
    repeat (8) @(posedge clk);
    #1;
    idle(2);
    if (!dut.ack_edge) $fatal(1, "test did not align Capture with acknowledge edge");
    check_snapshot(8'h1d ^ sensor);
    if (write_count != count_before + 1)
      $fatal(1, "acknowledge coincidence test changed write count");

    $display("PASS JtagSnapshotSpec_tb (TCK period %0d ns, core period 10 ns): snapshots, write pulses, busy, TLR, independent resets, acknowledge coincidence", 2*tck_half_ns+1);
    $finish;
  end

  initial begin
    #100000;
    $fatal(1, "JtagSnapshotSpec_tb timeout");
  end
endmodule
```

```systemverilog
// FILE_INDEX: 67
// FILE_PATH : test\JtagTapIntegrationSpec_tb.sv

`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

// Integration fixture, NOT a production SoC bridge:
// - supplied TAP RTL and the actual uploaded jtag_cfg_pkg instruction constants;
// - actual UcieDigitalTopJtag and its TDRs (the phy bank is selected and its
//   mode decoded here; UcieDigitalTopJtagPhyModeSpec_tb scans its data);
// - bank_select below supplies the missing six-bank decoder/TDO mux in the TB.
// A real system must supply that decoder/opcode allocation; the attached TAP
// alone cannot address all six wrapper registers.
// The wide snapshots are injected at each TDR's data_in boundary. This checks
// every serialized bit and clock-domain transaction, not analog training.
// New speed fields are additionally scanned through the actual top-level muxes,
// with only the aggregate LTSM status outputs forced for wiring coverage.
module JtagTapIntegrationSpec_tb;
  import jtag_cfg_pkg::*;
  localparam int MAX_DR_W = 2863;
  logic clock = 0;
  always #3 clock = ~clock;
  logic reset_n = 0, jtag_nRst = 0;
  logic tck = 0, tms = 1, tdi = 0;
  wire tdo, tdo_en;
  wire tdr_rst, tdr_tck, tdr_tdi, tdr_capture, tdr_shift, tdr_update;
  wire snap_sel, step_sel, dtmcs_sel, dmi_sel;

  logic [2556:0] dig_live;
  logic [179:0] fdi_live;
  logic [173:0] rdi_live;
  logic [2861:0] ltsm_live;
  logic [MAX_DR_W-1:0] tx, rx, ignored, expected_dr;
  logic [2556:0] held_dig;
  logic [179:0] held_fdi;
  logic [173:0] held_rdi;
  logic [2861:0] held_ltsm;
  logic sample_bit;
  int checks = 0;
  logic [1:0] speed_live = 2'b0;
  logic speed_apply_live = 1'b0, speed_idle_live = 1'b0;

  always_comb begin
    case (bank_select)
      0: selected_tdo = tdo_ctrl;
      1: selected_tdo = tdo_dig;
      2: selected_tdo = tdo_fdi;
      3: selected_tdo = tdo_rdi;

    .dtmcs_sel(dtmcs_sel), .dtmcs_tdo(1'b0),
    .dmi_sel(dmi_sel), .dmi_tdo(1'b0),
    .tdr_snap_sel(snap_sel), .tdr_snap_tdo(selected_tdo),
    .tdr_step_sel(step_sel), .tdr_step_tdo(1'b0)
  );
  UcieDigitalTopJtag dut (
    .jtag_nRst(jtag_nRst),
    .tdr_rst(tdr_rst),
    .tdr_tck(tdr_tck),
    .tdr_tdi(tdr_tdi),
    .tdr_capture(tdr_capture),
    .tdr_shift(tdr_shift),
    .tdr_update(tdr_update),
    .sel_ctrl((snap_sel && bank_select==3'd0)),
    .sel_dig((snap_sel && bank_select==3'd1)),

    .fdi_lp_linkerror('0),
    .fdi_lp_rx_active_sts('0),
    .fdi_lp_wake_req('0),
    .fdi_lp_clk_ack('0),
    .fdi_lp_stall_ack('0),
    .timeout_disable('0),
    .cycles_1us('0),
    .ltsm_start('0),
    .ltsm_linkSpeed_requestedSpeed(2'd3),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_linkSpeed_speedApplied(1'b0),
    .ltsm_stable_clk('0),
    .ltsm_pll_locked('0),
    .ltsm_stable_supply('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_ReadyToExchangeClkPatterns('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_FinishedClkPatterns('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_FinishedValTrainPattern('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_ReversalMbFinishedLaneIDPattern('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_RepairMbFinishedLaneIDPattern('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_clkPatternReceivedRTRK_L('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_clkPatternReceivedRCKN_L('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_clkPatternReceivedRCKP_L('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_ValTrainPatternReceived('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_ReversalMbTrainPatternReceived0('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_ReversalMbTrainPatternReceived1('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_ReversalMbTrainPatternReceived2('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_ReversalMbTrainPatternReceived3('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_ReversalMbTrainPatternReceived4('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_ReversalMbTrainPatternReceived5('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_ReversalMbTrainPatternReceived6('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_ReversalMbTrainPatternReceived7('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_ReversalMbTrainPatternReceived8('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_ReversalMbTrainPatternReceived9('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_ReversalMbTrainPatternReceived10('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_ReversalMbTrainPatternReceived11('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_ReversalMbTrainPatternReceived12('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_ReversalMbTrainPatternReceived13('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_ReversalMbTrainPatternReceived14('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_ReversalMbTrainPatternReceived15('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_RepairMbDetectedLaneIDPattern0('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_RepairMbDetectedLaneIDPattern1('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_RepairMbDetectedLaneIDPattern2('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_RepairMbDetectedLaneIDPattern3('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_RepairMbDetectedLaneIDPattern4('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_RepairMbDetectedLaneIDPattern5('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_RepairMbDetectedLaneIDPattern6('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_RepairMbDetectedLaneIDPattern7('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_RepairMbDetectedLaneIDPattern8('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_RepairMbDetectedLaneIDPattern9('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_RepairMbDetectedLaneIDPattern10('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_RepairMbDetectedLaneIDPattern11('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_RepairMbDetectedLaneIDPattern12('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_RepairMbDetectedLaneIDPattern13('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_RepairMbDetectedLaneIDPattern14('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_RepairMbDetectedLaneIDPattern15('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_valVref_detectedValPattern('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_valVref_finishedPattern('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_valVref_rxVrefApplied('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_dataVref_detectedDataPattern('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_dataVref_finishedPattern('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_dataVref_rxVrefApplied('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_rxClkCal_done('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_d2cSender_valTrainPatternSent('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_d2cSender_txClockPhaseApplied('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_d2cReceiver_txInitD2CResultsMsgInfo('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_d2cReceiver_txInitD2CResultsPayload('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_d2cSender_lfsrPatternSent('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_d2cSender_txLaneDeskewApplied('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_rxDeskew_lfsrPatternSent('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_rxDeskew_rxLaneDeskewApplied('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_rxDeskew_detectedDataPattern('0),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_d2cReceiver_laneComparisonSuccessful('0),
    .sb_rx_din('0),
    .sb_rx_clk('0),
    .tdo_ctrl(tdo_ctrl),
    .tdo_dig(tdo_dig),
    .tdo_fdi(tdo_fdi),
    .tdo_rdi(tdo_rdi),
    .tdo_ltsm(tdo_ltsm),
    .tdo_phy(tdo_phy)
  );

  // Sample on the next rising edge; the TAP launches TDO on falling TCK.
  task automatic tick(input bit next_tms, input bit next_tdi, output bit out_bit);
    tms = next_tms;
    tdi = next_tdi;
    #7;
    out_bit = tdo;
    tck = 1;
    #7;
    tck = 0;
    #1;
  endtask
  task automatic idle(input int cycles);
    bit unused_bit;
    repeat(cycles) tick(0, 0, unused_bit);
  endtask
  task automatic select_ir(input logic [JTAG_IR_WIDTH-1:0] code);
    bit unused_bit;
    logic [JTAG_IR_WIDTH-1:0] captured;
    tick(1,0,unused_bit); // Select-DR
    tick(1,0,unused_bit); // Select-IR
    tick(0,0,unused_bit); // Capture-IR
    tick(0,0,unused_bit); // Shift-IR, capture occurs here
    for (int i=0; i<JTAG_IR_WIDTH; i++) begin
      if (!tdo_en) $fatal(1,"TDO must be enabled during Shift-IR");
      tick(i==JTAG_IR_WIDTH-1,code[i],captured[i]);
    end
    if (captured[1:0] !== 2'b01) $fatal(1,"IR capture signature");
    tick(1,0,unused_bit); // Update-IR
    tick(0,0,unused_bit); // Idle: commits IR in the supplied TAP
    checks++;
  endtask
  task automatic scan_dr(input int width,
                         input logic [MAX_DR_W-1:0] in_bits,
                         output logic [MAX_DR_W-1:0] out_bits);
    bit unused_bit;
    out_bits = '0;
    tick(1,0,unused_bit); // Select-DR
    tick(0,0,unused_bit); // Capture-DR
    tick(0,0,unused_bit); // Shift-DR, capture occurs here
    for (int i=0; i<width; i++) begin
      if (!tdo_en) $fatal(1,"TDO must be enabled during Shift-DR");
      tick(i==width-1,in_bits[i],out_bits[i]);
    end
    tick(1,0,unused_bit); // Update-DR
    tick(0,0,unused_bit); // Idle: commits DR in the supplied TAP
  endtask
  function automatic int dr_width(input int bank);
    case (bank)
      0: return 9;
      1: return 2558;
      2: return 181;
      3: return 175;
      4: return 2863;
      default: return 0;
    endcase
  endfunction
  function automatic logic [MAX_DR_W-1:0] pattern(input int seed);
    logic [31:0] lfsr;
    lfsr = 32'hb59d_1237 ^ (32'h0034_5991 * 32'(seed));
    for (int i=0; i<MAX_DR_W; i++) begin
      pattern[i] = lfsr[0];
      lfsr = {lfsr[30:0], lfsr[31]^lfsr[21]^lfsr[1]^lfsr[0]};
    end
  endfunction
  task automatic control_write(input logic [7:0] value);
    bank_select = 0;
    tx = '0;
    tx[8:0] = {value, 1'b1};
    scan_dr(9, tx, ignored);
    idle(12);
    if (dut.ctrl_q !== value) $fatal(1,"Control write failed");
    scan_dr(9, '0, rx);
    if (rx[8:0] !== {value, 1'b0}) $fatal(1,"Control snapshot/readback failed");
    idle(12);
    checks++;
  endtask

  // These offsets deliberately agree with the checked-in default host map.
  // They test actual serial field packing rather than forcing the input struct.
  task automatic speed_fields_scan(input int bank);
    int request_lsb, ack_lsb, code_lsb, apply_lsb, idle_lsb;
    logic [1:0] expected_speed;
    logic expected_apply, expected_idle;
    if (bank == 1) begin
      request_lsb=4; ack_lsb=3; code_lsb=83; apply_lsb=82; idle_lsb=81;
    end else begin
      request_lsb=2; ack_lsb=1; code_lsb=233; apply_lsb=232; idle_lsb=231;
    end
    control_write(8'(8+bank)); // digital=1 or LTSM=4; keep block reset asserted.
    for (int requested=0; requested<4; requested++) begin
      bank_select = 3'(bank);
      tx = '0;
      tx[0] = 1'b1;
      tx[request_lsb +: 2] = 2'(requested);
      tx[ack_lsb] = 1'(requested);
      expected_speed = 2'(3-requested);
      expected_apply = 1'(requested >> 1);
      expected_idle = 1'(requested);
      speed_live = expected_speed;
      speed_apply_live = expected_apply;
      speed_idle_live = expected_idle;
      scan_dr(dr_width(bank), tx, ignored);
      idle(12);
      if (dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm.linkSpeed_requestedSpeed !== 2'(requested) ||
          dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm.flagFromAnalog_linkSpeed_speedApplied !== 1'(requested))
        $fatal(1,"Serial requested-speed/ack field failed bank=%0d code=%0d",bank,requested);
      if (bank==1 && (dut.dig_in.ltsm_linkSpeed_requestedSpeed !== 2'(requested) ||
                     dut.dig_in.ltsm_flagFromAnalog_linkSpeed_speedApplied !== 1'(requested)))
        $fatal(1,"Digital speed fields are at the wrong scan offsets");
      if (bank==4 && (dut.ltsm_in.linkSpeed_requestedSpeed !== 2'(requested) ||
                     dut.ltsm_in.flagFromAnalog_linkSpeed_speedApplied !== 1'(requested)))
        $fatal(1,"LTSM speed fields are at the wrong scan offsets");
      // Read back a snapshot through real LTSM/Core/Top/packed-field routing.
      // Change live output first to prove the returned value was latched.
      speed_live = ~expected_speed;
      speed_apply_live = ~expected_apply;
      speed_idle_live = ~expected_idle;
      scan_dr(dr_width(bank), '0, rx);
      if (rx[0] || rx[code_lsb +: 2] !== expected_speed ||
          rx[apply_lsb] !== expected_apply || rx[idle_lsb] !== expected_idle)
        $fatal(1,"Serial selected-speed/apply/idle snapshot failed bank=%0d code=%0d",bank,requested);
      idle(12);
      checks++;
    end
  endtask

  initial begin
    dig_live = '0; fdi_live = '0; rdi_live = '0; ltsm_live = '0;
    held_dig = '0; held_fdi = '0; held_rdi = '0; held_ltsm = '0;
    // These force points isolate serializer coverage from PHY/training behavior.
    force dut.dig_data_in = dig_live;
    force dut.fdi_data_in = fdi_live;
    force dut.rdi_data_in = rdi_live;
    force dut.ltsm_data_in = ltsm_live;
    #12;
    reset_n = 1;
    jtag_nRst = 1;
    repeat (6) tick(1,0,sample_bit);
    tick(0,0,sample_bit); // Idle
    if (dut.CTRL_W+1!=9 || dut.DIG_W+1!=2558 || dut.FDI_W+1!=181 ||
        dut.RDI_W+1!=175 || dut.LTSM_W+1!=2863)
      $fatal(1,"Default scan lengths changed; update host map and test fixture");

    // Reset defaults to IDCODE; no IR selection is needed for this first scan.
    scan_dr(32, '0, rx);
    if (rx[31:0] !== JTAG_IDCODE_VALUE) $fatal(1,"IDCODE scan ordering/value");
    select_ir(BYPASS_1);
    tx = '0; tx[7:0] = 8'b10110010;
    scan_dr(8, tx, rx);
    if (rx[7:0] !== {tx[6:0],1'b0}) $fatal(1,"BYPASS one-bit latency");
    select_ir(TDR_SNAP);

    // Exercise all control modes while holding their selected block in reset.
    for (int mode=0; mode<=7; mode++) begin
      control_write(8'h08 | 8'(mode));
      if ({dut.u_top.testModePhy,dut.u_top.testModeLtsm,dut.u_top.testModeRdi,
           dut.u_top.testModeFdi,dut.u_top.testModeDigital} !==
          ((mode>=1 && mode<=5) ? (5'b1 << (mode-1)) : 5'b0))
        $fatal(1,"Mode decode is not mutually exclusive, mode=%0d",mode);
      if (dut.test_reset_n !== 0) $fatal(1,"Control reset not asserted");
    end
    control_write(8'h09); // digital test mode, core held reset for data scans

    // Every bank receives a distinct wide write. All snapshot bits (including
    // bit 19 of every widened control word and topmost DR bit) are exercised.
    for (int bank=1; bank<=4; bank++) begin
      bank_select = 3'(bank);
      tx = pattern(bank);
      tx[0] = 1;
      expected_dr = pattern(bank+17);
      expected_dr[0] = 0;
      case (bank)
        1: begin dig_live=expected_dr[2557:1]; held_dig=tx[2557:1]; end
        2: begin fdi_live=expected_dr[180:1]; held_fdi=tx[180:1]; end
        3: begin rdi_live=expected_dr[174:1]; held_rdi=tx[174:1]; end
        4: begin ltsm_live=expected_dr[2862:1]; held_ltsm=tx[2862:1]; end
      endcase
      scan_dr(dr_width(bank), tx, ignored);
      idle(12);
      if (dut.dig_data_out !== held_dig || dut.fdi_data_out !== held_fdi ||
          dut.rdi_data_out !== held_rdi || dut.ltsm_data_out !== held_ltsm ||
          dut.ctrl_q !== 8'h09)
        $fatal(1,"Selected write/other-bank isolation failed, bank=%0d",bank);
      // Change live data AFTER acknowledgement; the returned snapshot must
      // retain the prior transaction's value throughout the next long scan.
      dig_live = ~dig_live; fdi_live = ~fdi_live;
      rdi_live = ~rdi_live; ltsm_live = ~ltsm_live;
      scan_dr(dr_width(bank), '0, rx);
      for (int i=0; i<dr_width(bank); i++)
        if (rx[i] !== expected_dr[i])
          $fatal(1,"Snapshot/LSB-first serialization mismatch bank=%0d bit=%0d",bank,i);
      idle(12);
      // That read-only Update-DR snapshots the inverted live value. Checking
      // its response guarantees both 0 and 1 are tested at every data bit,
      // including the new high control-word bits and the topmost scan bit.
      expected_dr = ~expected_dr;
      expected_dr[0] = 0;
      scan_dr(dr_width(bank), '0, rx);
      for (int i=0; i<dr_width(bank); i++)
        if (rx[i] !== expected_dr[i])
          $fatal(1,"Complement snapshot mismatch bank=%0d bit=%0d",bank,i);
      idle(12);
      if (dut.dig_data_out !== held_dig || dut.fdi_data_out !== held_fdi ||
          dut.rdi_data_out !== held_rdi || dut.ltsm_data_out !== held_ltsm)
        $fatal(1,"Read-only scan modified a bank");
      checks++;
    end
    release dut.dig_data_in;
    release dut.ltsm_data_in;
    force dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm.flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_speedCode = speed_live;
    force dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm.flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_applySpeed = speed_apply_live;
    force dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm.flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_electricalIdle = speed_idle_live;
    speed_fields_scan(1);
    speed_fields_scan(4);
    release dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm.flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_speedCode;
    release dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm.flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_applySpeed;
    release dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm.flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_electricalIdle;
    control_write(8'h09); // select digital mode while still held in reset
    control_write(8'h01); // release core within same test mode
    if (!dut.test_reset_n) $fatal(1,"Control reset not released");
    control_write(8'h09);
    control_write(8'h08); // return to functional mode while reset selected
    if (tdo_en) $fatal(1,"TDO unexpectedly enabled in Idle");
    $display("PASS JtagTapIntegrationSpec_tb checks=%0d; actual TAP opcodes; test-only bank decoder",checks);
    $finish;
  end
  initial begin
    #2000000;
    $fatal(1,"JTAG integration watchdog");
  end
endmodule
`default_nettype wire
```

## [68] test\LinkSpeedSpec_tb.sv

```systemverilog
// FILE_INDEX: 68
// FILE_PATH : test\LinkSpeedSpec_tb.sv

`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

// Two real LINKSPEED peers, accepted-message transport with deliberate stalls,
// and independent analog lane results. This verifies protocol/cycle behavior;
// clocking a simulation at 800 MHz does not establish physical timing closure.
module LinkSpeedSpec_tb;
  import SidebandMsgGenerator_pkg::*;
  logic clock = 1'b0;
  always #0.625 clock = ~clock;
  logic reset_n = 1'b0, start = 1'b0;
  logic [31:0] cycles_1us = 32'd800;
  wire busy [0:1], done [0:1], train_error [0:1], retrain [0:1];
  wire degrade_exit [0:1];
  wire tx_valid [0:1], send_pattern [0:1];
  logic tx_ready [0:1];
  wire [127:0] tx_message [0:1];
  logic [127:0] wire_message [0:1];
  logic [15:0] lane_pass [0:1];
  logic [2:0] corrupt_mode [0:1];
  wire [15:0] last_errors [0:1];
  int cycle_count = 0;
  int pattern_cycles [0:1];
  int error_req_count [0:1], error_rsp_count [0:1];
  int done_req_count [0:1], done_rsp_count [0:1];
  int degrade_req_count [0:1], degrade_rsp_count [0:1];
  int degrade_req_hold [0:1], degrade_rsp_hold [0:1];
  logic block_all_tx = 1'b0, block_done_response = 1'b0;
  logic inject_stall = 1'b0;
  logic drop_degrade_response [0:1];
  int completed_scenarios = 0;
  localparam logic [127:0] RESULT_TEMPLATE =
    msgMbtrainTxInitD2CResultsResp(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY, 16'd0, 64'd0);

  for (genvar die = 0; die < 2; die++) begin : peer
    logic stalled;
    logic [127:0] held_message;
    wire accepted_result = tx_valid[1-die] && tx_ready[1-die] &&
      wire_message[1-die][61:56] == RESULT_TEMPLATE[61:56] &&
      wire_message[1-die][39:0] == RESULT_TEMPLATE[39:0];
    wire deliver_message = tx_valid[1-die] && tx_ready[1-die] &&
      !(drop_degrade_response[1-die] && wire_message[1-die] ==
        msgMbtrainLinkSpeedExitToSpeedDegradeResp(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY));
    MBTrain_LinkSpeed dut (
      .clock(clock), .reset_n(reset_n), .start(start), .cycles_1us(cycles_1us),
      .busy(busy[die]), .done(done[die]), .trainError(train_error[die]),
      .exitToSpeedDegrade(degrade_exit[die]),
      .flagToLtsm_phyInRetrain(retrain[die]),
      .sb_tx_ready(tx_ready[die]), .sb_tx_valid(tx_valid[die]),
      .sb_tx_din(tx_message[die]),
      .sb_rx_valid(inject_stall || deliver_message),
      .sb_rx_dout(inject_stall ? msgWithoutPayloadBase(16'hffff,8'hba,8'h19,
                    ENDPOINT_PHY,ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY) : wire_message[1-die]),
      .flagToAnalog_d2cSender_sendLfsrPattern(send_pattern[die]),
      .flagFromAnalog_d2cSender_lfsrPatternSent(pattern_cycles[die] >= 3),
      .flagFromAnalog_d2cReceiver_laneComparisonSuccessful(lane_pass[die]),
      .lastErrorCount(last_errors[die])
    );

    always_comb begin
      tx_ready[die] = !block_all_tx && (cycle_count % (7+die)) >= 3;
      if ((tx_message[die] == msgMbtrainLinkSpeedExitToSpeedDegradeReq(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY)) &&
          degrade_req_hold[die] < 5) tx_ready[die] = 1'b0;
      if ((tx_message[die] == msgMbtrainLinkSpeedExitToSpeedDegradeResp(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY)) &&
          degrade_rsp_hold[die] < 5) tx_ready[die] = 1'b0;
      if (block_done_response && tx_message[die] == msgMbtrainLinkSpeedDoneResp(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY))
        tx_ready[die] = 1'b0;
      wire_message[die] = tx_message[die];
      if (tx_message[die][61:56] == RESULT_TEMPLATE[61:56] &&
          tx_message[die][39:0] == RESULT_TEMPLATE[39:0]) begin
        case (corrupt_mode[die])
          1: wire_message[die][45] = 1'b0; // Invalid lane-result flag.
          2: wire_message[die][44] = 1'b0; // Failed summary with all lanes passing.
          3: wire_message[die][127] = 1'b1; // Reserved upper result bits set.
          4: wire_message[die][44] = 1'b1; // Passing summary cannot hide bad lanes.
          default: ;
        endcase
      end
    end

    always @(posedge clock) begin
      if (!reset_n) begin
        stalled <= 1'b0;
        held_message <= '0;
        pattern_cycles[die] <= 0;
        error_req_count[die] <= 0;
        error_rsp_count[die] <= 0;
        done_req_count[die] <= 0;
        done_rsp_count[die] <= 0;
        degrade_req_count[die] <= 0;
        degrade_rsp_count[die] <= 0;
        degrade_req_hold[die] <= 0;
        degrade_rsp_hold[die] <= 0;
      end else begin
        if (stalled && !train_error[die] && (!tx_valid[die] || tx_message[die] !== held_message))
          $fatal(1, "Peer %0d changed an unaccepted packet", die);
        if (degrade_exit[die] && tx_valid[die])
          $fatal(1, "Peer %0d exited before its last accepted degrade response", die);
        stalled <= tx_valid[die] && !tx_ready[die];
        held_message <= tx_message[die];
        pattern_cycles[die] <= send_pattern[die] ? pattern_cycles[die] + 1 : 0;
        if (tx_valid[die] && !tx_ready[die]) begin
          if (tx_message[die] == msgMbtrainLinkSpeedExitToSpeedDegradeReq(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY))
            degrade_req_hold[die] <= degrade_req_hold[die] + 1;
          if (tx_message[die] == msgMbtrainLinkSpeedExitToSpeedDegradeResp(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY))
            degrade_rsp_hold[die] <= degrade_rsp_hold[die] + 1;
        end
        if (tx_valid[die] && tx_ready[die]) begin
          if (tx_message[die] == msgMbtrainLinkSpeedErrorReq(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY))
            error_req_count[die] <= error_req_count[die] + 1;
          if (tx_message[die] == msgMbtrainLinkSpeedErrorResp(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY))
            error_rsp_count[die] <= error_rsp_count[die] + 1;
          if (tx_message[die] == msgMbtrainLinkSpeedDoneReq(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY))
            done_req_count[die] <= done_req_count[die] + 1;
          if (tx_message[die] == msgMbtrainLinkSpeedDoneResp(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY))
            done_rsp_count[die] <= done_rsp_count[die] + 1;
          if (tx_message[die] == msgMbtrainLinkSpeedExitToSpeedDegradeReq(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY)) begin
            if (error_req_count[die] != 1 || error_rsp_count[1-die] != 1)
              $fatal(1, "Peer %0d initiated degrade before completing ERROR", die);
            degrade_req_count[die] <= degrade_req_count[die] + 1;
          end
          if (tx_message[die] == msgMbtrainLinkSpeedExitToSpeedDegradeResp(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY)) begin
            if (error_rsp_count[die] != 1 || degrade_req_count[1-die] != 1)
              $fatal(1, "Peer %0d acknowledged degrade out of order", die);
            degrade_rsp_count[die] <= degrade_rsp_count[die] + 1;
          end
        end
      end
    end

    // Acceptance first captures the partial counts. Notification of the
    // point-test FSM must wait for the following registered final count.
    always @(posedge clock) begin
      if (reset_n && accepted_result && dut.d2cSender_sentResultsReq &&
          !dut.d2cSender_receivedResultsResp && !dut.resultCountPendingReg) begin
        #0.001;
        if (!dut.resultCountPendingReg || dut.d2cSender_receivedResultsResp)
          $fatal(1, "Peer %0d bypassed the result-count pipeline boundary", die);
      end
    end
  end

  always @(posedge clock)
    cycle_count <= reset_n ? cycle_count + 1 : 0;

  task automatic run_case(input logic [15:0] pass0, input logic [15:0] pass1,
                          input logic [2:0] corrupt0, input logic [2:0] corrupt1);
    int expected_errors [0:1];
    int cycles;
    bit failure;
    begin
      @(negedge clock);
      reset_n = 0; start = 0;
      cycles_1us = 800; block_all_tx = 0; block_done_response = 0; inject_stall = 0;
      drop_degrade_response[0] = 0; drop_degrade_response[1] = 0;
      lane_pass[0] = pass0; lane_pass[1] = pass1;
      corrupt_mode[0] = corrupt0; corrupt_mode[1] = corrupt1;
      expected_errors[0] = 16 - $countones(pass1);
      expected_errors[1] = 16 - $countones(pass0);
      if (corrupt1 >= 1 && corrupt1 <= 3 && expected_errors[0] == 0) expected_errors[0] = 1;
      if (corrupt0 >= 1 && corrupt0 <= 3 && expected_errors[1] == 0) expected_errors[1] = 1;
      failure = expected_errors[0] != 0 || expected_errors[1] != 0;
      repeat (3) @(negedge clock);
      reset_n = 1; start = 1;
      @(negedge clock);
      start = 0;
      cycles = 0;
      while (!((done[0] || train_error[0] || degrade_exit[0]) &&
               (done[1] || train_error[1] || degrade_exit[1]))) begin
        @(negedge clock);
        if (++cycles > 1000)
          $fatal(1, "LINKSPEED timeout: sender=%h/%h receiver=%h/%h", peer[0].dut.dbg_senderState,
                 peer[1].dut.dbg_senderState, peer[0].dut.dbg_receiverState, peer[1].dut.dbg_receiverState);
      end
      for (int die = 0; die < 2; die++) begin
        if (last_errors[die] != expected_errors[die])
          $fatal(1, "Wrong pipelined count peer=%0d expected=%0d got=%0d", die, expected_errors[die], last_errors[die]);
        if (busy[die] || retrain[die] || train_error[die] ||
            degrade_exit[die] != failure || done[die] == failure)
          $fatal(1, "Wrong completion for peer %0d failure=%0b", die, failure);
        if (error_req_count[die] != (expected_errors[die] != 0) ||
            error_rsp_count[die] != (expected_errors[1-die] != 0))
          $fatal(1, "Error exchange obligations lost or duplicated peer=%0d", die);
        if (!failure && (done_req_count[die] != 1 || done_rsp_count[die] != 1))
          $fatal(1, "Success did not finish both DONE exchanges peer=%0d", die);
        if (degrade_req_count[die] != (expected_errors[die] != 0) ||
            degrade_rsp_count[die] != (expected_errors[1-die] != 0))
          $fatal(1, "Degrade exchange obligations lost or duplicated peer=%0d", die);
      end
      repeat (3) @(negedge clock);
      if (failure && (!degrade_exit[0] || !degrade_exit[1]))
        $fatal(1, "Degrade exit did not remain latched until start/reset");
      completed_scenarios++;
    end
  endtask

  task automatic run_missing_degrade_response;
    int waited;
    begin
      @(negedge clock);
      reset_n = 0; start = 0; block_all_tx = 0; block_done_response = 0; inject_stall = 0;
      cycles_1us = 1;
      lane_pass[0] = '1; lane_pass[1] = 16'hfffe;
      corrupt_mode[0] = 0; corrupt_mode[1] = 0;
      drop_degrade_response[0] = 0; drop_degrade_response[1] = 1;
      repeat (3) @(negedge clock);
      reset_n = 1; start = 1;
      @(negedge clock);
      start = 0; waited = 0;
      while (!train_error[0] && waited <= 8001) begin
        @(negedge clock);
        waited++;
      end
      if (waited != 8000 || !train_error[0] || degrade_exit[0] ||
          !degrade_exit[1] || train_error[1] || degrade_req_count[0] != 1 ||
          degrade_rsp_count[1] != 1)
        $fatal(1, "Lost degrade response did not prevent exit until timeout");
      drop_degrade_response[1] = 0;
      completed_scenarios++;
    end
  endtask

  task automatic run_timeout(input int clocks_per_us);
    int elapsed, expected;
    begin
      @(negedge clock);
      reset_n = 0; start = 0; block_all_tx = 1; block_done_response = 0; inject_stall = 0;
      cycles_1us = 32'(clocks_per_us);
      lane_pass[0] = '1; lane_pass[1] = '1; corrupt_mode[0] = 0; corrupt_mode[1] = 0;
      repeat (3) @(negedge clock);
      reset_n = 1; start = 1;
      @(negedge clock);
      start = 0; elapsed = 0;
      expected = 8000 * (clocks_per_us == 0 ? 1 : clocks_per_us);
      while (!(train_error[0] && train_error[1]) && elapsed <= expected + 2) begin
        @(negedge clock);
        elapsed++;
      end
      if (elapsed != expected || !train_error[0] || !train_error[1] ||
          busy[0] || busy[1] || done[0] || done[1] || degrade_exit[0] || degrade_exit[1] ||
          tx_valid[0] || tx_valid[1])
        $fatal(1, "Timeout did not abort at 8000 us: clocks/us=%0d elapsed=%0d", clocks_per_us, elapsed);
      completed_scenarios++;
    end
  endtask

  task automatic run_stall_extension;
    int waited;
    begin
      @(negedge clock);
      reset_n = 0; start = 0; block_all_tx = 0; block_done_response = 1; inject_stall = 0;
      cycles_1us = 1;
      lane_pass[0] = '1; lane_pass[1] = '1; corrupt_mode[0] = 0; corrupt_mode[1] = 0;
      repeat (3) @(negedge clock);
      reset_n = 1; start = 1;
      @(negedge clock);
      start = 0; waited = 0;
      while (!(tx_valid[0] && tx_valid[1] &&
               tx_message[0] == msgMbtrainLinkSpeedDoneResp(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY) &&
               tx_message[1] == msgMbtrainLinkSpeedDoneResp(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY))) begin
        @(negedge clock);
        if (++waited > 1000) $fatal(1, "No stalled DONE responses");
      end
      repeat (6500) @(negedge clock);
      inject_stall = 1;
      @(negedge clock);
      inject_stall = 0;
      repeat (7000) @(negedge clock);
      if (train_error[0] || train_error[1] || !busy[0] || !busy[1])
        $fatal(1, "Valid DONE Stall did not restart the 8 ms counter");
      block_done_response = 0; waited = 0;
      while (!(done[0] && done[1])) begin
        @(negedge clock);
        if (++waited > 1000) $fatal(1, "DONE exchange failed after Stall");
      end
      completed_scenarios++;
    end
  endtask

  initial begin
    lane_pass[0] = '1; lane_pass[1] = '1;
    corrupt_mode[0] = 0; corrupt_mode[1] = 0;
    drop_degrade_response[0] = 0; drop_degrade_response[1] = 0;
    // Literal packets independently enforce the UCIe 2.0 Table 7-9 fields,
    // endpoints and header parity, rather than comparing helpers to themselves.
    if (msgMbtrainLinkSpeedExitToSpeedDegradeReq(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY) !==
        128'h000000000000000006000018402d4012 ||
        msgMbtrainLinkSpeedExitToSpeedDegradeResp(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY) !==
        128'h000000000000000006000018402e8012)
      $fatal(1, "Wrong exit-to-speed-degrade wire encoding");
    // Every representable failed-lane population, with independent $countones
    // expectations instead of the RTL tree; also exercise each physical bit.
    for (int failures = 0; failures <= 16; failures++)
      run_case(16'hffff, 16'hffff << failures, 0, 0);
    for (int lane = 0; lane < 16; lane++)
      run_case(~(16'b1 << lane), 16'hffff, 0, 0);
    run_case(16'h00ff, 16'hf000, 0, 0); // Both peers fail simultaneously.
    for (int corruption = 1; corruption <= 3; corruption++)
      run_case(16'hffff, 16'hffff, 0, 3'(corruption));
    run_case(16'hffff, 16'hfffe, 0, 4); // Summary says pass; bitmap still fails.
    run_timeout(0); // Explicitly verify zero clamps to one clock/us.
    run_timeout(2);
    run_stall_extension();
    run_missing_degrade_response();
    run_case(16'hffff, 16'hffff, 0, 0); // Recovery after timed-out attempts.
    $display("PASS LinkSpeedSpec_tb: %0d two-peer count/error/degrade/stall/timeout scenarios", completed_scenarios);
    $finish;
  end
endmodule

`default_nettype wire
```

<a id="test-MBInitSpeedNegotiationSpec_tb-sv"></a>

## [69] test\MBInitSpeedNegotiationSpec_tb.sv

```systemverilog
// FILE_INDEX: 69
// FILE_PATH : test\MBInitSpeedNegotiationSpec_tb.sv

`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

module MBInitSpeedNegotiationSpec_tb #(
  parameter logic [3:0] MAX_SPEED = 4'd3
);
  import SidebandMsgGenerator_pkg::*;
  import LtsmParameters_pkg::*;
  logic clock = 0;
  always #0.625 clock = ~clock;
  logic reset_n = 0, start = 0, tx_ready = 0, rx_valid = 0;
  logic [1:0] requested_speed = 0;
  logic [127:0] rx_data = 0;
  wire tx_valid, train_error, busy, done;
  wire [127:0] tx_data;
  wire [1:0] negotiated_speed;
  wire [2:0] substate;
  int req_count = 0, rsp_count = 0, scenarios = 0;
  logic [3:0] expected_cap, expected_speed;
  logic held = 0;
  logic [127:0] held_data;

  MBInitFSM #(.maxLinkSpeed(MAX_SPEED)) dut (
    .clock(clock), .reset_n(reset_n), .start(start),
    .requestedSpeed(requested_speed), .negotiatedSpeed(negotiated_speed),
    .busy(busy), .done(done), .trainError(train_error), .substate(substate),
    .sb_tx_ready(tx_ready), .sb_tx_valid(tx_valid), .sb_tx_din(tx_data),
    .sb_rx_valid(rx_valid), .sb_rx_dout(rx_data)
  );

  function automatic logic [127:0] param_req(input logic [3:0] speed);
    return msgMbinitParamConfigReq(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY,
      DEFAULT_SB_FEATURE_EXTENSION, DEFAULT_UCIE_A, DEFAULT_MODULE_ID,
      DEFAULT_CLK_PHASE, DEFAULT_CLK_MODE, DEFAULT_VOLTAGE_SWING, speed);
  endfunction
  function automatic logic [127:0] param_rsp(input logic [3:0] speed);
    return msgMbinitParamConfigResp(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY,
      DEFAULT_CLK_PHASE, DEFAULT_CLK_MODE, speed);
  endfunction
  task automatic tick(input int count = 1);
    repeat (count) begin @(posedge clock); #0.01; end
  endtask
  task automatic receive(input logic [127:0] message);
    @(negedge clock); rx_data = message; rx_valid = 1;
    tick(); @(negedge clock); rx_valid = 0; tick();
  endtask

  always @(posedge clock) begin
    if (!reset_n) begin
      req_count <= 0; rsp_count <= 0; held <= 0;
    end else begin
      if (held && (!tx_valid || tx_data !== held_data))
        $fatal(1, "PARAM changed an unaccepted packet");
      held <= tx_valid && !tx_ready;
      held_data <= tx_data;
      if (tx_valid && tx_ready && substate == 0) begin
        case (tx_data[21:14])
          8'hA5: begin
            if (tx_data !== param_req(expected_cap))
              $fatal(1, "Wrong latched advertisement: %032h cap=%0d", tx_data, expected_cap);
            req_count <= req_count + 1;
          end
          8'hAA: begin
            if (tx_data !== param_rsp(expected_speed))
              $fatal(1, "Wrong highest-common response: %032h speed=%0d", tx_data, expected_speed);
            rsp_count <= rsp_count + 1;
          end
          default: $fatal(1, "Unexpected PARAM packet");
        endcase
      end
    end
  end

  // mode: 0 successful, 1 invalid advertised speed, 2 incorrect response,
  // 3 reserved parameter bit, 4 bad payload parity.
  task automatic run_case(input logic [1:0] requested, input logic [3:0] remote,
                          input int mode = 0);
    logic [127:0] remote_req;
    @(negedge clock); reset_n = 0; start = 0; rx_valid = 0; tx_ready = 0;
    requested_speed = requested;
    expected_cap = (MAX_SPEED < {2'b0, requested}) ? MAX_SPEED : {2'b0, requested};
    expected_speed = (remote < expected_cap) ? remote : expected_cap;
    tick(3); @(negedge clock); reset_n = 1; start = 1;
    tick(); @(negedge clock); start = 0;
    // Deliberately change the pin during negotiation: it must stay latched.
    requested_speed = ~requested;
    tick(8);
    if (!tx_valid || tx_data !== param_req(expected_cap) || req_count != 0)
      $fatal(1, "PARAM did not hold its first request under backpressure");
    remote_req = param_req(remote);
    if (mode == 3) begin remote_req[127] = 1; remote_req[63] = ^remote_req[127:64]; end
    if (mode == 4) remote_req[63] = ~remote_req[63];
    receive(remote_req);
    tick(5);
    @(negedge clock); tx_ready = 1;
    if (mode == 0 || mode == 2) begin
      receive(param_rsp(mode == 2 ? 4'd5 : expected_speed));
    end
    for (int n = 0; n < 100; n++) begin
      tick();
      if (mode == 0 && substate == 1) begin
        if (train_error || negotiated_speed !== expected_speed[1:0] || req_count != 1 || rsp_count != 1)
          $fatal(1, "Negotiation failed req=%0d rsp=%0d agreed=%0d expected=%0d", req_count, rsp_count, negotiated_speed, expected_speed);
        scenarios++;
        return;
      end
      if (mode != 0 && train_error) begin
        if (substate != 0) $fatal(1, "Malformed parameter advanced into CAL");
        scenarios++;
        return;
      end
    end
    $fatal(1, "Negotiation timeout mode=%0d local=%0d remote=%0d state=%0d", mode, requested, remote, substate);
  endtask

  initial begin
    for (int speed = 0; speed < 4; speed++) run_case(2'(speed), 4'(speed));
    run_case(3, 1); run_case(1, 3); run_case(3, 4); run_case(3, 5);
    run_case(3, 6, 1); run_case(3, 15, 1);
    run_case(3, 1, 2); run_case(3, 3, 3); run_case(3, 3, 4);
    $display("PASS MBInitSpeedNegotiationSpec_tb: %0d cases, MAX_SPEED=%0d", scenarios, MAX_SPEED);
    $finish;
  end
  initial begin #100000; $fatal(1, "Global timeout"); end
endmodule
`default_nettype wire

```

<a id="test-reference-DllPiExternalReferenceSpec_tb-sv"></a>

## [70] test\reference\DllPiExternalReferenceSpec_tb.sv

```systemverilog
// FILE_INDEX: 70
// FILE_PATH : test\reference\DllPiExternalReferenceSpec_tb.sv

// Optional: requires the separately supplied dll_pi_control golden RTL.
`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

// The supplied reference decoder is kept unchanged under reference_dll_pi.
// Expected words below are computed independently from physical bank weights.
module DllPiExternalReferenceSpec_tb;
  logic clock = 0;
  always #5 clock = ~clock;
  logic reset_n = 0, update = 0;
  logic [2:0] sector;
  logic [5:0] step;
  wire s0, s1, s2, s3, invert, applied, error;
  wire [16:0] upper_en, lower_en;
  wire [2:0] active_sector;
  wire [5:0] active_step, raw_code;
  logic [37:0] last_word, seen [0:263];
  int commands = 0, encoding_checks = 0;
  dll_pi_control reference_dut (
    .ctrl_clk(clock), .rst_n(reset_n), .update_en(update),
    .sector_req(sector), .delay_step_req(step),
    .s0(s0), .s1(s1), .s2(s2), .s3(s3),
    .upper_en(upper_en), .lower_en(lower_en),
    .sector_active(active_sector), .delay_step_active(active_step),
    .pi_code_active(raw_code), .invert_active(invert),
    .update_applied(applied), .request_error(error)
  );

  function automatic logic [37:0] expected(input int sec, input int delay);
    logic [16:0] later, upper, lower;
    logic [1:0] upper_mux, lower_mux;
    later = '0;
    later[0] = 1'(delay % 2);
    for (int switch_index = 0; switch_index < 16; switch_index++)
      later[switch_index+1] = switch_index < delay/2;
    upper_mux = 2'((sec+1)/2);
    lower_mux = 2'(sec/2);
    upper = sec % 2 ? later : ~later;
    lower = ~upper;
    return {lower, upper, lower_mux, upper_mux};
  endfunction

  function automatic int weight(input logic [16:0] bank);
    int result;
    result = int'(bank[0]);
    for (int bit_index = 1; bit_index < 17; bit_index++)
      result += 2*int'(bank[bit_index]);
    return result;
  endfunction

  function automatic int physical_phase(input logic [37:0] word);
    int upper_coordinate, lower_coordinate;
    upper_coordinate = int'(word[1:0])*66;
    lower_coordinate = int'(word[3:2])*66+33;
    // The upper CLK0 input is the next-cycle endpoint beside lower CLK315.
    if(word[1:0]==0 && word[3:2]==3) upper_coordinate=264;
    return ((upper_coordinate*weight(word[20:4]) +
             lower_coordinate*weight(word[37:21]))/33)%264;
  endfunction

  initial begin
    sector = 0;
    step = 0;
    @(negedge clock);
    if ({lower_en,upper_en,s3,s2,s1,s0} !== expected(0,0))
      $fatal(1,"Reference RTL reset is not sector0/step0");
    reset_n = 1;
    for (int sec = 0; sec < 8; sec++) begin
      for (int delay = 0; delay <= 33; delay++) begin
        sector = 3'(sec);
        step = 6'(delay);
        update = 1;
        @(negedge clock);
        if ({lower_en,upper_en,s3,s2,s1,s0} !== expected(sec,delay) ||
            !applied || error || active_sector != sec || active_step != delay ||
            raw_code != 33-delay || invert != (sec%2 == 0))
          $fatal(1,"Reference command mismatch sector=%0d step=%0d",sec,delay);
        if (lower_en !== ~upper_en || weight(lower_en)+weight(upper_en) != 33 ||
            (sec%2 ? weight(upper_en) : weight(lower_en)) != delay)
          $fatal(1,"Bank complement/weight/order mismatch");
        if(physical_phase({lower_en,upper_en,s3,s2,s1,s0}) != (sec*33+delay)%264)
          $fatal(1,"Decoded physical phase/wrap mismatch sector=%0d step=%0d",sec,delay);
        commands++;
        if (delay < 33) begin
          int phase;
          logic [37:0] encoded;
          phase = sec*33 + delay;
          encoded = LtsmParameters_pkg::encode_d2c_phase(9'(phase));
          if (encoded !== expected(sec,delay) || encoded !== {lower_en,upper_en,s3,s2,s1,s0})
            $fatal(1,"Production/reference mismatch phase=%0d code=%h",phase,encoded);
          for (int previous = 0; previous < phase; previous++)
            if (encoded == seen[previous]) $fatal(1,"Duplicate phase word %0d/%0d",phase,previous);
          seen[phase] = encoded;
          encoding_checks++;
        end else begin
          // Endpoint sec/33 and next-sector/0 select the same clock phase,
          // although the unused mux and enabled-bank orientation may differ.
          if (physical_phase({lower_en,upper_en,s3,s2,s1,s0}) !=
              physical_phase(expected((sec+1)%8,0)))
            $fatal(1,"Endpoint coordinate mismatch");
        end
      end
    end
    last_word = {lower_en,upper_en,s3,s2,s1,s0};
    for (int delay = 34; delay < 64; delay++) begin
      step = 6'(delay);
      @(negedge clock);
      if (!error || applied || {lower_en,upper_en,s3,s2,s1,s0} !== last_word)
        $fatal(1,"Reference invalid command changed active controls");
    end
    update = 0;
    @(negedge clock);
    if (error || applied || {lower_en,upper_en,s3,s2,s1,s0} !== last_word)
      $fatal(1,"Reference inactive-update hold failed");
    for (int invalid_phase = 264; invalid_phase < 512; invalid_phase++)
      if (LtsmParameters_pkg::encode_d2c_phase(9'(invalid_phase)) !== expected(0,0))
        $fatal(1,"Invalid phase index did not select deterministic phase0 fallback");
    if (commands != 272 || encoding_checks != 264)
      $fatal(1,"Exhaustive coverage incomplete");
    $display("PASS DllPiEncodingSpec_tb: 272 reference commands, 264 unique production phases, invalid-command hold");
    $finish;
  end
endmodule

`default_nettype wire
```
