```systemverilog
// FILE_INDEX: 71
// FILE_PATH : test\RxDeskewEncodingSpec_tb.sv

`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

// Independent switch-word oracle plus directed RXDESKEW sweep/handshake tests.
module RxDeskewEncodingSpec_tb;
  logic clock = 1'b0;
  always #5 clock = ~clock;
  logic reset_n = 1'b0, start = 1'b0;
  logic busy, done, trainError, apply, applied = 1'b0, pointStart;
  logic pointDone = 1'b0;
  logic [3:0] pointPass = '0, state;
  logic [79:0] codes, selected, leftCodes, rightCodes;
  logic [15:0] failedCount, retries;

  MBTrain_RxDeskewSweepEngine #(
    .DATA_LANE_COUNT(4), .ACTIVE_DATA_LANE_MASK(4'b0111),
    .MAX_TRAINING_RETRIES(1)
  ) dut (
    .clock(clock), .reset_n(reset_n), .start(start),
    .busy(busy), .done(done), .trainError(trainError),
    .apply_rx_lane_deskew(apply), .rx_lane_deskew_codes(codes),
    .rx_lane_deskew_applied(applied), .point_test_start(pointStart),
    .point_test_done(pointDone), .point_test_pass(pointPass),
    .state(state), .lastFailedLaneCount(failedCount), .retryCount(retries),
    .finalRxDeskewCodes(selected), .validWindowLeftCodes(leftCodes),
    .validWindowRightCodes(rightCodes)
  );

  // Each 10-bit cell is a fine bit followed by a low-to-high thermometer.
  // This expression is deliberately separate from the RTL bit-by-bit decoder.
  function automatic logic [19:0] expectedCode(input int halfSteps);
    int first, second, firstCoarse, secondCoarse;
    logic [9:0] firstWord, secondWord;
    if (halfSteps < 0 || halfSteps > 38)
      $fatal(1, "Invalid oracle input %0d", halfSteps);
    first = halfSteps > 19 ? 19 : halfSteps;
    second = halfSteps - first;
    firstCoarse = (1 << (first / 2)) - 1;
    secondCoarse = (1 << (second / 2)) - 1;
    firstWord = 10'((firstCoarse << 1) | (first % 2));
    secondWord = 10'((secondCoarse << 1) | (second % 2));
    return {secondWord, firstWord};
  endfunction

  function automatic int decode(input logic [19:0] value);
    for (int step = 0; step < 39; step++)
      if (value === expectedCode(step)) return step;
    $fatal(1, "Illegal RXDESKEW switch word %h", value);
    return -1;
  endfunction

  function automatic bit passAt(input int scenario, lane, step);
    if (scenario == 3) return 1'b0;
    if (scenario == 2) return 1'b1;
    if (scenario == 1) begin
      case (lane)
        0: return (step >= 2 && step <= 5) || (step >= 12 && step <= 15);
        1: return step == 38;
        default: return step == 0;
      endcase
    end
    case (lane)
      0: return step >= 17 && step <= 22;
      1: return step >= 35 && step <= 38;
      default: return step >= 0 && step <= 5;
    endcase
  endfunction

  task automatic checkWindow(input int lane, mid, lo, hi);
    if (selected[lane*20 +: 20] !== expectedCode(mid) ||
        leftCodes[lane*20 +: 20] !== expectedCode(lo) ||
        rightCodes[lane*20 +: 20] !== expectedCode(hi))
      $fatal(1, "Lane %0d window selected=%h left=%h right=%h; expected steps %0d/%0d/%0d",
        lane, selected[lane*20 +: 20], leftCodes[lane*20 +: 20],
        rightCodes[lane*20 +: 20], mid, lo, hi);
  endtask

  task automatic runScenario(input int scenario, input bit resetBefore = 1'b1,
                             input int applyDelay = 3, input int pointDelay = 2);
    int sweepCount, finalCount, pointCount, cycles, applyWait, pointWait;
    int prepareCount, encodeFinalCount;
    logic [3:0] previousState;
    logic [79:0] heldCodes, previousSelected, previousLeft, previousRight;
    prepareCount = 0;
    encodeFinalCount = 0;
    sweepCount = 0;
    finalCount = 0;
    pointCount = 0;
    cycles = 0;
    applyWait = 0;
    pointWait = 0;
    previousState = '0;
    heldCodes = '0;
    previousSelected = '0;
    previousLeft = '0;
    previousRight = '0;
    @(negedge clock);
    start = 1'b0;
    applied = 1'b0;
    pointDone = 1'b0;
    pointPass = '0;
    if (resetBefore) begin
      reset_n = 1'b0;
      @(negedge clock);
      if (codes !== '0 || selected !== '0 || leftCodes !== '0 || rightCodes !== '0)
        $fatal(1, "Reset must select the zero-delay word and clear endpoints");
      reset_n = 1'b1;
    end
    start = 1'b1;
    @(negedge clock);
    start = 1'b0;
    while (!(done || trainError)) begin
      if (++cycles > 3000) $fatal(1, "RXDESKEW scenario %0d timed out", scenario);
      if (!busy) $fatal(1, "Busy dropped before terminal state");
      // Every physical code application must pass through exactly one encode
      // stage. During final encoding, the registered result vectors still
      // hold their previous values: analysis has latched indices only.
      if (state == 4'ha) begin
        if (state == previousState || apply || pointStart)
          $fatal(1, "Invalid sweep preparation state/handshake");
        prepareCount++;
      end
      if (state == 4'hb) begin
        if (previousState != 4'h4 || apply || pointStart ||
            selected !== previousSelected || leftCodes !== previousLeft ||
            rightCodes !== previousRight)
          $fatal(1, "Final index analysis bypassed the encoding register boundary");
        encodeFinalCount++;
      end
      if (state == 4'h1 && previousState != 4'h1 && previousState != 4'ha)
        $fatal(1, "Sweep apply occurred without a preparation cycle");
      if (state == 4'h5 && previousState != 4'h5 && previousState != 4'hb)
        $fatal(1, "Final apply occurred without a separate encoding cycle");
      applied = 1'b0;
      pointDone = 1'b0;
      if (codes[60 +: 20] !== '0 || selected[60 +: 20] !== '0 ||
          leftCodes[60 +: 20] !== '0 || rightCodes[60 +: 20] !== '0)
        $fatal(1, "Inactive lane did not stay at zero delay");
      if (apply) begin
        if (state != previousState) begin
          heldCodes = codes;
          applyWait = 0;
          if (state == 4'h1) begin
            for (int lane = 0; lane < 3; lane++)
              if (codes[lane*20 +: 20] !== expectedCode(sweepCount % 39))
                $fatal(1, "Sweep skipped/reordered step %0d on lane %0d", sweepCount % 39, lane);
            sweepCount++;
          end else finalCount++;
        end
        if (codes !== heldCodes || pointStart)
          $fatal(1, "Control changed or point test started before apply acknowledgement");
        applied = ++applyWait >= applyDelay;
      end
      if (pointStart) pointCount++;
      if (state == 4'h3 || state == 4'h7) begin
        if (state != previousState) begin
          heldCodes = codes;
          pointWait = 0;
        end
        if (codes !== heldCodes || apply || pointStart)
          $fatal(1, "Code/handshake changed while waiting for point result");
        pointPass = '0;
        if (state == 4'h3) begin
          for (int lane = 0; lane < 3; lane++)
            pointPass[lane] = passAt(scenario, lane, decode(codes[lane*20 +: 20]));
        end else begin
          pointPass = ((scenario == 4 && finalCount == 1) || scenario == 5) ? 4'b0000 : 4'b0111;
        end
        pointDone = ++pointWait >= pointDelay;
      end
      previousState = state;
      previousSelected = selected;
      previousLeft = leftCodes;
      previousRight = rightCodes;
      @(negedge clock);
    end
    applied = 1'b0;
    pointDone = 1'b0;
    if (busy || (done && trainError)) $fatal(1, "Invalid terminal flags");
    if (scenario == 3) begin
      if (!trainError || done || retries != 1 || sweepCount != 78 || finalCount != 0 || failedCount != 117)
        $fatal(1, "No-window retry/exhaustion behavior failed");
    end else if (scenario == 5) begin
      if (!trainError || done || retries != 1 || sweepCount != 78 || finalCount != 2 || failedCount != 104)
        $fatal(1, "Final verification retry/exhaustion failed: errors=%0d", failedCount);
    end else begin
      if (!done || trainError || retries != (scenario == 4 ? 1 : 0) ||
          sweepCount != (scenario == 4 ? 78 : 39) || finalCount != (scenario == 4 ? 2 : 1))
        $fatal(1, "Passing sweep/verification counts failed");
      case (scenario)
        0, 4: begin
          checkWindow(0, 19, 17, 22);
          checkWindow(1, 36, 35, 38);
          checkWindow(2, 2, 0, 5);
        end
        1: begin
          checkWindow(0, 3, 2, 5);
          checkWindow(1, 38, 38, 38);
          checkWindow(2, 0, 0, 0);
        end
        2: begin
          for (int lane = 0; lane < 3; lane++) checkWindow(lane, 19, 0, 38);
        end
      endcase
    end
    if (prepareCount != sweepCount || encodeFinalCount != finalCount)
      $fatal(1, "Pipeline stage count mismatch: sweep %0d/%0d final %0d/%0d",
        prepareCount, sweepCount, encodeFinalCount, finalCount);
    if (pointCount != sweepCount + finalCount)
      $fatal(1, "Expected one point-test start per applied code");
    repeat (3) begin
      @(negedge clock);
      if (apply || pointStart || busy) $fatal(1, "Terminal state did not hold");
    end
    $display("PASS RXDESKEW scenario %0d: sweep=%0d final=%0d retry=%0d", scenario, sweepCount, finalCount, retries);
  endtask

  task automatic resetInPipeline(input logic [3:0] resetState);
    int cycles;
    @(negedge clock);
    start = 1'b1;
    applied = 1'b0;
    pointDone = 1'b0;
    @(negedge clock);
    start = 1'b0;
    cycles = 0;
    while (state != resetState) begin
      if (++cycles > 1000) $fatal(1, "Did not reach pipeline reset state %h", resetState);
      applied = apply;
      pointDone = (state == 4'h3 || state == 4'h7);
      pointPass = 4'b0111;
      @(negedge clock);
    end
    if (apply || pointStart) $fatal(1, "Pipeline reset target asserted a handshake");
    #1 reset_n = 1'b0;
    #1;
    if (state !== 4'h0 || busy || done || trainError || apply || pointStart ||
        codes !== '0 || selected !== '0 || leftCodes !== '0 || rightCodes !== '0)
      $fatal(1, "Asynchronous reset did not flush pipeline state %h", resetState);
    applied = 1'b0;
    pointDone = 1'b0;
    @(negedge clock);
    reset_n = 1'b1;
  endtask

  initial begin
    if (expectedCode(0) !== 20'h00000 || expectedCode(1) !== 20'h00001 ||
        expectedCode(2) !== 20'h00002 || expectedCode(18) !== 20'h003fe ||
        expectedCode(19) !== 20'h003ff || expectedCode(20) !== 20'h007ff ||
        expectedCode(21) !== 20'h00bff || expectedCode(38) !== 20'hfffff)
      $fatal(1, "Independent oracle boundary error");
    for (int scenario = 0; scenario < 6; scenario++) runScenario(scenario);
    runScenario(1, 1'b0, 1, 1); // Restart directly from error; immediate handshakes.
    runScenario(0, 1'b0, 1, 1); // Restart directly from done.
    resetInPipeline(4'ha);
    runScenario(2, 1'b0, 1, 1);
    resetInPipeline(4'hb);
    runScenario(2, 1'b0, 1, 1);
    $display("PASS RxDeskewEncodingSpec_tb: all 39 codes, two-cell boundary, windows, ties, inactive lanes, stalls, retries, pipeline stages and terminal restarts");
    $finish;
  end
endmodule
```

```systemverilog
// FILE_INDEX: 72
// FILE_PATH : test\RxDeskewPipelineSpec_tb.sv

`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

// Nondefault seven-point, three-lane configuration: an undersized window
// forces a retry, then equal-length windows must choose the first midpoint.
module RxDeskewPipelineSpec_tb;
  logic clock = 1'b0;
  always #5 clock = ~clock;
  logic reset_n = 1'b0, start = 1'b0;
  logic busy, done, trainError, apply, applied = 1'b0, pointStart;
  logic pointDone = 1'b0;
  logic [2:0] pointPass = '0;
  logic [3:0] state;
  logic [59:0] codes, selected, leftCodes, rightCodes;
  logic [15:0] failedCount, retries;

  MBTrain_RxDeskewSweepEngine #(
    .DATA_LANE_COUNT(3), .ACTIVE_DATA_LANE_MASK(3'b101),
    .RX_DESKEW_VALUE_COUNT(7), .MIN_PASSING_WINDOW_VALUES(3),
    .MAX_TRAINING_RETRIES(1)
  ) dut (
    .clock(clock), .reset_n(reset_n), .start(start),
    .busy(busy), .done(done), .trainError(trainError),
    .apply_rx_lane_deskew(apply), .rx_lane_deskew_codes(codes),
    .rx_lane_deskew_applied(applied), .point_test_start(pointStart),
    .point_test_done(pointDone), .point_test_pass(pointPass),
    .state(state), .lastFailedLaneCount(failedCount), .retryCount(retries),
    .finalRxDeskewCodes(selected), .validWindowLeftCodes(leftCodes),
    .validWindowRightCodes(rightCodes)
  );

  function automatic logic [19:0] expectedCode(input int halfSteps);
    // All seven settings use only the first cell. Independent thermometer
    // expression checks that the preparation stage did not skip an index.
    return 20'((((1 << (halfSteps / 2)) - 1) << 1) | (halfSteps % 2));
  endfunction

  initial begin : regression
    int cycles, sweepCount, finalCount, startCount, prepCount, encodeCount;
    int applyWait, pointWait, step;
    logic [3:0] previousState;
    logic [59:0] heldCodes;
    cycles = 0;
    sweepCount = 0;
    finalCount = 0;
    startCount = 0;
    prepCount = 0;
    encodeCount = 0;
    applyWait = 0;
    pointWait = 0;
    previousState = '0;
    heldCodes = '0;
    repeat (2) @(negedge clock);
    reset_n = 1'b1;
    start = 1'b1;
    @(negedge clock);
    start = 1'b0;
    while (!done && !trainError) begin
      if (++cycles > 1000) $fatal(1, "Nondefault RXDESKEW pipeline timeout");
      if (!busy || codes[39:20] !== '0 || selected[39:20] !== '0 ||
          leftCodes[39:20] !== '0 || rightCodes[39:20] !== '0)
        $fatal(1, "Busy/inactive-lane contract failed");
      applied = 1'b0;
      pointDone = 1'b0;
      if (state == 4'ha) begin
        if (apply || pointStart || previousState == 4'ha)
          $fatal(1, "Sweep preparation must take exactly one silent cycle");
        prepCount++;
      end
      if (state == 4'hb) begin
        if (apply || pointStart || previousState != 4'h4 || retries != 1)
          $fatal(1, "Final encoding entered before a qualifying retry window");
        encodeCount++;
      end
      if (apply) begin
        if (state != previousState) begin
          heldCodes = codes;
          applyWait = 0;
          if (state == 4'h1) begin
            if (previousState != 4'ha)
              $fatal(1, "Sweep code did not pass through preparation");
            step = sweepCount % 7;
            if (codes[19:0] !== expectedCode(step) || codes[59:40] !== expectedCode(step))
              $fatal(1, "Nondefault sweep index skipped/reordered: %0d", step);
            sweepCount++;
          end else begin
            if (state != 4'h5 || previousState != 4'hb || sweepCount != 14)
              $fatal(1, "Final code applied before the successful full retry");
            finalCount++;
          end
        end
        if (codes !== heldCodes || pointStart)
          $fatal(1, "Registered code changed before acknowledgement");
        applied = ++applyWait >= ((sweepCount % 4) + 1);
      end
      if (pointStart) startCount++;
      if (state == 4'h3 || state == 4'h7) begin
        if (state != previousState) begin
          pointWait = 0;
          heldCodes = codes;
        end
        if (apply || pointStart || codes !== heldCodes)
          $fatal(1, "Control changed while waiting for a delayed result");
        if (state == 4'h3) begin
          step = (sweepCount - 1) % 7;
          pointPass[0] = (retries == 0) ? (step >= 2 && step <= 3) :
                                         (step >= 1 && step <= 3);
          pointPass[1] = 1'b0; // Inactive failures must be ignored.
          pointPass[2] = (retries == 0) || (step <= 2 || step >= 4);
        end else pointPass = 3'b101;
        pointDone = ++pointWait >= ((sweepCount % 3) + 1);
      end
      previousState = state;
      @(negedge clock);
    end
    if (!done || trainError || busy || retries != 1 || failedCount != 5 ||
        sweepCount != 14 || finalCount != 1 || startCount != 15 ||
        prepCount != 14 || encodeCount != 1)
      $fatal(1, "Nondefault minimum-window retry/pipeline accounting failed");
    if (selected !== {expectedCode(1), 20'b0, expectedCode(2)} ||
        leftCodes !== {expectedCode(0), 20'b0, expectedCode(1)} ||
        rightCodes !== {expectedCode(2), 20'b0, expectedCode(3)})
      $fatal(1, "Nondefault midpoint/endpoints or equal-window tie failed");
    $display("PASS RxDeskewPipelineSpec_tb: nondefault count/minimum, inactive lane, undersized-window retry, tie, registered codes and variable stalls");
    $finish;
  end
endmodule

`default_nettype wire
```

```systemverilog
// FILE_INDEX: 73
// FILE_PATH : test\SpeedIdleRateChangeSpec_tb.sv

`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

module SpeedIdleRateChangeSpec_tb;
  import SidebandMsgGenerator_pkg::*;
  logic clock = 0;
  always #0.625 clock = ~clock;
  logic reset_n = 0, start = 0, speed_applied = 0, at_floor = 0;
  logic tx_ready = 0, rx_valid = 0;
  logic [31:0] cycles_us = 1;
  logic [127:0] rx_data = 0;
  wire tx_valid, busy, done, train_error;
  wire [127:0] tx_data;
  wire [1:0] sender_state, receiver_state;
  int done_req_count = 0, done_rsp_count = 0, error_req_count = 0, error_rsp_count = 0;
  int scenarios = 0;
  logic held = 0;
  logic [127:0] held_data;
  localparam logic [127:0] DONE_REQ = msgMbtrainSpeedIdleDoneReq(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY);
  localparam logic [127:0] DONE_RSP = msgMbtrainSpeedIdleDoneResp(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY);
  localparam logic [127:0] ERROR_REQ = msgWithoutPayloadBase(16'd0,
    UCIe2_LtsmMsgCode_TRAINERROR_REQ, 8'd0, ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY);
  localparam logic [127:0] ERROR_RSP = msgWithoutPayloadBase(16'd0,
    UCIe2_LtsmMsgCode_TRAINERROR_RSP, 8'd0, ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY);
  MBTrainSpeedIdleFSM dut (
    .clock(clock), .reset_n(reset_n), .start(start), .speedApplied(speed_applied),
    .speedDegradeAtFloor(at_floor), .cycles_1us(cycles_us),
    .busy(busy), .done(done), .trainError(train_error),
    .sb_tx_ready(tx_ready), .sb_tx_valid(tx_valid), .sb_tx_din(tx_data),
    .sb_rx_valid(rx_valid), .sb_rx_dout(rx_data),
    .dbg_senderState(sender_state), .dbg_receiverState(receiver_state)
  );
  task automatic tick(input int count = 1);
    repeat (count) begin @(posedge clock); #0.01; end
  endtask
  task automatic receive(input logic [127:0] message);
    @(negedge clock); rx_data = message; rx_valid = 1;
    tick(); @(negedge clock); rx_valid = 0; tick();
  endtask
  task automatic begin_case(input bit floor_case, input logic [31:0] cycles = 1);
    @(negedge clock); reset_n = 0; start = 0; speed_applied = 0;
    at_floor = floor_case; cycles_us = cycles; tx_ready = 0; rx_valid = 0;
    tick(3); @(negedge clock); reset_n = 1; start = 1;
    tick(); @(negedge clock); start = 0; tick();
  endtask
  task automatic await_exit(input bit expect_error, input int limit = 100);
    for (int n = 0; n < limit; n++) begin
      tick();
      if (done || train_error) begin
        if (train_error != expect_error || done == expect_error || busy || tx_valid)
          $fatal(1, "Incorrect SPEEDIDLE exit done=%b error=%b busy=%b valid=%b", done, train_error, busy, tx_valid);
        scenarios++;
        return;
      end
    end
    $fatal(1, "SPEEDIDLE exit timeout");
  endtask
  task automatic await_error_request(input int limit = 8100);
    for (int n = 0; n < limit; n++) begin
      tick();
      if (done || train_error) $fatal(1, "Exited before the TRAINERROR request was accepted");
      if (error_req_count == 1) return;
    end
    $fatal(1, "Missing residency-timeout TRAINERROR request");
  endtask
  always @(posedge clock) begin
    if (!reset_n) begin
      done_req_count <= 0; done_rsp_count <= 0; error_req_count <= 0; error_rsp_count <= 0; held <= 0;
    end else begin
      if (held && (!tx_valid || tx_data !== held_data))
        $fatal(1, "SPEEDIDLE changed an unaccepted packet");
      held <= tx_valid && !tx_ready; held_data <= tx_data;
      if (tx_valid && tx_ready) begin
        case (tx_data)
          DONE_REQ: done_req_count <= done_req_count + 1;
          DONE_RSP: done_rsp_count <= done_rsp_count + 1;
          ERROR_REQ: error_req_count <= error_req_count + 1;
          ERROR_RSP: error_rsp_count <= error_rsp_count + 1;
          default: $fatal(1, "Unexpected SPEEDIDLE packet %032h", tx_data);
        endcase
      end
    end
  end

  initial begin
    // A peer's early done request cannot bypass our PLL acknowledgement.
    begin_case(0); receive(DONE_REQ); tick(12);
    if (tx_valid || sender_state != 0 || done || train_error)
      $fatal(1, "SPEEDIDLE progressed before applied acknowledgement");
    @(negedge clock); speed_applied = 1; tick();
    @(negedge clock); speed_applied = 0; tick(12);
    if (!tx_valid || tx_data !== DONE_RSP) $fatal(1, "Applied pulse was not retained");
    @(negedge clock); tx_ready = 1;
    while (done_req_count == 0) tick();
    receive(DONE_RSP); await_exit(0);
    if (done_req_count != 1 || done_rsp_count != 1 || error_req_count != 0 || error_rsp_count != 0)
      $fatal(1, "Normal SPEEDIDLE repeated or incorrect packet");

    // At 4 GT/s, no PLL ack is required: exchange TRAINERROR entry instead.
    begin_case(1); tick(10);
    if (!tx_valid || tx_data !== ERROR_REQ || train_error) $fatal(1, "Floor did not hold TRAINERROR request");
    receive(ERROR_REQ); tick(8);
    @(negedge clock); tx_ready = 1;
    while (error_req_count == 0) tick();
    receive(ERROR_RSP); await_exit(1);
    if (error_req_count != 1 || error_rsp_count != 1 || done_req_count != 0 || done_rsp_count != 0)
      $fatal(1, "Floor handshake packets incorrect");

    // A partner can abort while this side waits for its PLL; respond once.
    begin_case(0); receive(ERROR_REQ); tick(10);
    if (!tx_valid || tx_data !== ERROR_RSP || train_error)
      $fatal(1, "Peer TRAINERROR did not wait for accepted response");
    @(negedge clock); tx_ready = 1; await_exit(1);
    if (error_req_count != 0 || error_rsp_count != 1 || done_req_count != 0 || done_rsp_count != 0)
      $fatal(1, "Peer-initiated TRAINERROR sent unexpected request");

    // An abort cannot replace an earlier unaccepted packet. Drain that packet,
    // then the error response, before reporting the terminal exit.
    begin_case(0); @(negedge clock); speed_applied = 1; tick(8);
    if (!tx_valid || tx_data !== DONE_REQ) $fatal(1, "Expected pending normal request");
    receive(ERROR_REQ); tick(10);
    if (!tx_valid || tx_data !== DONE_REQ || train_error)
      $fatal(1, "TRAINERROR replaced a pending normal packet");
    @(negedge clock); tx_ready = 1; await_exit(1);
    if (error_req_count != 0 || error_rsp_count != 1 || done_req_count != 1 || done_rsp_count != 0)
      $fatal(1, "Abort did not drain exactly the pending packet and error response");

    // A missing PLL acknowledgement starts TRAINERROR after normal 8 ms
    // residency. Its own unanswered request then receives a fresh 8 ms bound.
    begin_case(0); @(negedge clock); tx_ready = 1; tick(7980);
    if (tx_valid || error_req_count != 0 || done || train_error)
      $fatal(1, "PLL residency timeout fired too early");
    await_error_request(40);
    if (done_req_count != 0 || done_rsp_count != 0)
      $fatal(1, "Unapplied rate sent SPEEDIDLE done packets");
    tick(7990);
    if (train_error) $fatal(1, "TRAINERROR entry timer was not restarted");
    await_exit(1, 20);

    // Completing one direction cannot disable the residency watchdog for a
    // missing partner done response; a late done cannot end the error exchange.
    begin_case(0); @(negedge clock); tx_ready = 1; speed_applied = 1;
    receive(DONE_REQ);
    while (done_req_count == 0 || done_rsp_count == 0) tick();
    await_error_request();
    receive(DONE_RSP); tick(5);
    if (done || train_error) $fatal(1, "Late SPEEDIDLE response bypassed TRAINERROR handshake");
    receive(ERROR_RSP); await_exit(1);
    if (done_req_count != 1 || done_rsp_count != 1 || error_req_count != 1 || error_rsp_count != 0)
      $fatal(1, "Missing done-response timeout repeated packets");

    // The watchdog must preserve a normal packet stalled at the timeout, then
    // issue its error request only after that original packet is accepted.
    begin_case(0); @(negedge clock); speed_applied = 1; tick(8020);
    if (!tx_valid || tx_data !== DONE_REQ || done || train_error)
      $fatal(1, "Residency timeout corrupted a pending packet");
    @(negedge clock); tx_ready = 1; await_error_request(30);
    if (done_req_count != 1) $fatal(1, "Error request overtook pending done request");
    receive(ERROR_RSP); await_exit(1);
    if (error_req_count != 1 || done_rsp_count != 0 || error_rsp_count != 0)
      $fatal(1, "Stalled residency timeout repeated packets");

    // 8 ms timeout is measured from accepted local request, never its enqueue.
    // Exercise both zero-to-one clamp and the nested cycle/us counter.
    for (int cycles = 0; cycles <= 2; cycles++) begin
      int elapsed;
      begin_case(1, 32'(cycles)); tick(30);
      if (train_error) $fatal(1, "Timeout ran before request acceptance");
      @(negedge clock); tx_ready = 1;
      while (error_req_count == 0) tick();
      elapsed = 0;
      while (!train_error && elapsed < 17000) begin tick(); elapsed++; end
      if (!train_error || elapsed < 8000 * ((cycles == 0) ? 1 : cycles) ||
          elapsed > 8000 * ((cycles == 0) ? 1 : cycles) + 3 || done || busy ||
          error_req_count != 1 || error_rsp_count != 0 || done_req_count != 0 || done_rsp_count != 0)
        $fatal(1, "Incorrect TRAINERROR timeout cycles/us=%0d elapsed=%0d", cycles, elapsed);
      scenarios++;
    end
    $display("PASS SpeedIdleRateChangeSpec_tb: %0d cases", scenarios);
    $finish;
  end
  initial begin #100000; $fatal(1, "Global timeout"); end
endmodule
`default_nettype wire

```

## [74] test\support\jtag_cfg_pkg.sv

```systemverilog
// FILE_INDEX: 74
// FILE_PATH : test\support\jtag_cfg_pkg.sv

/*   
*   JTAG TAP Configuration
*
*   Author: Alex R!
*/

package jtag_cfg_pkg;

	// JTAG IR REGISTER LENGTH
	localparam int unsigned JTAG_IR_WIDTH = 5;	// Minimum of 5 bits to satisfy RISC-V DEBUG SPEC !!!

	// TDRs ENUM

	//-------- RISCV DEBUG SPEC RESERVED IR CODES --------//
	//							 				  	      //
	//  0x00 -> BYPASS (VIA EXTEST)	| INTERNALLY MANAGED  //
	//  0x01 -> IDCODE			 	| INTERNALLY MANAGED  //
	//  0x02 -> BYPASS (VIA SAMPLE)	| INTERNALLY MANAGED  //
	//													  //
	//  0x03 to 0x0F -> **** FREE **** (13 OPCODES)	      //
	//  0x10 -> RISC-V DTMCS     				  	      //
	//  0x11 -> RISC-V DMI	    				  	      //
	//  0x12 to 0x17 -> RESERVED (ROUTED TO BYPASS)	      //
	//  0x18 to 0x1E -> **** FREE **** (7 OPCODES) 	      //
	//													  //
	//  0x1F -> BYPASS				| INTERNALLY MANAGED  //
	//----------------------------------------------------//

	typedef enum logic [(JTAG_IR_WIDTH - 1) : 0] {
		BYPASS_0	= 'h00, 
		IDCODE 		= 'h01,
		TDR_SNAP 	= 'h03,
		TDR_STEP 	= 'h04,
		RV_DTMCS 	= 'h10,
		RV_DMI		= 'h11,
		BYPASS_1   	= 'h1f
	} tdr_id_t;

	// JTAG ID CODE (FOR NOW SAME AS XHEEP 32'h1000_1C05)
	localparam logic [10:0] JTAG_IDCODE_MAN_NUM 	= 11'h602;	
	localparam logic [15:0] JTAG_IDCODE_PART_NUM 	= 16'h0001;
	localparam logic [3:0]  JTAG_IDCODE_VER_NUM		= 4'h1;

	localparam logic [31:0]  JTAG_IDCODE_VALUE	= {
		JTAG_IDCODE_VER_NUM,
		JTAG_IDCODE_PART_NUM,
		JTAG_IDCODE_MAN_NUM,
		1'b1
	};

endpackage
```

## [75] test\support\jtag_tap.sv

```systemverilog
// FILE_INDEX: 75
// FILE_PATH : test\support\jtag_tap.sv

/* Copyright 2018 ETH Zurich and University of Bologna.
* Copyright and related rights are licensed under the Solderpad Hardware
* License, Version 0.51 (the “License”); you may not use this file except in
* compliance with the License.  You may obtain a copy of the License at
* http://solderpad.org/licenses/SHL-0.51. Unless required by applicable law
* or agreed to in writing, software, hardware and materials distributed under
* this License is distributed on an “AS IS” BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR
* CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied. See the License for the
* specific language governing permissions and limitations under the License.
*
* File:   dmi_jtag_tap.sv
* Author: Florian Zaruba <zarubaf@iis.ee.ethz.ch>
* Date:   19.7.2018
*
* Description: JTAG TAP for DMI (according to debug spec 0.13)
*
* Modified by: Alex R!
*/

module jtag_tap 
	import jtag_cfg_pkg::*;
(
	// JTAG PORT
	input  logic	jtag_nRst,  // JTAG test reset pad

	input  logic	tck,    	// JTAG test clock pad
	input  logic	tms,    	// JTAG test mode select pad
	input  logic	tdi,     	// JTAG test data input pad
	output logic	tdo,     	// JTAG test data output pad
	output logic	tdo_en, 	// Data out output enable
	input  logic	testmode_i,

	// TDR COMMON BUS
	output logic	tdr_rst,
	output logic	tdr_tck,
	output logic	tdr_tdi,
	output logic	tdr_update,
	output logic	tdr_capture,
	output logic	tdr_shift,

	// TDRs
	output logic	dtmcs_sel,
	input  logic	dtmcs_tdo,

	output logic	dmi_sel,
	input  logic	dmi_tdo,

	output logic 	tdr_snap_sel,
	input  logic 	tdr_snap_tdo,

	output logic 	tdr_step_sel,
	input  logic 	tdr_step_tdo
);
	// ------------------------------------------------------------------------
	// TYPEDEFS
	// ------------------------------------------------------------------------

	typedef enum logic [3:0] {
		TestLogicReset, 
		RunTestIdle, 
		SelectDrScan,
		CaptureDr, 
		ShiftDr, 
		Exit1Dr, 
		PauseDr, 
		Exit2Dr,
		UpdateDr, 
		SelectIrScan, 
		CaptureIr, 
		ShiftIr,
		Exit1Ir,
		PauseIr, 
		Exit2Ir, 
		UpdateIr
	} tap_state_e;

	// ------------------------------------------------------------------------
	// SIGNALS
	// ------------------------------------------------------------------------

	// FSM state
	tap_state_e tap_state_q, tap_state_d;

	// DR signals
	logic update_dr, shift_dr, capture_dr;

	// IR signals
	logic capture_ir, shift_ir, update_ir, test_logic_reset; // pause_ir

	// IR shift register
	logic [(JTAG_IR_WIDTH - 1) : 0]  jtag_ir_shift_d, jtag_ir_shift_q;

	// IR shadow register -> captured from shift register upon update_ir
	tdr_id_t jtag_ir_d, jtag_ir_q;

	// IDCODE and BYPASS Regs
	logic [31:0] idcode_d, idcode_q;  // 32-bits
	logic        bypass_d, bypass_q;  // 1-bit

	// Internal TDR sel
	logic idcode_sel;
	logic bypass_sel;

	// TDO mux out
	logic tdo_mux;

	// TDO output reg clock
	logic tck_n;

	// ------------------------------------------------------------------------
	// IR LOGIC
	// ------------------------------------------------------------------------

	always_comb begin : p_jtag
		jtag_ir_shift_d = jtag_ir_shift_q;
		jtag_ir_d       = jtag_ir_q;

		// IR shift register
		if (shift_ir) begin
			jtag_ir_shift_d = {tdi, jtag_ir_shift_q[(JTAG_IR_WIDTH - 1) : 1]};
		end

		// capture IR register
		if (capture_ir) begin
			jtag_ir_shift_d =  JTAG_IR_WIDTH'(4'b0101);
		end

		// update IR register
		if (update_ir) begin
			jtag_ir_d = tdr_id_t'(jtag_ir_shift_q);
		end

		if (test_logic_reset) begin
			// Bring all TAP state to the initial value.
			jtag_ir_shift_d = '0;
			jtag_ir_d = IDCODE;
		end
	end

	always_ff @(posedge tck, negedge jtag_nRst) begin : p_jtag_ir_reg
		if (!jtag_nRst) begin
			jtag_ir_shift_q <= '0;
			jtag_ir_q       <= IDCODE;
		end else begin
			jtag_ir_shift_q <= jtag_ir_shift_d;
			jtag_ir_q       <= jtag_ir_d;
		end
	end

	// ------------------------------------------------------------------------
	// DR INTERNAL REGS
	// ------------------------------------------------------------------------

	always_comb begin
		idcode_d = idcode_q;
		bypass_d = bypass_q;

		if (capture_dr) begin
			if (idcode_sel) idcode_d = JTAG_IDCODE_VALUE;
			if (bypass_sel) bypass_d = 1'b0;
		end

		if (shift_dr) begin
			if (idcode_sel) idcode_d = {tdi, 31'(idcode_q >> 1)};
			if (bypass_sel) bypass_d = tdi;
		end

		if (test_logic_reset) begin
			// Bring all TAP state to the initial value.
			idcode_d = JTAG_IDCODE_VALUE;
			bypass_d = 1'b0;
		end
	end

	// ------------------------------------------------------------------------
	// TDR SELECT
	// ------------------------------------------------------------------------

	always_comb begin : p_data_reg_sel
		dtmcs_sel 		= 1'b0;
		dmi_sel   		= 1'b0;
		tdr_snap_sel 	= 1'b0;
		tdr_step_sel 	= 1'b0;
		idcode_sel  	= 1'b0;
		bypass_sel  	= 1'b0;

		unique case (jtag_ir_q)
			BYPASS_0:	bypass_sel		= 1'b1;
			IDCODE:    	idcode_sel  	= 1'b1;

			TDR_SNAP:	tdr_snap_sel 	= 1'b1;
			TDR_STEP:	tdr_step_sel 	= 1'b1;

			RV_DTMCS:	dtmcs_sel 		= 1'b1;
			RV_DMI: 	dmi_sel   		= 1'b1;

			BYPASS_1:   bypass_sel  	= 1'b1;

			default:	bypass_sel  	= 1'b1;
		endcase
	end

	// ------------------------------------------------------------------------
	// TDO MUX
	// ------------------------------------------------------------------------

	always_comb begin : p_out_sel
		if (shift_ir) begin
			// IR Register Shift
			tdo_mux = jtag_ir_shift_q[0];
	
		end else begin
			// DR Register Shift
			unique case (jtag_ir_q)
				IDCODE:         tdo_mux 	= idcode_q[0];		// Reading ID code

				TDR_SNAP:		tdo_mux 	= tdr_snap_tdo;
				TDR_STEP:		tdo_mux 	= tdr_step_tdo;

				RV_DTMCS:       tdo_mux 	= dtmcs_tdo;   		// Read from DTMCS TDO
				RV_DMI:      	tdo_mux 	= dmi_tdo;			// Read from DMI TDO

				default:        tdo_mux 	= bypass_q;			// BYPASS instruction
			endcase
		end
	end

	// ------------------------------------------------------------------------
	// TDO REGISTER
	// ------------------------------------------------------------------------
	
	tc_clk_inverter i_tck_inv (
		.clk_i ( tck  ),
		.clk_o ( tck_n )
	);

	// TDO changes state at negative edge of TCK
	always_ff @(posedge tck_n, negedge jtag_nRst) begin : p_tdo_regs
		if (!jtag_nRst) begin
			tdo     <= 1'b0;
			tdo_en <= 1'b0;
		end else begin
			tdo     <= tdo_mux;
			tdo_en <= (shift_ir | shift_dr);
		end
	end

	// ------------------------------------------------------------------------
	// TAP FSM
	// ------------------------------------------------------------------------

	// Determination of next state; purely combinatorial
	always_comb begin : p_tap_fsm

		test_logic_reset   = 1'b0;

		capture_dr         = 1'b0;
		shift_dr           = 1'b0;
		update_dr          = 1'b0;

		capture_ir         = 1'b0;
		shift_ir           = 1'b0;
		// pause_ir           = 1'b0; unused
		update_ir          = 1'b0;

		unique case (tap_state_q)
			TestLogicReset: begin
				tap_state_d = (tms) ? TestLogicReset : RunTestIdle;
				test_logic_reset = 1'b1;
			end
			RunTestIdle: begin
				tap_state_d = (tms) ? SelectDrScan : RunTestIdle;
			end
			// DR Path
			SelectDrScan: begin
				tap_state_d = (tms) ? SelectIrScan : CaptureDr;
			end
			CaptureDr: begin
				capture_dr = 1'b1;
				tap_state_d = (tms) ? Exit1Dr : ShiftDr;
			end
			ShiftDr: begin
				shift_dr = 1'b1;
				tap_state_d = (tms) ? Exit1Dr : ShiftDr;
			end
			Exit1Dr: begin
				tap_state_d = (tms) ? UpdateDr : PauseDr;
			end
			PauseDr: begin
				tap_state_d = (tms) ? Exit2Dr : PauseDr;
			end
			Exit2Dr: begin
				tap_state_d = (tms) ? UpdateDr : ShiftDr;
			end
			UpdateDr: begin
				update_dr = 1'b1;
				tap_state_d = (tms) ? SelectDrScan : RunTestIdle;
			end
			// IR Path
			SelectIrScan: begin
				tap_state_d = (tms) ? TestLogicReset : CaptureIr;
			end
			// In this controller state, the shift register bank in the
			// Instruction Register parallel loads a pattern of fixed values on
			// the rising edge of TCK. The last two significant bits must always
			// be "01".
			CaptureIr: begin
				capture_ir = 1'b1;
				tap_state_d = (tms) ? Exit1Ir : ShiftIr;
			end
			// In this controller state, the instruction register gets connected
			// between TDI and TDO, and the captured pattern gets shifted on
			// each rising edge of TCK. The instruction available on the TDI
			// pin is also shifted in to the instruction register.
			ShiftIr: begin
				shift_ir = 1'b1;
				tap_state_d = (tms) ? Exit1Ir : ShiftIr;
			end
			Exit1Ir: begin
				tap_state_d = (tms) ? UpdateIr : PauseIr;
			end
			PauseIr: begin
				// pause_ir = 1'b1; // unused
				tap_state_d = (tms) ? Exit2Ir : PauseIr;
			end
			Exit2Ir: begin
				tap_state_d = (tms) ? UpdateIr : ShiftIr;
			end
			// In this controller state, the instruction in the instruction
			// shift register is latched to the latch bank of the Instruction
			// Register on every falling edge of TCK. This instruction becomes
			// the current instruction once it is latched.
			UpdateIr: begin
				update_ir = 1'b1;
				tap_state_d = (tms) ? SelectDrScan : RunTestIdle;
			end
			default: ; // can't actually happen since case is full
		endcase
	end

	always_ff @(posedge tck or negedge jtag_nRst) begin : p_regs
		if (!jtag_nRst) begin
			tap_state_q <= TestLogicReset;
			idcode_q    <= JTAG_IDCODE_VALUE;
			bypass_q    <= 1'b0;
		end else begin
			tap_state_q <= tap_state_d;
			idcode_q    <= idcode_d;
			bypass_q    <= bypass_d;
		end
	end

	// ------------------------------------------------------------------------
	// PASSTHROUGH SIGNALS
	// ------------------------------------------------------------------------

	assign tdr_tck 		= tck;
	assign tdr_tdi 		= tdi;
	assign tdr_update	= update_dr;
	assign tdr_shift 	= shift_dr;
	assign tdr_capture 	= capture_dr;
	assign tdr_rst 		= test_logic_reset;


endmodule : jtag_tap

```

<a id="test-TrainingRestartSpec_tb-sv"></a>

## [78] test\TrainingRestartSpec_tb.sv

```systemverilog
// FILE_INDEX: 78
// FILE_PATH : test\TrainingRestartSpec_tb.sv

`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

// Real peer-to-peer calibration exchanges, repeated without reset. Checking
// every request/response and analog calibration request catches a stale DONE
// shortcut that a test observing only terminal states would miss.
module TrainingRestartSpec_tb;
  import SidebandMsgGenerator_pkg::*;
  logic clock = 1'b0;
  always #5 clock = ~clock;
  logic reset_n = 1'b0;
  logic start = 1'b0;
  wire [1:0] tx_done, tx_error, tx_valid, rx_done, rx_error, rx_valid;
  wire [1:0] calibrate, calibration_done;
  wire [127:0] tx_packet [0:1], rx_packet [0:1];
  logic [2:0] calibration_delay [0:1];
  logic [1:0] previous_calibrate;
  int tx_req_count [0:1], tx_resp_count [0:1];
  int rx_start_req_count [0:1], rx_start_resp_count [0:1];
  int rx_done_req_count [0:1], rx_done_resp_count [0:1];
  int calibration_count [0:1];

  for (genvar die = 0; die < 2; die++) begin : g_peer
    MBTrainTxSelfCalFSM tx_self_cal (
      .clock(clock), .reset_n(reset_n), .start(start),
      .busy(), .done(tx_done[die]), .trainError(tx_error[die]),
      .sb_tx_ready(1'b1), .sb_tx_valid(tx_valid[die]), .sb_tx_din(tx_packet[die]),
      .sb_rx_valid(tx_valid[1-die]), .sb_rx_dout(tx_packet[1-die]),
      .dbg_senderState(), .dbg_receiverState()
    );
    MBTrainRxClkCalFSM rx_clock_cal (
      .clock(clock), .reset_n(reset_n), .start(start),
      .busy(), .done(rx_done[die]), .trainError(rx_error[die]),
      .sb_tx_ready(1'b1), .sb_tx_valid(rx_valid[die]), .sb_tx_din(rx_packet[die]),
      .sb_rx_valid(rx_valid[1-die]), .sb_rx_dout(rx_packet[1-die]),
      .flagToAnalog_rxClkCalDoCalibration(calibrate[die]),
      .flagFromAnalog_rxClkCalDone(calibration_done[die]),
      .flagToAnalog_rxClkCalSendClockTrack(), .dbg_senderState(), .dbg_receiverState()
    );
    assign calibration_done[die] = calibration_delay[die][2];

    always_ff @(posedge clock or negedge reset_n) begin
      if (!reset_n) begin
        calibration_delay[die] <= '0;
        previous_calibrate[die] <= 1'b0;
        calibration_count[die] <= 0;
        tx_req_count[die] <= 0;
        tx_resp_count[die] <= 0;
        rx_start_req_count[die] <= 0;
        rx_start_resp_count[die] <= 0;
        rx_done_req_count[die] <= 0;
        rx_done_resp_count[die] <= 0;
      end else begin
        previous_calibrate[die] <= calibrate[die];
        calibration_delay[die] <= {calibration_delay[die][1:0],
                                   calibrate[die] && !previous_calibrate[die]};
        if (calibrate[die] && !previous_calibrate[die])
          calibration_count[die] <= calibration_count[die] + 1;
        if (tx_valid[die]) begin
          if (tx_packet[die] == msgMbtrainTxSelfCalDoneReq(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY))
            tx_req_count[die] <= tx_req_count[die] + 1;
          else if (tx_packet[die] == msgMbtrainTxSelfCalDoneResp(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY))
            tx_resp_count[die] <= tx_resp_count[die] + 1;
          else $fatal(1, "Unexpected TXSELFCAL packet die=%0d", die);
        end
        if (rx_valid[die]) begin
          if (rx_packet[die] == msgMbtrainRxClkCalStartReq(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY))
            rx_start_req_count[die] <= rx_start_req_count[die] + 1;
          else if (rx_packet[die] == msgMbtrainRxClkCalStartResp(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY))
            rx_start_resp_count[die] <= rx_start_resp_count[die] + 1;
          else if (rx_packet[die] == msgMbtrainRxClkCalDoneReq(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY))
            rx_done_req_count[die] <= rx_done_req_count[die] + 1;
          else if (rx_packet[die] == msgMbtrainRxClkCalDoneResp(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY))
            rx_done_resp_count[die] <= rx_done_resp_count[die] + 1;
          else $fatal(1, "Unexpected RXCLKCAL packet die=%0d", die);
        end
        if (|tx_error || |rx_error) $fatal(1, "Calibration reported an error");
      end
    end
  end

  task automatic run_training(input int run_number);
    int cycles;
    @(negedge clock);
    start = 1'b1;
    @(negedge clock);
    if (|tx_done || |rx_done)
      $fatal(1, "Sticky DONE was not cleared on restart %0d", run_number);
    cycles = 0;
    while (!( &tx_done && &rx_done )) begin
      if (++cycles > 100)
        $fatal(1, "Calibration restart %0d timed out", run_number);
      @(negedge clock);
    end
    // Keep start asserted as the parent does while observing completion.
    repeat (3) @(negedge clock);
    for (int die = 0; die < 2; die++) begin
      if (tx_req_count[die] != run_number || tx_resp_count[die] != run_number ||
          rx_start_req_count[die] != run_number || rx_start_resp_count[die] != run_number ||
          rx_done_req_count[die] != run_number || rx_done_resp_count[die] != run_number ||
          calibration_count[die] != run_number)
        $fatal(1, "Skipped/repeated exchange on run=%0d die=%0d: TX=%0d/%0d RX=%0d/%0d/%0d/%0d analog=%0d",
          run_number, die, tx_req_count[die], tx_resp_count[die],
          rx_start_req_count[die], rx_start_resp_count[die],
          rx_done_req_count[die], rx_done_resp_count[die], calibration_count[die]);
    end
    start = 1'b0;
    repeat (3) @(negedge clock);
  endtask

  initial begin
    repeat (3) @(negedge clock);
    reset_n = 1'b1;
    run_training(1);
    run_training(2);
    run_training(3);
    $display("PASS TrainingRestartSpec_tb: three complete TXSELFCAL/RXCLKCAL peer exchanges and analog calibrations without reset");
    $finish;
  end
endmodule

`default_nettype wire
```

<a id="test-Ucie8GHzBringUpFallbackSpec_tb-sv"></a>

## [79] test\Ucie8GHzBringUpFallbackSpec_tb.sv

```systemverilog
// FILE_INDEX: 79
// FILE_PATH : test\Ucie8GHzBringUpFallbackSpec_tb.sv

// Dedicated full serial bring-up: fail lane 0 at 8 GHz, then retrain at 6 GHz.
// Two real digital dies communicate through the existing one-bit sideband
// serializers/CDC. The behavioral PHY reports FFFE only at speed code 3 on
// die0's receiver; it reports FFFF at code 2. No DUT state/rate is forced.
// The GHz labels denote requested PHY settings, not simulated analog clocks.
// Compile the shared harness and D2DAdapterLinkMgmtLtsmDualDieBringUpSpec_tb
// before this file, or use scripts/run_tests.sh Ucie8GHzBringUpFallbackSpec_tb.
`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

module Ucie8GHzBringUpFallbackSpec_tb #(
  parameter bit TEST_MODE_DIGITAL = 1'b0
);
  import SidebandMsgGenerator_pkg::*;

  D2DAdapterLinkMgmtLtsmDualDieBringUpSpec_tb #(
    .LINK_SPEED_FAIL_TOP_RATE_MASK(2'b01),
    .LINK_SPEED_FAIL_ALL_RATES(1'b0),
    .TEST_MODE_DIGITAL(TEST_MODE_DIGITAL)
  ) scenario ();

  wire clock = scenario.clock;
  wire reset_n = scenario.reset_n;
  wire [1:0] tx_fire = {
    scenario.dut.mon_die1_tx_valid && scenario.dut.mon_die1_tx_ready,
    scenario.dut.mon_die0_tx_valid && scenario.dut.mon_die0_tx_ready};
  wire [1:0] rx_fire = {
    scenario.dut.mon_die1_rx_valid && scenario.dut.mon_die1_rx_ready,
    scenario.dut.mon_die0_rx_valid && scenario.dut.mon_die0_rx_ready};
  wire [127:0] tx_message [0:1];
  wire [127:0] rx_message [0:1];
  assign tx_message[0] = scenario.dut.mon_die0_tx_msg;
  assign tx_message[1] = scenario.dut.mon_die1_tx_msg;
  assign rx_message[0] = scenario.dut.mon_die0_rx_msg;
  assign rx_message[1] = scenario.dut.mon_die1_rx_msg;
  // The child completes a local send when the pulse-capture queue accepts it.
  // The downstream serializer tap can lag under backpressure. Observe both:
  // capture for local apply ordering, serializer TX/RX for eventual delivery.
  wire [1:0] capture_fire;
  wire [127:0] capture_message [0:1];
  assign capture_fire[0] = scenario.dut.die0.sb_mon_ltsm_enqueue;
  assign capture_fire[1] = scenario.dut.die1.sb_mon_ltsm_enqueue;
  assign capture_message[0] = scenario.dut.die0.sb_mon_ltsm_enqueue_msg;
  assign capture_message[1] = scenario.dut.die1.sb_mon_ltsm_enqueue_msg;
  wire [1:0] applied = {
    scenario.dut.die1.ltsm_flagFromAnalog_linkSpeed_speedApplied,
    scenario.dut.die0.ltsm_flagFromAnalog_linkSpeed_speedApplied};
  wire [1:0] calibrate_rx = {
    scenario.dut.die1.ltsm_flagToAnalog_rxClkCal_doCalibration,
    scenario.dut.die0.ltsm_flagToAnalog_rxClkCal_doCalibration};

  localparam logic [127:0] ERROR_REQ =
    msgMbtrainLinkSpeedErrorReq(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY);
  localparam logic [127:0] ERROR_RESP =
    msgMbtrainLinkSpeedErrorResp(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY);
  localparam logic [127:0] DEGRADE_REQ =
    msgMbtrainLinkSpeedExitToSpeedDegradeReq(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY);
  localparam logic [127:0] DEGRADE_RESP =
    msgMbtrainLinkSpeedExitToSpeedDegradeResp(ENDPOINT_PHY, ENDPOINT_REMOTE_PHY);
  localparam logic [15:0] REQUIRED_RATE_STAGES = 16'h1ff8; // SPEEDIDLE..LINKSPEED

  // Event bit 0=ERROR request, 1=ERROR response, 2=DEGRADE request, 3=response.
  // Each direction is checked at both TX acceptance and actual serial RX.
  bit [3:0] tx_events [0:1], rx_events [0:1], capture_events [0:1];
  bit [15:0] stages [0:1][0:1]; // rate index 0=8 GHz, 1=6 GHz
  bit [10:0] training_packets [0:1][0:1];
  bit result_seen [0:1][0:1], rx_calibrated [0:1][0:1];
  logic [3:0] previous_stage [0:1];
  logic [1:0] previous_apply, previous_applied;
  bit checked_active;

  function automatic int event_index(input logic [127:0] message);
    if (message == ERROR_REQ) return 0;
    if (message == ERROR_RESP) return 1;
    if (message == DEGRADE_REQ) return 2;
    if (message == DEGRADE_RESP) return 3;
    return -1;
  endfunction

  function automatic string event_name(input int index);
    case (index)
      0: return "LINKSPEED ERROR request";
      1: return "LINKSPEED ERROR response";
      2: return "LINKSPEED speed-degrade request";
      3: return "LINKSPEED speed-degrade response";
      default: return "unknown";
    endcase
  endfunction

  function automatic string stage_name(input logic [3:0] stage);
    case (stage)
      3: return "SPEEDIDLE";
      4: return "TXSELFCAL";
      5: return "RXCLKCAL";
      6: return "VALTRAINCENTER";
      7: return "VALTRAINVREF";
      8: return "DATATRAINCENTER1";
      9: return "DATATRAINVREF";
      10: return "RXDESKEW";
      11: return "DATATRAINCENTER2";
      12: return "LINKSPEED";
      default: return "other";
    endcase
  endfunction

  // Fresh stage protocol traffic prevents a bare state-visit mask from passing
  // when sticky completion flags skip the actual second calibration/sweep.
  function automatic int training_packet_index(input logic [127:0] message);
    if (message[4:0] != 5'h12 || message[21:14] != 8'hb5) return -1;
    case (message[39:32])
      8'h05: return 0; // TXSELFCAL done
      8'h06: return 1; // RXCLKCAL start
      8'h07: return 2; // RXCLKCAL done
      8'h08: return 3; // VALTRAINCENTER start
      8'h09: return 4; // VALTRAINCENTER done
      8'h0c: return 5; // DATATRAINCENTER1 start
      8'h0d: return 6; // DATATRAINCENTER1 end
      8'h13: return 7; // DATATRAINCENTER2 start
      8'h14: return 8; // DATATRAINCENTER2 end
      8'h15: return 9; // LINKSPEED start
      8'h19: return 10; // LINKSPEED done (only expected at 6 GHz)
      default: return -1;
    endcase
  endfunction

  initial $display("SCENARIO: 8 GHz first attempt fails lane 0; expect ERROR -> DEGRADE -> 6 GHz retraining -> Active");

  // Blocking scoreboard updates make same-cycle events visible to later checks
  // within this passive monitor. Stimulus and DUT registers are not modified.
  always @(posedge clock or negedge reset_n) begin : monitor
    int rate, event_id, packet_id;
    if (!reset_n) begin
      previous_apply = '0;
      previous_applied = '0;
      checked_active = 1'b0;
      for (int die = 0; die < 2; die++) begin
        tx_events[die] = '0;
        rx_events[die] = '0;
        capture_events[die] = '0;
        previous_stage[die] = '0;
        for (int r = 0; r < 2; r++) begin
          stages[die][r] = '0;
          training_packets[die][r] = '0;
          result_seen[die][r] = 1'b0;
          rx_calibrated[die][r] = 1'b0;
        end
      end
    end else begin
      for (int die = 0; die < 2; die++) begin
        rate = (scenario.observedSpeedCode[die] == 2'd2) ? 1 : 0;
        if (scenario.observedSpeedCode[die] inside {2'd2, 2'd3}) begin
          stages[die][rate] |= 16'h1 << scenario.observedMbtrainState[die];
          if (calibrate_rx[die]) rx_calibrated[die][rate] = 1'b1;
          if (scenario.observedMbtrainState[die] != previous_stage[die] &&
              scenario.observedMbtrainState[die] inside {[4'd3:4'd12]})
            $display("FALLBACK cycle=%0d die%0d %0d GHz enter %s",
              scenario.elapsedCycles, die, rate ? 6 : 8,
              stage_name(scenario.observedMbtrainState[die]));
        end

        if (rx_fire[die]) begin
          event_id = event_index(rx_message[die]);
          if (event_id >= 0) begin
            if (rx_events[die][event_id] || ((event_id % 2) != die))
              $fatal(1, "Duplicate/wrong-direction fallback RX event die%0d index%0d", die, event_id);
            rx_events[die][event_id] = 1'b1;
            $display("FALLBACK cycle=%0d die%0d RX %s", scenario.elapsedCycles, die, event_name(event_id));
          end
          if (scenario.observedMbtrainState[die] == 4'hc &&
              rx_message[die][4:0] == 5'h1b &&
              rx_message[die][21:14] == 8'h8a && rx_message[die][39:32] == 8'h03) begin
            if (result_seen[die][rate]) $fatal(1, "Duplicate LINKSPEED result");
            if (rate == 0 && die == 1) begin
              if (rx_message[die][55:40] !== 16'h0020 || rx_message[die][127:64] !== 64'hfffe)
                $fatal(1, "8 GHz failure did not reach die1 over the serial link");
              $display("FALLBACK cycle=%0d die1 8 GHz result FAIL: lane0 failed, bitmap=FFFE", scenario.elapsedCycles);
            end else begin
              if (rx_message[die][55:40] !== 16'h0030 || rx_message[die][127:64] !== 64'hffff)
                $fatal(1, "Expected all lanes to pass at die%0d rate index%0d", die, rate);
              $display("FALLBACK cycle=%0d die%0d %0d GHz result PASS: bitmap=FFFF", scenario.elapsedCycles, die, rate ? 6 : 8);
            end
            result_seen[die][rate] = 1'b1;
          end
        end

        if (capture_fire[die]) begin
          event_id = event_index(capture_message[die]);
          if (event_id >= 0) begin
            if (capture_events[die][event_id]) $fatal(1, "Duplicate queued fallback event");
            capture_events[die][event_id] = 1'b1;
          end
        end

        if (tx_fire[die]) begin
          packet_id = training_packet_index(tx_message[die]);
          if (packet_id >= 0) training_packets[die][rate][packet_id] = 1'b1;
          event_id = event_index(tx_message[die]);
          if (event_id >= 0) begin
            if (tx_events[die][event_id] || ((event_id % 2) == die))
              $fatal(1, "Duplicate/wrong-direction fallback TX event die%0d index%0d", die, event_id);
            if (event_id == 0 && !result_seen[1][0])
              $fatal(1, "ERROR sent before the failed result was received");
            if (event_id == 1 && !rx_events[0][0])
              $fatal(1, "ERROR response before request");
            if (event_id == 2 && !rx_events[1][1])
              $fatal(1, "Speed degrade requested before ERROR completed");
            if (event_id == 3 && (!rx_events[0][2] || !tx_events[0][1]))
              $fatal(1, "Speed degrade response out of order");
            tx_events[die][event_id] = 1'b1;
            $display("FALLBACK cycle=%0d die%0d TX %s", scenario.elapsedCycles, die, event_name(event_id));
          end
        end

        if (scenario.observedSpeedApply[die] && !previous_apply[die]) begin
          if (rate == 1 && ((capture_events[die] | rx_events[die]) != 4'hf))
            $fatal(1, "Die%0d applied lower speed before completing local ERROR/DEGRADE obligations", die);
          $display("FALLBACK cycle=%0d die%0d PHY apply %0d GHz (code=%b)",
            scenario.elapsedCycles, die, rate ? 6 : 8, scenario.observedSpeedCode[die]);
        end
        if (applied[die] && !previous_applied[die])
          $display("FALLBACK cycle=%0d die%0d PHY acknowledges %0d GHz", scenario.elapsedCycles, die, rate ? 6 : 8);
        previous_stage[die] = scenario.observedMbtrainState[die];
      end
      previous_apply = scenario.observedSpeedApply;
      previous_applied = applied;

      if (scenario.all_active && !checked_active) begin
        for (int die = 0; die < 2; die++) begin
          if ((tx_events[die] | rx_events[die]) != 4'hf)
            $fatal(1, "Missing ERROR/DEGRADE protocol event");
          for (int r = 0; r < 2; r++) begin
            if ((stages[die][r] & REQUIRED_RATE_STAGES) != REQUIRED_RATE_STAGES ||
                !result_seen[die][r] || !rx_calibrated[die][r] ||
                training_packets[die][r][9:0] != 10'h3ff)
              $fatal(1, "Incomplete actual training die%0d rate index%0d: stages=%h packets=%h", die, r, stages[die][r], training_packets[die][r]);
          end
          if (!training_packets[die][1][10]) $fatal(1, "Missing lower-speed LINKSPEED done request");
        end
        checked_active = 1'b1;
        $display("PASS: Ucie8GHzBringUpFallbackSpec: 8 GHz failed, ERROR/DEGRADE exchanged, both dies retrained and reached Active at 6 GHz");
      end
    end
  end

  // The reused scenario owns timeout, final serial drain and $finish. Ensure
  // its success cannot accidentally bypass this dedicated scenario's checks.
  final begin
    assert (checked_active) else $error("Dedicated speed-fallback checks did not complete");
  end
endmodule

`default_nettype wire
```

<a id="test-UcieCodeWidthSpec_tb-sv"></a>

## [80] test\UcieCodeWidthSpec_tb.sv

```systemverilog
// FILE_INDEX: 80
// FILE_PATH : test\UcieCodeWidthSpec_tb.sv

`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

// Wiring contract test, not a substitute for analog training or CDC signoff.
// Force only the MBTrain output boundary so the real LTSM/Core/Top/TopJtag
// wiring and packed capture fields carry walking-one patterns in every bit.
module UcieCodeWidthSpec_tb;
  UcieDigitalTopJtag dut (
    .clock(1'b0), .reset_n(1'b0), .jtag_nRst(1'b0), .tdr_rst(1'b0),
    .tdr_tck(1'b0), .tdr_tdi(1'b0), .tdr_capture(1'b0),
    .tdr_shift(1'b0), .tdr_update(1'b0),
    .sel_ctrl(1'b0), .sel_dig(1'b0), .sel_fdi(1'b0),
    .sel_rdi(1'b0), .sel_ltsm(1'b0), .sel_phy(1'b0),
    .ltsm_linkSpeed_requestedSpeed(requested_speed),
    .ltsm_flagFromAnalog_linkSpeed_speedApplied(speed_applied)
  );
  // Standalone instances ensure that a parent's explicit parameter forwarding
  // cannot mask stale defaults in either lower-level top module. A reduced
  // sweep count must still preserve the physical 20-bit interface.
  UcieDigitalCore #(.validVrefValueCount(4), .dataVrefValueCount(4),
                   .rxDeskewValueCount(4)) standalone_core (
    .clock(1'b0), .reset_n(1'b0), .testModeFdi(1'b0),
    .testModeRdi(1'b0), .testModeLtsm(1'b0)
  );
  UcieDigitalTop standalone_top (
    .clock(1'b0), .reset_n(1'b0), .testModeDigital(1'b0),
    .testModeFdi(1'b0), .testModeRdi(1'b0), .testModeLtsm(1'b0),
    .testModePhy(1'b0)
  );
  logic [19:0] valid_code = '0;
  logic [319:0] data_codes = '0;
  logic [319:0] rx_codes = '0;
  logic [37:0] phase_code = '0;
  logic [1279:0] tx_codes = '0;
  logic [7:0] mode_control = 8'h08;
  logic [1:0] requested_speed = 2'b0;
  logic speed_applied = 1'b0;
  logic [1:0] selected_speed = 2'b0;
  logic apply_speed = 1'b0, electrical_idle = 1'b0;
  logic [1:0] digital_requested_speed = 2'b0, ltsm_requested_speed = 2'b0;
  logic digital_speed_applied = 1'b0, ltsm_speed_applied = 1'b0;

  task automatic check_paths(input int mode);
    if (dut.ltsm_flagToAnalog_valVref_rxVrefCode !== (mode == 0 ? valid_code : 20'b0))
      $fatal(1, "Functional valVref_rxVrefCode mismatch mode=%0d", mode);
    if (dut.dig_out.ltsm_flagToAnalog_valVref_rxVrefCode !== (mode == 1 ? valid_code : 20'b0))
      $fatal(1, "Digital capture valVref_rxVrefCode mismatch mode=%0d", mode);
    if (dut.ltsm_out.flagToAnalog_valVref_rxVrefCode !== (mode == 4 ? valid_code : 20'b0))
      $fatal(1, "LTSM capture valVref_rxVrefCode mismatch mode=%0d", mode);
    if (dut.ltsm_flagToAnalog_dataVref_rxVrefCodes !== (mode == 0 ? data_codes : 320'b0))
      $fatal(1, "Functional dataVref_rxVrefCodes mismatch mode=%0d", mode);
    if (dut.dig_out.ltsm_flagToAnalog_dataVref_rxVrefCodes !== (mode == 1 ? data_codes : 320'b0))
      $fatal(1, "Digital capture dataVref_rxVrefCodes mismatch mode=%0d", mode);
    if (dut.ltsm_out.flagToAnalog_dataVref_rxVrefCodes !== (mode == 4 ? data_codes : 320'b0))
      $fatal(1, "LTSM capture dataVref_rxVrefCodes mismatch mode=%0d", mode);
    if (dut.ltsm_flagToAnalog_rxDeskew_rxLaneDeskewCodes !== (mode == 0 ? rx_codes : 320'b0))
      $fatal(1, "Functional rxDeskew_rxLaneDeskewCodes mismatch mode=%0d", mode);
    if (dut.dig_out.ltsm_flagToAnalog_rxDeskew_rxLaneDeskewCodes !== (mode == 1 ? rx_codes : 320'b0))
      $fatal(1, "Digital capture rxDeskew_rxLaneDeskewCodes mismatch mode=%0d", mode);
    if (dut.ltsm_out.flagToAnalog_rxDeskew_rxLaneDeskewCodes !== (mode == 4 ? rx_codes : 320'b0))
      $fatal(1, "LTSM capture rxDeskew_rxLaneDeskewCodes mismatch mode=%0d", mode);
    if (dut.ltsm_flagToAnalog_d2cSender_txClockPhaseCode !== (mode == 0 ? phase_code : 38'b0))
      $fatal(1, "Functional d2cSender_txClockPhaseCode mismatch mode=%0d", mode);
    if (dut.dig_out.ltsm_flagToAnalog_d2cSender_txClockPhaseCode !== (mode == 1 ? phase_code : 38'b0))
      $fatal(1, "Digital capture d2cSender_txClockPhaseCode mismatch mode=%0d", mode);
    if (dut.ltsm_out.flagToAnalog_d2cSender_txClockPhaseCode !== (mode == 4 ? phase_code : 38'b0))
      $fatal(1, "LTSM capture d2cSender_txClockPhaseCode mismatch mode=%0d", mode);
    if (dut.ltsm_flagToAnalog_d2cSender_txLaneDeskewCodes !== (mode == 0 ? tx_codes : 1280'b0))
      $fatal(1, "Functional d2cSender_txLaneDeskewCodes mismatch mode=%0d", mode);
    if (dut.dig_out.ltsm_flagToAnalog_d2cSender_txLaneDeskewCodes !== (mode == 1 ? tx_codes : 1280'b0))
      $fatal(1, "Digital capture d2cSender_txLaneDeskewCodes mismatch mode=%0d", mode);
    if (dut.ltsm_out.flagToAnalog_d2cSender_txLaneDeskewCodes !== (mode == 4 ? tx_codes : 1280'b0))
      $fatal(1, "LTSM capture d2cSender_txLaneDeskewCodes mismatch mode=%0d", mode);
  endtask

  task automatic check_speed_paths(input int mode);
    logic [1:0] expected_requested;
    logic expected_applied;
    expected_requested = mode == 1 ? digital_requested_speed :
                         mode == 4 ? ltsm_requested_speed : requested_speed;
    expected_applied = mode == 1 ? digital_speed_applied :
                       mode == 4 ? ltsm_speed_applied : speed_applied;
    if (dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm.linkSpeed_requestedSpeed !== expected_requested ||
        dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm.flagFromAnalog_linkSpeed_speedApplied !== expected_applied)
      $fatal(1, "Requested speed/analog acknowledgement input routing failed mode=%0d", mode);
    if ({dut.ltsm_flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_speedCode,
         dut.ltsm_flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_applySpeed,
         dut.ltsm_flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_electricalIdle} !==
        (mode == 0 ? {selected_speed, apply_speed, electrical_idle} : 4'b0))
      $fatal(1, "Functional speed-control output routing failed mode=%0d", mode);
    if ({dut.dig_out.ltsm_flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_speedCode,
         dut.dig_out.ltsm_flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_applySpeed,
         dut.dig_out.ltsm_flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_electricalIdle} !==
        (mode == 1 ? {selected_speed, apply_speed, electrical_idle} : 4'b0))
      $fatal(1, "Digital speed-control capture routing failed mode=%0d", mode);
    if ({dut.ltsm_out.flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_speedCode,
         dut.ltsm_out.flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_applySpeed,
         dut.ltsm_out.flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_electricalIdle} !==
        (mode == 4 ? {selected_speed, apply_speed, electrical_idle} : 4'b0))
      $fatal(1, "LTSM speed-control capture routing failed mode=%0d", mode);
  endtask

  initial begin
    if ($bits(dut.ltsm_linkSpeed_requestedSpeed) != 2 ||
        $bits(dut.ltsm_flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_speedCode) != 2 ||
        $bits(dut.u_top.ltsm_linkSpeed_requestedSpeed) != 2 ||
        $bits(dut.u_top.ltsm_flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_speedCode) != 2 ||
        $bits(dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm_linkSpeed_requestedSpeed) != 2 ||
        $bits(dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm_flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_speedCode) != 2 ||
        $bits(standalone_core.ltsm_linkSpeed_requestedSpeed) != 2 ||
        $bits(standalone_top.ltsm_flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_speedCode) != 2)
      $fatal(1, "Requested/selected speed must be two bits through every top");
    force dut.dig_in.ltsm_linkSpeed_requestedSpeed = digital_requested_speed;
    force dut.dig_in.ltsm_flagFromAnalog_linkSpeed_speedApplied = digital_speed_applied;
    force dut.ltsm_in.linkSpeed_requestedSpeed = ltsm_requested_speed;
    force dut.ltsm_in.flagFromAnalog_linkSpeed_speedApplied = ltsm_speed_applied;
    // Speed selection also occurs outside MBTRAIN, so force the aggregate
    // LTSM output boundary for this wiring-only test.
    force dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm.flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_speedCode = selected_speed;
    force dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm.flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_applySpeed = apply_speed;
    force dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm.flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_electricalIdle = electrical_idle;
    if ($bits(dut.ltsm_flagToAnalog_valVref_rxVrefCode) != 20)
      $fatal(1, "dut.valVref_rxVrefCode: wrong width");
    if ($bits(dut.ltsm_flagToAnalog_dataVref_rxVrefCodes) != 320)
      $fatal(1, "dut.dataVref_rxVrefCodes: wrong width");
    if ($bits(dut.ltsm_flagToAnalog_rxDeskew_rxLaneDeskewCodes) != 320)
      $fatal(1, "dut.rxDeskew_rxLaneDeskewCodes: wrong width");
    if ($bits(dut.ltsm_flagToAnalog_d2cSender_txClockPhaseCode) != 38)
      $fatal(1, "dut.d2cSender_txClockPhaseCode: wrong width");
    if ($bits(dut.ltsm_flagToAnalog_d2cSender_txLaneDeskewCodes) != 1280)
      $fatal(1, "dut.d2cSender_txLaneDeskewCodes: wrong width");
    if ($bits(dut.u_top.ltsm_flagToAnalog_valVref_rxVrefCode) != 20)
      $fatal(1, "dut.u_top.valVref_rxVrefCode: wrong width");
    if ($bits(dut.u_top.ltsm_flagToAnalog_dataVref_rxVrefCodes) != 320)
      $fatal(1, "dut.u_top.dataVref_rxVrefCodes: wrong width");
    if ($bits(dut.u_top.ltsm_flagToAnalog_rxDeskew_rxLaneDeskewCodes) != 320)
      $fatal(1, "dut.u_top.rxDeskew_rxLaneDeskewCodes: wrong width");
    if ($bits(dut.u_top.ltsm_flagToAnalog_d2cSender_txClockPhaseCode) != 38)
      $fatal(1, "dut.u_top.d2cSender_txClockPhaseCode: wrong width");
    if ($bits(dut.u_top.ltsm_flagToAnalog_d2cSender_txLaneDeskewCodes) != 1280)
      $fatal(1, "dut.u_top.d2cSender_txLaneDeskewCodes: wrong width");
    if ($bits(dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm_flagToAnalog_valVref_rxVrefCode) != 20)
      $fatal(1, "dut.u_top.u_core.valVref_rxVrefCode: wrong width");
    if ($bits(dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm_flagToAnalog_dataVref_rxVrefCodes) != 320)
      $fatal(1, "dut.u_top.u_core.dataVref_rxVrefCodes: wrong width");
    if ($bits(dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm_flagToAnalog_rxDeskew_rxLaneDeskewCodes) != 320)
      $fatal(1, "dut.u_top.u_core.rxDeskew_rxLaneDeskewCodes: wrong width");
    if ($bits(dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm_flagToAnalog_d2cSender_txClockPhaseCode) != 38)

    if ($bits(dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm_flagToAnalog_d2cSender_txLaneDeskewCodes) != 1280)

      $fatal(1, "standalone_core.valVref_rxVrefCode: wrong width");

      $fatal(1, "standalone_core.d2cSender_txLaneDeskewCodes: wrong width");
    if ($bits(standalone_top.ltsm_flagToAnalog_valVref_rxVrefCode) != 20)
      $fatal(1, "standalone_top.valVref_rxVrefCode: wrong width");
    if ($bits(standalone_top.ltsm_flagToAnalog_dataVref_rxVrefCodes) != 320)
      $fatal(1, "standalone_top.dataVref_rxVrefCodes: wrong width");
    if ($bits(standalone_top.ltsm_flagToAnalog_rxDeskew_rxLaneDeskewCodes) != 320)
      $fatal(1, "standalone_top.rxDeskew_rxLaneDeskewCodes: wrong width");
    if ($bits(standalone_top.ltsm_flagToAnalog_d2cSender_txClockPhaseCode) != 38)
      $fatal(1, "standalone_top.d2cSender_txClockPhaseCode: wrong width");
    if ($bits(standalone_top.ltsm_flagToAnalog_d2cSender_txLaneDeskewCodes) != 1280)
      $fatal(1, "standalone_top.d2cSender_txLaneDeskewCodes: wrong width");
    if ($bits(dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm.mbTrainFsm.flagToAnalog_valVref_rxVrefCode) != 20)
      $fatal(1, "MBTrain valVref_rxVrefCode: wrong width");
    if ($bits(dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm.mbTrainFsm.flagToAnalog_dataVref_rxVrefCodes) != 320)
      $fatal(1, "MBTrain dataVref_rxVrefCodes: wrong width");
    if ($bits(dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm.mbTrainFsm.flagToAnalog_rxDeskew_rxLaneDeskewCodes) != 320)
      $fatal(1, "MBTrain rxDeskew_rxLaneDeskewCodes: wrong width");
    if ($bits(dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm.mbTrainFsm.flagToAnalog_d2cSender_txClockPhaseCode) != 38)
      $fatal(1, "MBTrain d2cSender_txClockPhaseCode: wrong width");
    if ($bits(dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm.mbTrainFsm.flagToAnalog_d2cSender_txLaneDeskewCodes) != 1280)
      $fatal(1, "MBTrain d2cSender_txLaneDeskewCodes: wrong width");
    if (dut.DIG_IN_W != 232 || dut.DIG_OUT_W != 2557 ||
        dut.FDI_IN_W != 180 || dut.FDI_OUT_W != 151 ||
        dut.RDI_IN_W != 174 || dut.RDI_OUT_W != 141 ||
        dut.LTSM_IN_W != 318 || dut.LTSM_OUT_W != 2862)
      $fatal(1, "Default packed scan-map size changed; update host scan definitions");
    force dut.ctrl_q = mode_control;
    force dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm.mbTrainFsm.flagToAnalog_valVref_rxVrefCode = valid_code;
    force dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm.mbTrainFsm.flagToAnalog_dataVref_rxVrefCodes = data_codes;
    force dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm.mbTrainFsm.flagToAnalog_rxDeskew_rxLaneDeskewCodes = rx_codes;
    force dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm.mbTrainFsm.flagToAnalog_d2cSender_txClockPhaseCode = phase_code;
    force dut.u_top.u_core.ltsm.mbTrainFsm.flagToAnalog_d2cSender_txLaneDeskewCodes = tx_codes;
    for (int pass = 0; pass < 3; pass++) begin
      int mode;
      mode = pass == 2 ? 4 : pass;
      mode_control = 8'(8 + mode); // Keep reset asserted across mode changes.
      for (int speed = 0; speed < 4; speed++) begin
        requested_speed = 2'(speed);
        digital_requested_speed = 2'(speed ^ 1);
        ltsm_requested_speed = 2'(speed ^ 2);
        speed_applied = 1'(speed);
        digital_speed_applied = ~1'(speed);
        ltsm_speed_applied = 1'(speed >> 1);
        selected_speed = 2'(3-speed);
        apply_speed = 1'(speed);
        electrical_idle = 1'(speed >> 1);
        #1;
        check_speed_paths(mode);
      end
      #1;
      check_paths(mode);
      for (int bit_index = 0; bit_index < 20; bit_index++) begin
        valid_code = 20'b1 << bit_index;
        #1;
        check_paths(mode);
      end
      valid_code = '0;
      for (int bit_index = 0; bit_index < 320; bit_index++) begin
        data_codes = 320'b1 << bit_index;
        #1;
        check_paths(mode);
      end
      data_codes = '0;
      for (int bit_index = 0; bit_index < 320; bit_index++) begin
        rx_codes = 320'b1 << bit_index;
        #1;
        check_paths(mode);
      end
      rx_codes = '0;
      for (int bit_index = 0; bit_index < 38; bit_index++) begin
        phase_code = 38'b1 << bit_index;
        #1;
        check_paths(mode);
      end
      phase_code = '0;
      for (int bit_index = 0; bit_index < 1280; bit_index++) begin
        tx_codes = 1280'b1 << bit_index;
        #1;
        check_paths(mode);
      end
      tx_codes = '0;
      #1;
      check_paths(mode);
    end
    $display("PASS UcieCodeWidthSpec_tb: 20/320/320/38/1280-bit paths, all walking bits, 2-bit speed/request/ack paths, functional/digital/LTSM modes");
    $finish;
  end
endmodule

`default_nettype wire
```

## [81] test\UcieDigitalTopBlockTestModesSpec_tb.sv

```systemverilog
// FILE_INDEX: 81
// FILE_PATH : test\UcieDigitalTopBlockTestModesSpec_tb.sv

// Smoke test of the UcieDigitalTop block isolation test modes
// (testModeFdi, testModeRdi, testModeLtsm).
// GENERATED from the UcieDigitalTop port list; regenerate if the ports change.
//
// For each mode the test:
//   - sets only that mode, runs only that block's jtag<Blk>_clock, keeps the
//     functional clock stopped and the functional reset_n asserted;
//   - resets the block through jtag<Blk>_reset_n and drives a stimulus that
//     makes it react (state request to Active, LTSM start);
//   - checks that the block's jtag<Blk>_* outputs change, i.e. it runs on the
//     TDR clock/reset and is observable;
//   - checks that every functional output and every jtag_* (digital TDR)
//     output stays frozen, and that the other blocks' jtag<Blk>_* outputs stay
//     0, so the rest of the core is quiet.
// The functional reset_n is released and the functional inputs would start
// the LTSM and FDI, so the other blocks are quiet only because the core holds
// them in reset.

`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

  // Only the clock of the block under test toggles.
  logic tb_clk = 1'b0;
  always #5ns tb_clk = ~tb_clk;
  typedef enum int {MODE_NONE, MODE_FDI, MODE_RDI, MODE_LTSM} mode_t;
  mode_t mode = MODE_NONE;
  assign jtagFdi_clock  = (mode == MODE_FDI)  & tb_clk;
  assign jtagRdi_clock  = (mode == MODE_RDI)  & tb_clk;
  assign jtagLtsm_clock = (mode == MODE_LTSM) & tb_clk;

  task automatic step(input int unsigned cycles);
    repeat (cycles) @(posedge tb_clk);
    #1ps;
  endtask

  // Run one block mode; quiet_* are the groups that must stay frozen.
  task automatic run_mode(input mode_t m, input string name);
    logic [func_outs_W-1:0] func0;
    logic [dig_outs_W-1:0]  dig0;
    logic [fdi_outs_W-1:0]  fdi0;
    logic [rdi_outs_W-1:0]  rdi0;
    logic [ltsm_outs_W-1:0] ltsm0;
    bit reacted = 0;
    mode = m;
    testModeFdi  = (m == MODE_FDI);
    testModeRdi  = (m == MODE_RDI);
    testModeLtsm = (m == MODE_LTSM);
    jtagFdi_reset_n  = 1'b0;
    jtagRdi_reset_n  = 1'b0;
    jtagLtsm_reset_n = 1'b0;
    // Snapshot after the (asynchronous) resets settle, before any clock edge.
    #1ps;
    func0 = func_outs; dig0 = dig_outs;
    fdi0 = fdi_outs; rdi0 = rdi_outs; ltsm0 = ltsm_outs;
    for (int unsigned c = 0; c < REACT_CYCLES; c++) begin
      if (c == 10) begin
        // Release the block under test after 10 clock cycles in reset.
        case (m)
          MODE_FDI:  jtagFdi_reset_n  = 1'b1;
          MODE_RDI:  jtagRdi_reset_n  = 1'b1;
          MODE_LTSM: jtagLtsm_reset_n = 1'b1;
          default: ;
        endcase
        #1ps;
        fdi0 = fdi_outs; rdi0 = rdi_outs; ltsm0 = ltsm_outs;
      end
      step(1);
      if (func_outs !== func0)
        $fatal(1, "[%s] functional output changed at cycle %0d", name, c);
      if (dig_outs !== dig0 || dig_outs !== '0)
        $fatal(1, "[%s] jtag_* (digital TDR) output not 0 at cycle %0d", name, c);
      if (m != MODE_FDI && fdi_outs !== '0)
        $fatal(1, "[%s] jtagFdi_* output not 0 at cycle %0d", name, c);
      if (m != MODE_RDI && rdi_outs !== '0)
        $fatal(1, "[%s] jtagRdi_* output not 0 at cycle %0d", name, c);
      if (m != MODE_LTSM && ltsm_outs !== '0)
        $fatal(1, "[%s] jtagLtsm_* output not 0 at cycle %0d", name, c);
      case (m)
        MODE_FDI:  reacted |= (fdi_outs  !== fdi0);
        MODE_RDI:  reacted |= (rdi_outs  !== rdi0);
        MODE_LTSM: reacted |= (ltsm_outs !== ltsm0);
        default: ;
      endcase
    end
    if (!reacted)
      $fatal(1, "[%s] block outputs never changed: block not running on its TDR clock/reset", name);
    $display("PASS: %s isolation: block reacts on jtag pins, rest of the top frozen", name);
    testModeFdi = 1'b0; testModeRdi = 1'b0; testModeLtsm = 1'b0;
    mode = MODE_NONE;
    step(2);
  endtask

  initial begin : run_test
    // Everything idle: all inputs 0, functional clock stopped, functional
    // reset_n asserted. The digital TDR clock is stopped too.
    testModeDigital = 1'b0;
    testModeFdi     = 1'b0;

    jtagLtsm_flagFromAnalog_d2cReceiver_txInitD2CResultsPayload = '0;
    jtagLtsm_flagFromAnalog_d2cSender_lfsrPatternSent = '0;
    jtagLtsm_flagFromAnalog_d2cSender_txLaneDeskewApplied = '0;
    jtagLtsm_flagFromAnalog_rxDeskew_lfsrPatternSent = '0;
    jtagLtsm_flagFromAnalog_rxDeskew_rxLaneDeskewApplied = '0;
    jtagLtsm_flagFromAnalog_rxDeskew_detectedDataPattern = '0;
    jtagLtsm_flagFromAnalog_d2cReceiver_laneComparisonSuccessful = '0;
    fdi_lp_state_req = UcieUPM_interfaces_pkg::PhyStateReq_t'('0);
    jtag_fdi_lp_state_req = UcieUPM_interfaces_pkg::PhyStateReq_t'('0);
    jtagFdi_fdi_lp_state_req = UcieUPM_interfaces_pkg::PhyStateReq_t'('0);
    jtagFdi_rdi_pl_state_sts = UcieUPM_interfaces_pkg::PhyState_t'('0);
    jtagRdi_lp_state_req = UcieUPM_interfaces_pkg::PhyStateReq_t'('0);

    // Functional pins: reset released and a stimulus that would start the
    // LTSM and the FDI. Blocks that are not under test must stay quiet only
    // because the core holds them in reset, not because of these pins.
    reset_n            = 1'b1;
    cycles_1us         = 32'd10;
    fdi_lp_state_req   = PhyStateReq_active;
    fdi_lp_clk_ack     = 1'b1;
    ltsm_start         = 1'b1;
    ltsm_stable_clk    = 1'b1;
    ltsm_pll_locked    = 1'b1;
    ltsm_stable_supply = 1'b1;

    // FDI: protocol layer asks for Active, emulated RDI reports Active.
    jtagFdi_cycles_1us        = 32'd10;
    jtagFdi_fdi_lp_state_req  = PhyStateReq_active;
    jtagFdi_fdi_lp_clk_ack    = 1'b1;
    jtagFdi_rdi_pl_state_sts  = PhyState_active;
    jtagFdi_rdi_pl_inband_pres = 1'b1;
    jtagFdi_rdiAwake          = 1'b1;
    jtagFdi_sb_snd_ready      = 1'b1;
    // RDI: emulated FDI asks for Active, emulated LTSM reports link up.
    jtagRdi_cycles_1us        = 32'd10;
    jtagRdi_lp_state_req      = PhyStateReq_active;
    jtagRdi_ltsm_lp_clk_ack   = 1'b1;
    jtagRdi_ltsm_pl_inband_pres = 1'b1;
    jtagRdi_fdiNeedsRdiAwake  = 1'b1;
    jtagRdi_fdiAwake          = 1'b1;
    jtagRdi_sb_snd_ready      = 1'b1;
    // LTSM: start training with stable clock/supply.
    jtagLtsm_start            = 1'b1;
    jtagLtsm_stable_clk       = 1'b1;
    jtagLtsm_pll_locked       = 1'b1;
    jtagLtsm_stable_supply    = 1'b1;
    jtagLtsm_sb_tx_ready      = 1'b1;
    step(5);

    run_mode(MODE_FDI,  "testModeFdi");
    run_mode(MODE_RDI,  "testModeRdi");
    run_mode(MODE_LTSM, "testModeLtsm");
    $finish;
  end
endmodule

`default_nettype wire
```

```systemverilog
// FILE_PATH : test\UcieDigitalTopJtagPhyModeSpec_tb.sv

`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

// PHY isolation test (testModePhy) of UcieDigitalTopJtag through its TDR bus.
// GENERATED from the analog-facing ltsm_* pin list of UcieDigitalTop;
// regenerate if those pins change.
//
// Checks, with the real ctrl and phy jtag_tdr_snapshot registers:
//   - ctrl mode 5 selects testModePhy only, and holds the core in reset;
//   - in functional mode the PHY pins follow the core and the PHY TDR reads 0;
//   - in PHY mode every ltsm_flagToAnalog_* bit follows the PHY TDR write,
//     every PHY status bit is returned by the PHY TDR snapshot (both values
//     at every bit), and the core sees 0 on those inputs;
//   - jtag_nRst keeps the committed PHY word; reset_n returns to functional.

    .ltsm_flagToAnalog_rxDeskew_configureRxInitD2CPointTest(ltsm_flagToAnalog_rxDeskew_configureRxInitD2CPointTest),
```
