```systemverilog
    .ltsm_flagToAnalog_rxDeskew_burstCountSettings(ltsm_flagToAnalog_rxDeskew_burstCountSettings),
    .ltsm_flagToAnalog_rxDeskew_patternMode(ltsm_flagToAnalog_rxDeskew_patternMode),
    .ltsm_flagToAnalog_rxDeskew_clockPhaseControl(ltsm_flagToAnalog_rxDeskew_clockPhaseControl),
    .ltsm_flagToAnalog_rxDeskew_validPattern(ltsm_flagToAnalog_rxDeskew_validPattern),
    .ltsm_flagToAnalog_rxDeskew_dataPattern(ltsm_flagToAnalog_rxDeskew_dataPattern),
    .ltsm_flagToAnalog_rxDeskew_clearComparisonErrors(ltsm_flagToAnalog_rxDeskew_clearComparisonErrors),
    .ltsm_flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_speedCode(ltsm_flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_speedCode),
    .ltsm_flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_applySpeed(ltsm_flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_applySpeed),
    .ltsm_flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_electricalIdle(ltsm_flagToAnalog_linkSpeed_electricalIdle),
    .tdo_ctrl(tdo_ctrl),
    .tdo_dig(tdo_dig),
    .tdo_fdi(tdo_fdi),
    .tdo_rdi(tdo_rdi),
    .tdo_ltsm(tdo_ltsm),
    .tdo_phy(tdo_phy)
  );

  localparam int unsigned PHY_DR_W = ((TO_W > FROM_W) ? TO_W : FROM_W) + 1;
  int checks = 0;

  // TDR bus driven directly, as the external TAP would (one TCK per state).
  task automatic tck_cycle();
    #5 tdr_tck = 1'b1;
    #5 tdr_tck = 1'b0;
  endtask

  // One scan: Capture-DR, PHY_DR_W/9 x Shift-DR (LSB first), Update-DR.
  task automatic scan(input int unsigned bank, input int unsigned width,
                      input logic [PHY_DR_W-1:0] in_bits,
                      output logic [PHY_DR_W-1:0] out_bits);
    sel_ctrl = (bank == 0);
    sel_phy  = (bank == 5);
    out_bits = '0;
    tdr_capture = 1'b1; tck_cycle(); tdr_capture = 1'b0;
    tdr_shift = 1'b1;
    for (int unsigned i = 0; i < width; i++) begin
      tdr_tdi = in_bits[i];
      #1 out_bits[i] = (bank == 0) ? tdo_ctrl : tdo_phy;
      tck_cycle();
    end
    tdr_shift = 1'b0;
    tdr_update = 1'b1; tck_cycle(); tdr_update = 1'b0;
    sel_ctrl = 1'b0; sel_phy = 1'b0;
    repeat (12) tck_cycle(); // let the mailbox handshake complete
  endtask

  task automatic ctrl_write(input logic [7:0] value);
    logic [PHY_DR_W-1:0] tx, rx;
    tx = '0; tx[8:0] = {value, 1'b1};
    scan(0, 9, tx, rx);
    if (dut.ctrl_q !== value) $fatal(1, "ctrl write %h failed (ctrl_q=%h)", value, dut.ctrl_q);
  endtask

  task automatic phy_write(input logic [TO_W-1:0] value);
    logic [PHY_DR_W-1:0] tx, rx;
    tx = '0; tx[TO_W:1] = value; tx[0] = 1'b1;
    scan(5, PHY_DR_W, tx, rx);
  endtask

  // A read is two scans: the first launches the snapshot, the second shifts it out.
  task automatic phy_read(output logic [FROM_W-1:0] value);
    logic [PHY_DR_W-1:0] rx;
    scan(5, PHY_DR_W, '0, rx);
    scan(5, PHY_DR_W, '0, rx);
    if (rx[0] !== 1'b0) $fatal(1, "PHY TDR still busy after read");
    value = rx[FROM_W:1];
  endtask

  function automatic logic [PHY_DR_W-1:0] pattern(input int seed);
    logic [31:0] lfsr;
    lfsr = 32'h1d87_2b41 ^ (32'h0019_3a6d * 32'(seed));
    for (int i = 0; i < PHY_DR_W; i++) begin
      pattern[i] = lfsr[0];
      lfsr = {lfsr[30:0], lfsr[31] ^ lfsr[21] ^ lfsr[1] ^ lfsr[0]};
    end
  endfunction

  task automatic check_functional(input string where);
    logic [FROM_W-1:0] got;
    if (dut.u_top.testModePhy !== 1'b0) $fatal(1, "[%s] testModePhy set", where);
    if (to_pins !== core_to) $fatal(1, "[%s] PHY outputs do not follow the core", where);
    if (core_from !== from_value) $fatal(1, "[%s] core does not see PHY inputs", where);
    phy_read(got);
    if (got !== '0) $fatal(1, "[%s] PHY TDR snapshot not 0 outside PHY mode", where);
    checks++;
  endtask

  task automatic check_phy_write(input logic [TO_W-1:0] value);
    phy_write(value);
    if (to_pins !== value)
      for (int i = 0; i < TO_W; i++)
        if (to_pins[i] !== value[i]) $fatal(1, "flagToAnalog bit %0d != PHY TDR", i);
    checks++;
  endtask

  task automatic check_phy_read(input logic [FROM_W-1:0] value);
    logic [FROM_W-1:0] got;
    from_value = value;
    phy_read(got);
    for (int i = 0; i < FROM_W; i++)
      if (got[i] !== value[i]) $fatal(1, "PHY status bit %0d not in PHY TDR snapshot", i);
    if (core_from !== '0) $fatal(1, "core sees PHY inputs during PHY test");
    checks++;
  endtask

  logic [PHY_DR_W-1:0] p;
  initial begin
    $display("PHY TDR: %0d bits toward PHY, %0d bits from PHY, DR length %0d",
             TO_W, FROM_W, PHY_DR_W);
    if (dut.PHY_W + 1 != PHY_DR_W) $fatal(1, "PHY_W does not match the pin list");
    #20 reset_n = 1'b1; jtag_nRst = 1'b1;
    repeat (4) tck_cycle();

    // Functional mode (ctrl reset value 0x08).
    p = pattern(1);
    from_value = p[FROM_W-1:0];
    check_functional("functional after reset");

    // Every ctrl mode decodes one-hot; mode 5 is PHY and holds the core in reset.
    for (int mode = 0; mode <= 7; mode++) begin
      ctrl_write(8'h08 | 8'(mode));
      if ({dut.u_top.testModePhy, dut.u_top.testModeLtsm, dut.u_top.testModeRdi,
           dut.u_top.testModeFdi, dut.u_top.testModeDigital} !==
          ((mode >= 1 && mode <= 5) ? (5'b1 << (mode - 1)) : 5'b0))
        $fatal(1, "mode %0d decode", mode);
    end
    checks++;

    // PHY mode. sys_rst does not matter here: the core is held in reset.
    ctrl_write(8'h05);
    if (dut.u_top.testModePhy !== 1'b1 || dut.u_top.core_reset_n !== 1'b0)
      $fatal(1, "PHY mode did not hold the core in reset");
    for (int s = 0; s < 3; s++) begin
      p = pattern(10 + s);
      check_phy_write(p[TO_W-1:0]);
      check_phy_write(~p[TO_W-1:0]);
      p = pattern(20 + s);
      check_phy_read(p[FROM_W-1:0]);
      check_phy_read(~p[FROM_W-1:0]);
    end
    // Writes and reads are independent: a read leaves the PHY word in place.
    p = pattern(30);
    check_phy_write(p[TO_W-1:0]);
    begin
      logic [PHY_DR_W-1:0] q;
      q = pattern(32);
      check_phy_read(q[FROM_W-1:0]);
    end
    if (to_pins !== p[TO_W-1:0]) $fatal(1, "PHY read changed the driven PHY word");

    // JTAG reset aborts the mailbox but keeps committed controls (ctrl and PHY).
    jtag_nRst = 1'b0; #20 jtag_nRst = 1'b1;
    repeat (4) tck_cycle();
    if (dut.u_top.testModePhy !== 1'b1 || to_pins !== p[TO_W-1:0])
      $fatal(1, "jtag_nRst changed committed PHY controls");
    checks++;

    // Back to functional through the ctrl register.
    ctrl_write(8'h08);
    check_functional("functional after PHY mode");

    // Functional reset returns ctrl (and so the PHY) to the normal path.
    ctrl_write(8'h05);
    reset_n = 1'b0; #20 reset_n = 1'b1;
    repeat (4) tck_cycle();
    check_functional("functional after reset_n");

    $display("PASS UcieDigitalTopJtagPhyModeSpec_tb checks=%0d", checks);
    $finish;
  end

  initial begin
    #50ms;
    $fatal(1, "watchdog");
  end
endmodule

`default_nettype wire
```

<a id="test-UcieDigitalTopTestModeDigitalSpec_tb-sv"></a>

## [83] test\UcieDigitalTopTestModeDigitalSpec_tb.sv

```systemverilog
// FILE_INDEX: 83
// FILE_PATH : test\UcieDigitalTopTestModeDigitalSpec_tb.sv

// Two-die Reset-to-Active test of UcieDigitalTop in testModeDigital.
// Reuses the dual-die bring-up spec with TEST_MODE_DIGITAL = 1: each die is a
// UcieDigitalTop with testModeDigital tied to 1, and the die model drives and
// observes only its jtag_* pins (clock, reset, FDI, LTSM analog flags and the
// serial sideband pins all go through the TDR side of the muxes).
//
// The functional pins carry junk that would break the link if any of it
// leaked through the test-mode muxes: functional clock and sb_rx_clk are
// stopped, functional reset_n is held asserted, and every other functional
// input is the bit-inverse of the value on its jtag_* twin. Every functional
// output is checked to stay 0 on every clock cycle.
//
// Passing means: both dies reach LTSM/RDI/FDI Active and exchange sideband
// packets over the one-bit serial links using only the jtag_* IOs.

`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

module UcieDigitalTopTestModeDigitalSpec_tb;
  D2DAdapterLinkMgmtLtsmDualDieBringUpSpec_tb #(
    .TEST_MODE_DIGITAL(1'b1)
  ) spec ();
endmodule

`default_nettype wire

```

```systemverilog
// FILE_INDEX: 84
// FILE_PATH : test\UcieDigitalTopTestModeFdiSpec_tb.sv

// Block isolation test of UcieDigitalTop in testModeFdi (fdi: LinkManagementController).
// GENERATED by gen_block_test_mode_tbs.py from the UcieDigitalTop port list and
// the fdi instance in UcieDigitalCore; rerun the script if either changes.
//
// Two UcieDigitalTop instances run side by side: dut gets random stimulus on
// every input group, sh (shadow) gets the same values on the active group only
// and 0 everywhere else (other clocks stopped, other resets asserted). The
// active group is the functional pins in functional phases and the jtagFdi_*
// pins in the block phase. Clocks outside the active group run dut at an
// unrelated period. Phases: functional, testModeFdi, functional again.
//
// Every cycle the test checks:
//   - all phases: every dut output equals the sh output, so nothing outside
//     the active group reaches any output;
//   - functional phases: every TDR output (jtag_*, jtagFdi_*, jtagRdi_*,
//     jtagLtsm_*, jtagPhy_*) is 0;
//   - block phase: every port of u_core.fdi (clock and reset included)
//     equals its jtagFdi_<port> pin (routing probe); a standalone reference
//     LinkManagementController driven by the jtagFdi_* inputs matches every jtagFdi_* output
//     (lockstep); every other TDR output is 0 and every functional output
//     stays constant.
// At the end, with clocks stopped, every fdi output is forced to all-ones
// and random patterns: in functional mode every TDR output must stay 0, in
// testModeFdi each jtagFdi_* pin must follow and the functional outputs must not move.
// This covers outputs the random stimulus never toggles (the end-of-test
// report lists them).
//
// Plusargs: +CYCLES=<block phase cycles> +SEED=<n>.

`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

  ) ref_blk (
    .clock(jtagFdi_clock),
    .reset_n(jtagFdi_reset_n),
    .fdi_lp_state_req(jtagFdi_fdi_lp_state_req),
    .fdi_lp_linkerror(jtagFdi_fdi_lp_linkerror),
    .fdi_lp_rx_active_sts(jtagFdi_fdi_lp_rx_active_sts),

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Clocks. tb_clk drives the active group; junk_clk (unrelated period)
  // drives every inactive clock on dut. sh inactive clocks are stopped.
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  typedef enum int {PH_IDLE, PH_FUNC, PH_BLK} phase_t;
  phase_t phase = PH_IDLE;
  bit clk_en = 0;
  logic tb_clk = 1'b0;
  logic junk_clk = 1'b0;
  always #5ns tb_clk = ~tb_clk;
  always #3.5ns junk_clk = ~junk_clk;

  assign clock = clk_en & ((phase == PH_FUNC) ? tb_clk : junk_clk);
  assign sh_clock = clk_en & (phase == PH_FUNC) & tb_clk;
  assign jtagFdi_clock = clk_en & ((phase == PH_BLK) ? tb_clk : junk_clk);
  assign sh_jtagFdi_clock = clk_en & (phase == PH_BLK) & tb_clk;
  assign jtagLtsm_clock = clk_en & (1'b0 ? tb_clk : junk_clk);
  assign sh_jtagLtsm_clock = clk_en & 1'b0 & tb_clk;
  assign jtagRdi_clock = clk_en & (1'b0 ? tb_clk : junk_clk);
  assign sh_jtagRdi_clock = clk_en & 1'b0 & tb_clk;
  assign jtag_clock = clk_en & (1'b0 ? tb_clk : junk_clk);
  assign sh_jtag_clock = clk_en & 1'b0 & tb_clk;
  assign jtag_sb_rx_clk = clk_en & (1'b0 ? tb_clk : junk_clk);
  assign sh_jtag_sb_rx_clk = clk_en & 1'b0 & tb_clk;
  assign sb_rx_clk = clk_en & ((phase == PH_FUNC) ? tb_clk : junk_clk);
  assign sh_sb_rx_clk = clk_en & (phase == PH_FUNC) & tb_clk;

  assign sh_testModeDigital = testModeDigital;
  assign sh_testModeFdi = testModeFdi;
  assign sh_testModeLtsm = testModeLtsm;
  assign sh_testModePhy = testModePhy;
  assign sh_testModeRdi = testModeRdi;

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Random stimulus
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  logic [2047:0] rnd;
  function automatic logic [2047:0] rnd_bits();
    logic [2047:0] r;
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) r[32*i +: 32] = $urandom;
    return r;
  endfunction
  function automatic PhyStateReq_t rnd_req();
    PhyStateReq_t e = e.first();
    repeat ($urandom_range(e.num() - 1)) e = e.next();
    return e;
  endfunction
  function automatic PhyState_t rnd_sts();
    PhyState_t e = e.first();
    repeat ($urandom_range(e.num() - 1)) e = e.next();
    return e;
  endfunction
  // Active resets: asserted for the first RESET_CYCLES of a phase, then
  // rare short pulses. Inactive resets are random bits like any other input.
  function automatic logic rnd_reset(input logic cur, input int unsigned cyc);
    if (cyc < RESET_CYCLES) return 1'b0;
    if (!cur) return ($urandom_range(3) == 0);
    return ($urandom_range(4095) != 0);
  endfunction

  // Called at negedge tb_clk. Each input gets a new value with probability
  // 1/16 per cycle; sh copies it only if its group is active.
  task automatic drive(input int unsigned cyc);
    bit act_func = (phase == PH_FUNC);
    bit act_dig = 1'b0;
    bit act_Fdi = (phase == PH_BLK);
    bit act_Rdi = 1'b0;
    bit act_Ltsm = 1'b0;
    bit act_Phy = 1'b0;
    reset_n = act_func ? rnd_reset(reset_n, cyc) : 1'($urandom);
    sh_reset_n = act_func ? reset_n : '0;
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); fdi_lp_state_req = rnd_req(); end
    sh_fdi_lp_state_req = act_func ? fdi_lp_state_req : type(fdi_lp_state_req)'('0);
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); fdi_lp_linkerror = rnd[$bits(fdi_lp_linkerror)-1:0]; end
    sh_fdi_lp_linkerror = act_func ? fdi_lp_linkerror : '0;
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); fdi_lp_rx_active_sts = rnd[$bits(fdi_lp_rx_active_sts)-1:0]; end
    sh_fdi_lp_rx_active_sts = act_func ? fdi_lp_rx_active_sts : '0;
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); fdi_lp_wake_req = rnd[$bits(fdi_lp_wake_req)-1:0]; end
    sh_fdi_lp_wake_req = act_func ? fdi_lp_wake_req : '0;
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); fdi_lp_clk_ack = rnd[$bits(fdi_lp_clk_ack)-1:0]; end
    sh_fdi_lp_clk_ack = act_func ? fdi_lp_clk_ack : '0;
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); fdi_lp_stall_ack = rnd[$bits(fdi_lp_stall_ack)-1:0]; end
    sh_fdi_lp_stall_ack = act_func ? fdi_lp_stall_ack : '0;
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); timeout_disable = rnd[$bits(timeout_disable)-1:0]; end
    sh_timeout_disable = act_func ? timeout_disable : '0;
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); cycles_1us = ($urandom_range(3) != 0 ? 32'($urandom_range(4, 1)) : 32'($urandom)); end
    sh_cycles_1us = act_func ? cycles_1us : '0;
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); ltsm_start = rnd[$bits(ltsm_start)-1:0]; end
    sh_ltsm_start = act_func ? ltsm_start : '0;
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); ltsm_stable_clk = rnd[$bits(ltsm_stable_clk)-1:0]; end
    sh_ltsm_stable_clk = act_func ? ltsm_stable_clk : '0;

  // Output walk: force every fdi output to all-ones and random patterns
  // (clocks stopped). Block mode: each jtagFdi_* pin follows and the functional
  // outputs do not move. Functional mode: every TDR output stays 0. Covers
  // outputs that random stimulus never toggles. Run last: after release, a
  // forced register keeps its value until the block next writes it.
  UcieUPM_interfaces_pkg::PhyState_t frc_fdi_pl_state_sts;
  logic frc_fdi_pl_rx_active_req;
  logic frc_fdi_pl_inband_pres;
  logic frc_fdi_pl_wake_ack;
  logic frc_fdi_pl_clk_req;
  logic frc_fdi_pl_stall_req;
  logic frc_fdi_active;
  UcieUPM_d2dadapter_pkg::LinkInitState_t frc_debug_link_init_state;
  logic frc_rdi_lp_linkerror;
  UcieUPM_interfaces_pkg::PhyStateReq_t frc_rdi_lp_state_req;
  logic frc_fdiNeedsRdiAwake;
  logic frc_fdiAwake;
  logic frc_rdi_lp_stall_ack;
  logic frc_sb_snd_valid;
  logic [127:0] frc_sb_snd_msg;
  logic frc_sb_rcv_ready;
  task automatic output_walk(input bit blk_mode, input int unsigned patterns);
    clk_en = 0;
    #20ns;
    func_outs0 = func_outs;
    force dut.u_core.fdi.fdi_pl_state_sts = frc_fdi_pl_state_sts;
    force dut.u_core.fdi.fdi_pl_rx_active_req = frc_fdi_pl_rx_active_req;
    force dut.u_core.fdi.fdi_pl_inband_pres = frc_fdi_pl_inband_pres;
    force dut.u_core.fdi.fdi_pl_wake_ack = frc_fdi_pl_wake_ack;
    force dut.u_core.fdi.fdi_pl_clk_req = frc_fdi_pl_clk_req;
    force dut.u_core.fdi.fdi_pl_stall_req = frc_fdi_pl_stall_req;
    force dut.u_core.fdi.fdi_active = frc_fdi_active;
    force dut.u_core.fdi.debug_link_init_state = frc_debug_link_init_state;
    force dut.u_core.fdi.rdi_lp_linkerror = frc_rdi_lp_linkerror;
    force dut.u_core.fdi.rdi_lp_state_req = frc_rdi_lp_state_req;

    if (&seen0_sb_rcv_valid && &seen1_sb_rcv_valid) inputs_full++; else partial = {partial, " jtagFdi_sb_rcv_valid"};
    if (&seen0_sb_rcv_msg && &seen1_sb_rcv_msg) inputs_full++; else partial = {partial, " jtagFdi_sb_rcv_msg"};
    if (&seen0_timeout_disable && &seen1_timeout_disable) inputs_full++; else partial = {partial, " jtagFdi_timeout_disable"};
    if (&seen0_cycles_1us && &seen1_cycles_1us) inputs_full++; else partial = {partial, " jtagFdi_cycles_1us"};
    $display("testModeFdi: %0d of 16 block outputs toggled, %0d of 16 block inputs saw every bit at 0 and 1", toggled, inputs_full);
    if (never != "" && toggled + 12 >= 16) $display("  outputs never toggled (route checked by the output walk):%s", never);
    else if (never != "") $display("  %0d outputs never toggled (routes checked by the output walk)", 16 - toggled);
    if (partial != "") fail({"block inputs not fully exercised:", partial});
    if (toggled == 0) fail("no block output ever toggled: fdi is not running in testModeFdi");
  endtask

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Phases. Mode pins change only while every clock is stopped.
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  task automatic run_phase(input phase_t ph, input int unsigned cycles);
    clk_en = 0;
    #20ns;
    phase = ph;
    testModeFdi = (ph == PH_BLK);
    for (cycle = 0; cycle < cycles; cycle++) begin
      @(negedge tb_clk);
      if (cycle == 0) clk_en = 1;
      if (cycle > RESET_CYCLES) begin
        check_shadow();
        if (ph == PH_FUNC) check_tdr_zero(0);
        else begin
          if (cycle == RESET_CYCLES + 1) func_outs0 = func_outs;
          check_tdr_zero(1);
          check_block();
          sample_coverage(cycle == RESET_CYCLES + 1);
        end
      end
      drive(cycle);
    end
    clk_en = 0;
    $display("%s phase done: %0d cycles", ph == PH_BLK ? "testModeFdi" : "functional", cycles);
  endtask

  initial begin : run_test
    int unsigned seed, blk_cycles;
    seed = 1;
    blk_cycles = 20000;
    void'($value$plusargs("SEED=%d", seed));
    void'($value$plusargs("CYCLES=%d", blk_cycles));
    void'($urandom(seed));
    $display("UcieDigitalTopTestModeFdiSpec_tb: seed %0d, testModeFdi phase %0d cycles", seed, blk_cycles);
    testModeDigital = 1'b0;
    testModeFdi = 1'b0;
    testModeLtsm = 1'b0;
    testModePhy = 1'b0;
    testModeRdi = 1'b0;
    zero_inputs();
    run_phase(PH_FUNC, FUNC_CYCLES);
    run_phase(PH_BLK, blk_cycles);
    run_phase(PH_FUNC, FUNC_CYCLES);
    output_walk(0, 8);
    phase = PH_BLK;
    testModeFdi = 1'b1;
    output_walk(1, 8);
    report_coverage();
    if (errors != 0) $fatal(1, "FAIL: %0d errors", errors);
    $display("PASS: testModeFdi: fdi routed to jtagFdi_* pins, matches reference, rest of the top isolated");
    $finish;
  end
endmodule

`default_nettype wire

```

<a id="test-UcieDigitalTopTestModeLtsmSpec_tb-sv"></a>

## [85] test\UcieDigitalTopTestModeLtsmSpec_tb.sv

```systemverilog
// FILE_INDEX: 85
// FILE_PATH : test\UcieDigitalTopTestModeLtsmSpec_tb.sv

// Block isolation test of UcieDigitalTop in testModeLtsm (ltsm: LinkTrainingFSM).
// GENERATED by gen_block_test_mode_tbs.py from the UcieDigitalTop port list and
// the ltsm instance in UcieDigitalCore; rerun the script if either changes.
//
// Two UcieDigitalTop instances run side by side: dut gets random stimulus on
// every input group, sh (shadow) gets the same values on the active group only
// and 0 everywhere else (other clocks stopped, other resets asserted). The
// active group is the functional pins in functional phases and the jtagLtsm_*
// pins in the block phase. Clocks outside the active group run dut at an
// unrelated period. Phases: functional, testModeLtsm, functional again.
//
// Every cycle the test checks:
//   - all phases: every dut output equals the sh output, so nothing outside
//     the active group reaches any output;
//   - functional phases: every TDR output (jtag_*, jtagFdi_*, jtagRdi_*,
//     jtagLtsm_*, jtagPhy_*) is 0;
//   - block phase: every port of u_core.ltsm (clock and reset included)
//     equals its jtagLtsm_<port> pin (routing probe); a standalone reference
//     LinkTrainingFSM driven by the jtagLtsm_* inputs matches every jtagLtsm_* output
//     (lockstep); every other TDR output is 0 and every functional output
//     stays constant.
// At the end, with clocks stopped, every ltsm output is forced to all-ones
// and random patterns: in functional mode every TDR output must stay 0, in
// testModeLtsm each jtagLtsm_* pin must follow and the functional outputs must not move.
// This covers outputs the random stimulus never toggles (the end-of-test
// report lists them).
//
// Plusargs: +CYCLES=<block phase cycles> +SEED=<n>.

// Block ports with no TDR pin (fed from the functional pin in test mode):
//   ltsm.cycles_1us <- cycles_1us
// The test holds these pins equal on dut and sh and prints a warning.

`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Clocks. tb_clk drives the active group; junk_clk (unrelated period)
  // drives every inactive clock on dut. sh inactive clocks are stopped.
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  typedef enum int {PH_IDLE, PH_FUNC, PH_BLK} phase_t;
  phase_t phase = PH_IDLE;
  bit clk_en = 0;
  logic tb_clk = 1'b0;
  logic junk_clk = 1'b0;
  always #5ns tb_clk = ~tb_clk;
  always #3.5ns junk_clk = ~junk_clk;

  assign clock = clk_en & ((phase == PH_FUNC) ? tb_clk : junk_clk);
  assign sh_clock = clk_en & (phase == PH_FUNC) & tb_clk;
  assign jtagFdi_clock = clk_en & (1'b0 ? tb_clk : junk_clk);
  assign sh_jtagFdi_clock = clk_en & 1'b0 & tb_clk;
  assign jtagLtsm_clock = clk_en & ((phase == PH_BLK) ? tb_clk : junk_clk);
  assign sh_jtagLtsm_clock = clk_en & (phase == PH_BLK) & tb_clk;
  assign jtagRdi_clock = clk_en & (1'b0 ? tb_clk : junk_clk);
  assign sh_jtagRdi_clock = clk_en & 1'b0 & tb_clk;
  assign jtag_clock = clk_en & (1'b0 ? tb_clk : junk_clk);
  assign sh_jtag_clock = clk_en & 1'b0 & tb_clk;
  assign jtag_sb_rx_clk = clk_en & (1'b0 ? tb_clk : junk_clk);
  assign sh_jtag_sb_rx_clk = clk_en & 1'b0 & tb_clk;
  assign sb_rx_clk = clk_en & ((phase == PH_FUNC) ? tb_clk : junk_clk);
  assign sh_sb_rx_clk = clk_en & (phase == PH_FUNC) & tb_clk;

  assign sh_testModeDigital = testModeDigital;
  assign sh_testModeFdi = testModeFdi;
  assign sh_testModeLtsm = testModeLtsm;
  assign sh_testModePhy = testModePhy;
  assign sh_testModeRdi = testModeRdi;

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Random stimulus
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  logic [2047:0] rnd;
  function automatic logic [2047:0] rnd_bits();
    logic [2047:0] r;
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) r[32*i +: 32] = $urandom;
    return r;
  endfunction
  function automatic PhyStateReq_t rnd_req();
    PhyStateReq_t e = e.first();
    repeat ($urandom_range(e.num() - 1)) e = e.next();
    return e;
  endfunction
  function automatic PhyState_t rnd_sts();
    PhyState_t e = e.first();
    repeat ($urandom_range(e.num() - 1)) e = e.next();
    return e;
  endfunction
  // Active resets: asserted for the first RESET_CYCLES of a phase, then
  // rare short pulses. Inactive resets are random bits like any other input.
  function automatic logic rnd_reset(input logic cur, input int unsigned cyc);
    if (cyc < RESET_CYCLES) return 1'b0;
    if (!cur) return ($urandom_range(3) == 0);
    return ($urandom_range(4095) != 0);
  endfunction

  // Called at negedge tb_clk. Each input gets a new value with probability
  // 1/16 per cycle; sh copies it only if its group is active.
  task automatic drive(input int unsigned cyc);
    bit act_func = (phase == PH_FUNC);
    bit act_dig = 1'b0;
    bit act_Fdi = 1'b0;
    bit act_Rdi = 1'b0;
    bit act_Ltsm = (phase == PH_BLK);
    bit act_Phy = 1'b0;
    reset_n = act_func ? rnd_reset(reset_n, cyc) : 1'($urandom);
    sh_reset_n = act_func ? reset_n : '0;
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); fdi_lp_state_req = rnd_req(); end
    sh_fdi_lp_state_req = act_func ? fdi_lp_state_req : type(fdi_lp_state_req)'('0);
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); fdi_lp_linkerror = rnd[$bits(fdi_lp_linkerror)-1:0]; end
    sh_fdi_lp_linkerror = act_func ? fdi_lp_linkerror : '0;
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); fdi_lp_rx_active_sts = rnd[$bits(fdi_lp_rx_active_sts)-1:0]; end
    sh_fdi_lp_rx_active_sts = act_func ? fdi_lp_rx_active_sts : '0;
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); fdi_lp_wake_req = rnd[$bits(fdi_lp_wake_req)-1:0]; end
    sh_fdi_lp_wake_req = act_func ? fdi_lp_wake_req : '0;
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); fdi_lp_clk_ack = rnd[$bits(fdi_lp_clk_ack)-1:0]; end
    sh_fdi_lp_clk_ack = act_func ? fdi_lp_clk_ack : '0;
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); fdi_lp_stall_ack = rnd[$bits(fdi_lp_stall_ack)-1:0]; end
    sh_fdi_lp_stall_ack = act_func ? fdi_lp_stall_ack : '0;
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); timeout_disable = rnd[$bits(timeout_disable)-1:0]; end
    sh_timeout_disable = act_func ? timeout_disable : '0;
    cycles_1us = 32'd4; sh_cycles_1us = cycles_1us;

    else if (never != "") $display("  %0d outputs never toggled (routes checked by the output walk)", 155 - toggled);

  endtask

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Phases. Mode pins change only while every clock is stopped.
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  task automatic run_phase(input phase_t ph, input int unsigned cycles);
    clk_en = 0;
    #20ns;
    phase = ph;
    testModeLtsm = (ph == PH_BLK);
    for (cycle = 0; cycle < cycles; cycle++) begin
      @(negedge tb_clk);
      if (cycle == 0) clk_en = 1;
      if (cycle > RESET_CYCLES) begin
        check_shadow();
        if (ph == PH_FUNC) check_tdr_zero(0);
        else begin
          if (cycle == RESET_CYCLES + 1) func_outs0 = func_outs;
          check_tdr_zero(1);
          check_block();
          sample_coverage(cycle == RESET_CYCLES + 1);
        end
      end
      drive(cycle);
    end
    clk_en = 0;
    $display("%s phase done: %0d cycles", ph == PH_BLK ? "testModeLtsm" : "functional", cycles);
  endtask

  initial begin : run_test
    int unsigned seed, blk_cycles;
    seed = 1;
    blk_cycles = 20000;
    void'($value$plusargs("SEED=%d", seed));
    void'($value$plusargs("CYCLES=%d", blk_cycles));
    void'($urandom(seed));
    $display("UcieDigitalTopTestModeLtsmSpec_tb: seed %0d, testModeLtsm phase %0d cycles", seed, blk_cycles);
    $warning("ltsm.cycles_1us has no jtagLtsm_cycles_1us TDR pin: in testModeLtsm it is fed from the functional pin cycles_1us");
    testModeDigital = 1'b0;
    testModeFdi = 1'b0;
    testModeLtsm = 1'b0;
    testModePhy = 1'b0;
    testModeRdi = 1'b0;
    zero_inputs();
    run_phase(PH_FUNC, FUNC_CYCLES);
    run_phase(PH_BLK, blk_cycles);
    run_phase(PH_FUNC, FUNC_CYCLES);
    output_walk(0, 8);
    phase = PH_BLK;
    testModeLtsm = 1'b1;
    output_walk(1, 8);
    report_coverage();
    if (errors != 0) $fatal(1, "FAIL: %0d errors", errors);
    $display("PASS: testModeLtsm: ltsm routed to jtagLtsm_* pins, matches reference, rest of the top isolated");
    $finish;
  end
endmodule

`default_nettype wire

```

<a id="test-UcieDigitalTopTestModeRdiSpec_tb-sv"></a>

## [86] test\UcieDigitalTopTestModeRdiSpec_tb.sv

```systemverilog
// FILE_INDEX: 86
// FILE_PATH : test\UcieDigitalTopTestModeRdiSpec_tb.sv

// Block isolation test of UcieDigitalTop in testModeRdi (rdi: RdiLinkManagementController).
// GENERATED by gen_block_test_mode_tbs.py from the UcieDigitalTop port list and
// the rdi instance in UcieDigitalCore; rerun the script if either changes.
//
// Two UcieDigitalTop instances run side by side: dut gets random stimulus on
// every input group, sh (shadow) gets the same values on the active group only
// and 0 everywhere else (other clocks stopped, other resets asserted). The
// active group is the functional pins in functional phases and the jtagRdi_*
// pins in the block phase. Clocks outside the active group run dut at an
// unrelated period. Phases: functional, testModeRdi, functional again.
//
// Every cycle the test checks:
//   - all phases: every dut output equals the sh output, so nothing outside
//     the active group reaches any output;
//   - functional phases: every TDR output (jtag_*, jtagFdi_*, jtagRdi_*,
//     jtagLtsm_*, jtagPhy_*) is 0;
//   - block phase: every port of u_core.rdi (clock and reset included)
//     equals its jtagRdi_<port> pin (routing probe); a standalone reference
//     RdiLinkManagementController driven by the jtagRdi_* inputs matches every jtagRdi_* output
//     (lockstep); every other TDR output is 0 and every functional output
//     stays constant.
// At the end, with clocks stopped, every rdi output is forced to all-ones
// and random patterns: in functional mode every TDR output must stay 0, in
// testModeRdi each jtagRdi_* pin must follow and the functional outputs must not move.
// This covers outputs the random stimulus never toggles (the end-of-test
// report lists them).
//
// Plusargs: +CYCLES=<block phase cycles> +SEED=<n>.

`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

  RdiLinkManagementController ref_blk (
    .clock(jtagRdi_clock),
    .reset_n(jtagRdi_reset_n),
    .ltsm_lp_wake_req(jtagRdi_ltsm_lp_wake_req),
    .ltsm_pl_wake_ack(ref_ltsm_pl_wake_ack),
    .ltsm_pl_clk_req(ref_ltsm_pl_clk_req),
    .ltsm_lp_clk_ack(jtagRdi_ltsm_lp_clk_ack),
    .lp_state_req(jtagRdi_lp_state_req),
    .pl_state_sts(ref_pl_state_sts),
    .pl_stallreq(ref_pl_stallreq),
    .lp_stallack(jtagRdi_lp_stallack),

    .ltsm_pl_inband_pres(jtagRdi_ltsm_pl_inband_pres),

    .fdiAwake(jtagRdi_fdiAwake),

    .sb_snd_ready(jtagRdi_sb_snd_ready),
    .sb_rcv_valid(jtagRdi_sb_rcv_valid),
    .sb_rcv_msg(jtagRdi_sb_rcv_msg),
    .sb_rcv_ready(ref_sb_rcv_ready),
    .lp_linkerror(jtagRdi_lp_linkerror),

    .timeout_disable(jtagRdi_timeout_disable),
    .cycles_1us(jtagRdi_cycles_1us)

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Clocks. tb_clk drives the active group; junk_clk (unrelated period)
  // drives every inactive clock on dut. sh inactive clocks are stopped.
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  typedef enum int {PH_IDLE, PH_FUNC, PH_BLK} phase_t;
  phase_t phase = PH_IDLE;
  bit clk_en = 0;
  logic tb_clk = 1'b0;
  logic junk_clk = 1'b0;
  always #5ns tb_clk = ~tb_clk;
  always #3.5ns junk_clk = ~junk_clk;

  assign clock = clk_en & ((phase == PH_FUNC) ? tb_clk : junk_clk);
  assign sh_clock = clk_en & (phase == PH_FUNC) & tb_clk;
  assign jtagFdi_clock = clk_en & (1'b0 ? tb_clk : junk_clk);
  assign sh_jtagFdi_clock = clk_en & 1'b0 & tb_clk;
  assign jtagLtsm_clock = clk_en & (1'b0 ? tb_clk : junk_clk);
  assign sh_jtagLtsm_clock = clk_en & 1'b0 & tb_clk;
  assign jtagRdi_clock = clk_en & ((phase == PH_BLK) ? tb_clk : junk_clk);
  assign sh_jtagRdi_clock = clk_en & (phase == PH_BLK) & tb_clk;
  assign jtag_clock = clk_en & (1'b0 ? tb_clk : junk_clk);
  assign sh_jtag_clock = clk_en & 1'b0 & tb_clk;
  assign jtag_sb_rx_clk = clk_en & (1'b0 ? tb_clk : junk_clk);
  assign sh_jtag_sb_rx_clk = clk_en & 1'b0 & tb_clk;
  assign sb_rx_clk = clk_en & ((phase == PH_FUNC) ? tb_clk : junk_clk);
  assign sh_sb_rx_clk = clk_en & (phase == PH_FUNC) & tb_clk;

  assign sh_testModeDigital = testModeDigital;
  assign sh_testModeFdi = testModeFdi;
  assign sh_testModeLtsm = testModeLtsm;
  assign sh_testModePhy = testModePhy;
  assign sh_testModeRdi = testModeRdi;

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Random stimulus
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  logic [2047:0] rnd;
  function automatic logic [2047:0] rnd_bits();
    logic [2047:0] r;
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) r[32*i +: 32] = $urandom;
    return r;
  endfunction
  function automatic PhyStateReq_t rnd_req();
    PhyStateReq_t e = e.first();
    repeat ($urandom_range(e.num() - 1)) e = e.next();
    return e;
  endfunction
  function automatic PhyState_t rnd_sts();
    PhyState_t e = e.first();
    repeat ($urandom_range(e.num() - 1)) e = e.next();
    return e;
  endfunction
  // Active resets: asserted for the first RESET_CYCLES of a phase, then
  // rare short pulses. Inactive resets are random bits like any other input.
  function automatic logic rnd_reset(input logic cur, input int unsigned cyc);
    if (cyc < RESET_CYCLES) return 1'b0;
    if (!cur) return ($urandom_range(3) == 0);
    return ($urandom_range(4095) != 0);
  endfunction

  // Called at negedge tb_clk. Each input gets a new value with probability
  // 1/16 per cycle; sh copies it only if its group is active.
  task automatic drive(input int unsigned cyc);
    bit act_func = (phase == PH_FUNC);
    bit act_dig = 1'b0;
    bit act_Fdi = 1'b0;
    bit act_Rdi = (phase == PH_BLK);
    bit act_Ltsm = 1'b0;
    bit act_Phy = 1'b0;
    reset_n = act_func ? rnd_reset(reset_n, cyc) : 1'($urandom);
    sh_reset_n = act_func ? reset_n : '0;
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); fdi_lp_state_req = rnd_req(); end
    sh_fdi_lp_state_req = act_func ? fdi_lp_state_req : type(fdi_lp_state_req)'('0);
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); fdi_lp_linkerror = rnd[$bits(fdi_lp_linkerror)-1:0]; end
    sh_fdi_lp_linkerror = act_func ? fdi_lp_linkerror : '0;
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); fdi_lp_rx_active_sts = rnd[$bits(fdi_lp_rx_active_sts)-1:0]; end
    sh_fdi_lp_rx_active_sts = act_func ? fdi_lp_rx_active_sts : '0;
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); fdi_lp_wake_req = rnd[$bits(fdi_lp_wake_req)-1:0]; end
    sh_fdi_lp_wake_req = act_func ? fdi_lp_wake_req : '0;
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); fdi_lp_clk_ack = rnd[$bits(fdi_lp_clk_ack)-1:0]; end
    sh_fdi_lp_clk_ack = act_func ? fdi_lp_clk_ack : '0;
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); fdi_lp_stall_ack = rnd[$bits(fdi_lp_stall_ack)-1:0]; end
    sh_fdi_lp_stall_ack = act_func ? fdi_lp_stall_ack : '0;
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); timeout_disable = rnd[$bits(timeout_disable)-1:0]; end
    sh_timeout_disable = act_func ? timeout_disable : '0;
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); cycles_1us = ($urandom_range(3) != 0 ? 32'($urandom_range(4, 1)) : 32'($urandom)); end
    sh_cycles_1us = act_func ? cycles_1us : '0;
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); ltsm_start = rnd[$bits(ltsm_start)-1:0]; end
    sh_ltsm_start = act_func ? ltsm_start : '0;
    if ($urandom_range(15) == 0) begin rnd = rnd_bits(); ltsm_stable_clk = rnd[$bits(ltsm_stable_clk)-1:0]; end

  // Output walk: force every rdi output to all-ones and random patterns
  // (clocks stopped). Block mode: each jtagRdi_* pin follows and the functional
  // outputs do not move. Functional mode: every TDR output stays 0. Covers
  // outputs that random stimulus never toggles. Run last: after release, a
  // forced register keeps its value until the block next writes it.
  logic frc_ltsm_pl_wake_ack;
  logic frc_ltsm_pl_clk_req;
  UcieUPM_interfaces_pkg::PhyState_t frc_pl_state_sts;
  logic frc_pl_stallreq;
  logic frc_rdi_pl_inband_pres;
  logic frc_rdiAwake;
  logic frc_rdiNeedsFdiAwake;
  logic frc_sb_snd_valid;
  logic [127:0] frc_sb_snd_msg;
  logic frc_sb_rcv_ready;
  logic frc_pl_phyinrecenter;
  task automatic output_walk(input bit blk_mode, input int unsigned patterns);
    clk_en = 0;
    #20ns;
    func_outs0 = func_outs;
    force dut.u_core.rdi.ltsm_pl_wake_ack = frc_ltsm_pl_wake_ack;
    force dut.u_core.rdi.ltsm_pl_clk_req = frc_ltsm_pl_clk_req;
    force dut.u_core.rdi.pl_state_sts = frc_pl_state_sts;
    force dut.u_core.rdi.pl_stallreq = frc_pl_stallreq;
    force dut.u_core.rdi.rdi_pl_inband_pres = frc_rdi_pl_inband_pres;
    force dut.u_core.rdi.rdiAwake = frc_rdiAwake;
    force dut.u_core.rdi.rdiNeedsFdiAwake = frc_rdiNeedsFdiAwake;
    force dut.u_core.rdi.sb_snd_valid = frc_sb_snd_valid;
    force dut.u_core.rdi.sb_snd_msg = frc_sb_snd_msg;
    force dut.u_core.rdi.sb_rcv_ready = frc_sb_rcv_ready;
    force dut.u_core.rdi.pl_phyinrecenter = frc_pl_phyinrecenter;
    for (int unsigned k = 0; k < patterns; k++) begin
      rnd = k == 0 ? '1 : rnd_bits(); frc_ltsm_pl_wake_ack = type(frc_ltsm_pl_wake_ack)'(rnd[$bits(frc_ltsm_pl_wake_ack)-1:0]);
      rnd = k == 0 ? '1 : rnd_bits(); frc_ltsm_pl_clk_req = type(frc_ltsm_pl_clk_req)'(rnd[$bits(frc_ltsm_pl_clk_req)-1:0]);
      rnd = k == 0 ? '1 : rnd_bits(); frc_pl_state_sts = type(frc_pl_state_sts)'(rnd[$bits(frc_pl_state_sts)-1:0]);
      rnd = k == 0 ? '1 : rnd_bits(); frc_pl_stallreq = type(frc_pl_stallreq)'(rnd[$bits(frc_pl_stallreq)-1:0]);
      rnd = k == 0 ? '1 : rnd_bits(); frc_rdi_pl_inband_pres = type(frc_rdi_pl_inband_pres)'(rnd[$bits(frc_rdi_pl_inband_pres)-1:0]);
      rnd = k == 0 ? '1 : rnd_bits(); frc_rdiAwake = type(frc_rdiAwake)'(rnd[$bits(frc_rdiAwake)-1:0]);
      rnd = k == 0 ? '1 : rnd_bits(); frc_rdiNeedsFdiAwake = type(frc_rdiNeedsFdiAwake)'(rnd[$bits(frc_rdiNeedsFdiAwake)-1:0]);
      rnd = k == 0 ? '1 : rnd_bits(); frc_sb_snd_valid = type(frc_sb_snd_valid)'(rnd[$bits(frc_sb_snd_valid)-1:0]);
      rnd = k == 0 ? '1 : rnd_bits(); frc_sb_snd_msg = type(frc_sb_snd_msg)'(rnd[$bits(frc_sb_snd_msg)-1:0]);
      rnd = k == 0 ? '1 : rnd_bits(); frc_sb_rcv_ready = type(frc_sb_rcv_ready)'(rnd[$bits(frc_sb_rcv_ready)-1:0]);
      rnd = k == 0 ? '1 : rnd_bits(); frc_pl_phyinrecenter = type(frc_pl_phyinrecenter)'(rnd[$bits(frc_pl_phyinrecenter)-1:0]);
      #1ns;
      if (blk_mode) begin
        if (func_outs !== func_outs0) fail("functional output follows a forced rdi output in testModeRdi");
        check_tdr_zero(1);
        if (jtagRdi_ltsm_pl_wake_ack !== frc_ltsm_pl_wake_ack) fail($sformatf("output route: forced rdi.ltsm_pl_wake_ack %0h, jtagRdi_ltsm_pl_wake_ack %0h", frc_ltsm_pl_wake_ack, jtagRdi_ltsm_pl_wake_ack));
        if (jtagRdi_ltsm_pl_clk_req !== frc_ltsm_pl_clk_req) fail($sformatf("output route: forced rdi.ltsm_pl_clk_req %0h, jtagRdi_ltsm_pl_clk_req %0h", frc_ltsm_pl_clk_req, jtagRdi_ltsm_pl_clk_req));
        if (jtagRdi_pl_state_sts !== frc_pl_state_sts) fail($sformatf("output route: forced rdi.pl_state_sts %0h, jtagRdi_pl_state_sts %0h", frc_pl_state_sts, jtagRdi_pl_state_sts));
        if (jtagRdi_pl_stallreq !== frc_pl_stallreq) fail($sformatf("output route: forced rdi.pl_stallreq %0h, jtagRdi_pl_stallreq %0h", frc_pl_stallreq, jtagRdi_pl_stallreq));
        if (jtagRdi_rdi_pl_inband_pres !== frc_rdi_pl_inband_pres) fail($sformatf("output route: forced rdi.rdi_pl_inband_pres %0h, jtagRdi_rdi_pl_inband_pres %0h", frc_rdi_pl_inband_pres, jtagRdi_rdi_pl_inband_pres));
        if (jtagRdi_rdiAwake !== frc_rdiAwake) fail($sformatf("output route: forced rdi.rdiAwake %0h, jtagRdi_rdiAwake %0h", frc_rdiAwake, jtagRdi_rdiAwake));
        if (jtagRdi_rdiNeedsFdiAwake !== frc_rdiNeedsFdiAwake) fail($sformatf("output route: forced rdi.rdiNeedsFdiAwake %0h, jtagRdi_rdiNeedsFdiAwake %0h", frc_rdiNeedsFdiAwake, jtagRdi_rdiNeedsFdiAwake));
        if (jtagRdi_sb_snd_valid !== frc_sb_snd_valid) fail($sformatf("output route: forced rdi.sb_snd_valid %0h, jtagRdi_sb_snd_valid %0h", frc_sb_snd_valid, jtagRdi_sb_snd_valid));
        if (jtagRdi_sb_snd_msg !== frc_sb_snd_msg) fail($sformatf("output route: forced rdi.sb_snd_msg %0h, jtagRdi_sb_snd_msg %0h", frc_sb_snd_msg, jtagRdi_sb_snd_msg));

    if (&seen0_ltsm_lp_wake_req && &seen1_ltsm_lp_wake_req) inputs_full++; else partial = {partial, " jtagRdi_ltsm_lp_wake_req"};
    if (&seen0_ltsm_lp_clk_ack && &seen1_ltsm_lp_clk_ack) inputs_full++; else partial = {partial, " jtagRdi_ltsm_lp_clk_ack"};

    if (&seen0_fdiAwake && &seen1_fdiAwake) inputs_full++; else partial = {partial, " jtagRdi_fdiAwake"};
    if (&seen0_sb_snd_ready && &seen1_sb_snd_ready) inputs_full++; else partial = {partial, " jtagRdi_sb_snd_ready"};
    if (&seen0_sb_rcv_valid && &seen1_sb_rcv_valid) inputs_full++; else partial = {partial, " jtagRdi_sb_rcv_valid"};
    if (&seen0_sb_rcv_msg && &seen1_sb_rcv_msg) inputs_full++; else partial = {partial, " jtagRdi_sb_rcv_msg"};
    if (&seen0_lp_linkerror && &seen1_lp_linkerror) inputs_full++; else partial = {partial, " jtagRdi_lp_linkerror"};
    if (&seen0_timeout_disable && &seen1_timeout_disable) inputs_full++; else partial = {partial, " jtagRdi_timeout_disable"};
    if (&seen0_cycles_1us && &seen1_cycles_1us) inputs_full++; else partial = {partial, " jtagRdi_cycles_1us"};
    $display("testModeRdi: %0d of 11 block outputs toggled, %0d of 13 block inputs saw every bit at 0 and 1", toggled, inputs_full);
    if (never != "" && toggled + 12 >= 11) $display("  outputs never toggled (route checked by the output walk):%s", never);
    else if (never != "") $display("  %0d outputs never toggled (routes checked by the output walk)", 11 - toggled);
    if (partial != "") fail({"block inputs not fully exercised:", partial});
    if (toggled == 0) fail("no block output ever toggled: rdi is not running in testModeRdi");
  endtask

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Phases. Mode pins change only while every clock is stopped.
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  task automatic run_phase(input phase_t ph, input int unsigned cycles);
    clk_en = 0;
    #20ns;
    phase = ph;
    testModeRdi = (ph == PH_BLK);
    for (cycle = 0; cycle < cycles; cycle++) begin
      @(negedge tb_clk);
      if (cycle == 0) clk_en = 1;
      if (cycle > RESET_CYCLES) begin
        check_shadow();
        if (ph == PH_FUNC) check_tdr_zero(0);
        else begin
          if (cycle == RESET_CYCLES + 1) func_outs0 = func_outs;
          check_tdr_zero(1);
          check_block();
          sample_coverage(cycle == RESET_CYCLES + 1);
        end
      end
      drive(cycle);
    end
    clk_en = 0;
    $display("%s phase done: %0d cycles", ph == PH_BLK ? "testModeRdi" : "functional", cycles);
  endtask

  initial begin : run_test
    int unsigned seed, blk_cycles;
    seed = 1;
    blk_cycles = 20000;
    void'($value$plusargs("SEED=%d", seed));
    void'($value$plusargs("CYCLES=%d", blk_cycles));
    void'($urandom(seed));
    $display("UcieDigitalTopTestModeRdiSpec_tb: seed %0d, testModeRdi phase %0d cycles", seed, blk_cycles);
    testModeDigital = 1'b0;
    testModeFdi = 1'b0;
    testModeLtsm = 1'b0;
    testModePhy = 1'b0;
    testModeRdi = 1'b0;
    zero_inputs();
    run_phase(PH_FUNC, FUNC_CYCLES);
    run_phase(PH_BLK, blk_cycles);
    run_phase(PH_FUNC, FUNC_CYCLES);
    output_walk(0, 8);
    phase = PH_BLK;
    testModeRdi = 1'b1;
    output_walk(1, 8);
    report_coverage();
    if (errors != 0) $fatal(1, "FAIL: %0d errors", errors);
    $display("PASS: testModeRdi: rdi routed to jtagRdi_* pins, matches reference, rest of the top isolated");
    $finish;
  end
endmodule

`default_nettype wire
```

```systemverilog
// FILE_INDEX: 87
// FILE_PATH : test\VrefOneHotSpec_tb.sv

`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

// Directed digital tests for the shared engines used by all four Vref states.
module VrefOneHotSpec_tb;
  logic clock = 1'b0;
  always #5 clock = ~clock;
  logic reset_n = 1'b0;
  logic start = 1'b0;
  logic validApply, validApplied = 1'b0, validPointStart;
  logic validPointDone = 1'b0, validPointPass = 1'b0;
  logic validBusy, validDone, validError;
  logic [19:0] validCode, validSelected, validLeft, validRight;
  logic [3:0] validState;
  logic [15:0] validFailed, validRetries;
  logic dataApply, dataApplied = 1'b0, dataPointStart;
  logic dataPointDone = 1'b0;
  logic [3:0] dataPointPass = '0;
  logic dataBusy, dataDone, dataError;
  logic [79:0] dataCodes, dataSelected, dataLeft, dataRight;
  logic [3:0] dataState;
  logic [15:0] dataFailed, dataRetries;

  MBTrain_ValidVrefSweepEngine #(.MAX_TRAINING_RETRIES(1)) validDut (
    .clock(clock), .reset_n(reset_n), .start(start),
    .busy(validBusy), .done(validDone), .trainError(validError),
    .apply_rx_vref(validApply), .rx_vref_code(validCode),
    .rx_vref_applied(validApplied), .point_test_start(validPointStart),
    .point_test_done(validPointDone), .point_test_pass(validPointPass),
    .state(validState), .lastFailedPointCount(validFailed),
    .retryCount(validRetries), .finalVrefCode(validSelected),
    .validLeftCode(validLeft), .validRightCode(validRight)
  );
  MBTrain_DataVrefSweepEngine #(
    .DATA_LANE_COUNT(4), .ACTIVE_DATA_LANE_MASK(4'b0111),
    .MAX_TRAINING_RETRIES(1)
  ) dataDut (
    .clock(clock), .reset_n(reset_n), .start(start),
    .busy(dataBusy), .done(dataDone), .trainError(dataError),
    .apply_rx_vref(dataApply), .rx_vref_codes(dataCodes),
    .rx_vref_applied(dataApplied), .point_test_start(dataPointStart),
    .point_test_done(dataPointDone), .point_test_pass(dataPointPass),
    .state(dataState), .lastFailedLaneCount(dataFailed),
    .retryCount(dataRetries), .finalVrefCodes(dataSelected),
    .validLeftCodes(dataLeft), .validRightCodes(dataRight)
  );

  function automatic logic [19:0] code(input int tap);
    return 20'b1 << tap;
  endfunction

  function automatic int decode(input logic [19:0] value);
    for (int tap = 0; tap < 20; tap++)
      if (value == code(tap)) return tap;
    $fatal(1, "Vref code is not exactly one-hot: %h", value);
    return -1;
  endfunction

  function automatic bit validPassAt(input int scenario, input int tap);
    case (scenario)
      0, 3: return tap >= 4 && tap <= 9;
      1: return (tap >= 2 && tap <= 5) || (tap >= 12 && tap <= 15);
      2: return 1'b0;
      default: return 1'b1;
    endcase
  endfunction

  function automatic bit dataPassAt(input int scenario, input int lane, input int tap);
    if (scenario == 2) return 1'b0;
    if (scenario == 4) return 1'b1;
    if (scenario == 1) begin
      case (lane)
        0: return (tap >= 2 && tap <= 5) || (tap >= 12 && tap <= 15);
        1: return tap == 19;
        default: return tap == 0;
      endcase
    end
    case (lane)
      0: return tap == 0;
      1: return tap >= 16 && tap <= 19;
      default: return 1'b1;
    endcase
  endfunction

  task automatic checkWindow(
    input logic [19:0] selectedCode, leftCode, rightCode,
    input int selectedTap, leftTap, rightTap
  );
    if (selectedCode !== code(selectedTap) ||
        leftCode !== code(leftTap) || rightCode !== code(rightTap))
      $fatal(1, "Window mismatch: selected=%h left=%h right=%h; expected taps %0d/%0d/%0d",
        selectedCode, leftCode, rightCode, selectedTap, leftTap, rightTap);
  endtask

  task automatic runScenario(input int scenario);
    int validSweepApplies, dataSweepApplies, validFinalApplies, dataFinalApplies;
    int cycles, tap;
    validSweepApplies = 0;
    dataSweepApplies = 0;
    validFinalApplies = 0;
    dataFinalApplies = 0;
    cycles = 0;
    @(negedge clock);
    reset_n = 1'b0;
    start = 1'b0;
    validApplied = 1'b0;
    dataApplied = 1'b0;
    validPointDone = 1'b0;
    dataPointDone = 1'b0;
    @(negedge clock);
    if (validSelected !== '0 || validLeft !== '0 || validRight !== '0 ||
        dataSelected !== '0 || dataLeft !== '0 || dataRight !== '0)
      $fatal(1, "Unselected windows must be zero after reset");
    reset_n = 1'b1;
    start = 1'b1;
    @(negedge clock);
    start = 1'b0;
    while (!((validDone || validError) && (dataDone || dataError))) begin
      if (++cycles > 1000) $fatal(1, "Scenario %0d timed out", scenario);
      validApplied = validApply;
      dataApplied = dataApply;
      validPointDone = validState == 4'h3 || validState == 4'h7;
      dataPointDone = dataState == 4'h3 || dataState == 4'h7;
      if (validApply) begin
        tap = decode(validCode);
        if (validState == 4'h1) begin
          if (tap != validSweepApplies % 20)
            $fatal(1, "Valid sweep skipped/reordered a tap");
          validSweepApplies++;
        end else validFinalApplies++;
      end
      if (dataApply) begin
        for (int lane = 0; lane < 3; lane++) begin
          tap = decode(dataCodes[lane*20 +: 20]);
          if (dataState == 4'h1 && tap != dataSweepApplies % 20)
            $fatal(1, "Data sweep skipped/reordered a tap on lane %0d", lane);
        end
        if (dataState == 4'h1) dataSweepApplies++;
        else dataFinalApplies++;
      end
      if (dataCodes[60 +: 20] !== '0 || dataSelected[60 +: 20] !== '0 ||
          dataLeft[60 +: 20] !== '0 || dataRight[60 +: 20] !== '0)
        $fatal(1, "Inactive data lane must stay zero");
      if (validState == 4'h3)
        validPointPass = validPassAt(scenario, decode(validCode));
      else if (validState == 4'h7)
        validPointPass = !(scenario == 3 && validFinalApplies == 1);
      if (dataState == 4'h3) begin
        dataPointPass = '0;
        for (int lane = 0; lane < 3; lane++)
          dataPointPass[lane] =
            dataPassAt(scenario, lane, decode(dataCodes[lane*20 +: 20]));
      end else if (dataState == 4'h7)
        dataPointPass = scenario == 3 && dataFinalApplies == 1 ? 4'b0000 : 4'b0111;
      @(negedge clock);
    end
    validApplied = 1'b0;
    dataApplied = 1'b0;
    validPointDone = 1'b0;
    dataPointDone = 1'b0;
    if (scenario == 2) begin
      if (!validError || !dataError || validRetries != 1 || dataRetries != 1 ||
          validSweepApplies != 40 || dataSweepApplies != 40 ||
          validFinalApplies != 0 || dataFinalApplies != 0)
        $fatal(1, "No-window retry/error behavior failed");
    end else begin
      if (!validDone || !dataDone || validError || dataError)
        $fatal(1, "Passing windows did not complete");
      if (validSweepApplies != (scenario == 3 ? 40 : 20) ||
          dataSweepApplies != (scenario == 3 ? 40 : 20) ||
          validFinalApplies != (scenario == 3 ? 2 : 1) ||
          dataFinalApplies != (scenario == 3 ? 2 : 1) ||
          validRetries != (scenario == 3 ? 1 : 0) ||
          dataRetries != (scenario == 3 ? 1 : 0))
        $fatal(1, "Unexpected sweep or final-verify counts");
      case (scenario)
        0, 3: begin
          checkWindow(validSelected, validLeft, validRight, 6, 4, 9);
          checkWindow(dataSelected[0 +: 20], dataLeft[0 +: 20], dataRight[0 +: 20], 0, 0, 0);
          checkWindow(dataSelected[20 +: 20], dataLeft[20 +: 20], dataRight[20 +: 20], 17, 16, 19);
          checkWindow(dataSelected[40 +: 20], dataLeft[40 +: 20], dataRight[40 +: 20], 9, 0, 19);
        end
        1: begin
          checkWindow(validSelected, validLeft, validRight, 3, 2, 5);
          checkWindow(dataSelected[0 +: 20], dataLeft[0 +: 20], dataRight[0 +: 20], 3, 2, 5);
          checkWindow(dataSelected[20 +: 20], dataLeft[20 +: 20], dataRight[20 +: 20], 19, 19, 19);
          checkWindow(dataSelected[40 +: 20], dataLeft[40 +: 20], dataRight[40 +: 20], 0, 0, 0);
        end
        default: begin
          checkWindow(validSelected, validLeft, validRight, 9, 0, 19);
          for (int lane = 0; lane < 3; lane++)
            checkWindow(dataSelected[lane*20 +: 20], dataLeft[lane*20 +: 20],
              dataRight[lane*20 +: 20], 9, 0, 19);
        end
      endcase
    end
    $display("PASS Vref one-hot scenario %0d", scenario);
  endtask
```
